# Tasks and subtasks

Every task of `tasks/`: its instruction, the success predicate, the subtasks every rollout is scored with (grade.py; the rule is on the Grading page) and every file of the task's folder, expandable, with its path from the repository root.

## beam

Several loose parts lie on the table, but only one belongs to this assembly. Identify the piece missing from the partially assembled symmetric structure, pick it up, and add it to the structure. Then let go and draw the arm back.

<details><summary><b>Success</b> (task.json; the last subtask)</summary><div style="max-height:22em;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:6px 10px"><div style="padding-left:0em">all of:</div><div style="padding-left:1.1em">&bull; part0 within 5 mm and 6° of its goal pose; lateral error ≤ 0.6 mm in the reference frame</div><div style="padding-left:1.1em">&bull; robot clear of part0</div></div></details>

**Subtasks** (`tasks/beam/grade.py`): the score is the share done; solved when all are.

<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>subtask</th><th>done when</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>1</td><td>pick the missing part among the loose parts and seat it on the structure, release</td><td>the task's success (task.json's tree above) holds at the end, for half a second</td></tr></tbody></table>

<details><summary><code>tasks/beam/test.py</code> (4 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the beam task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np
import pytest
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.grade_episode import make_checker, nodes
from core.tasks import TASKS
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from core import grade_episode as predicates
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
)


def test_fabrica_pose_within():
    if not (TASKS / &quot;beam&quot; / &quot;task.json&quot;).exists():
        pytest.skip(&quot;fabrica/beam pack not materialized&quot;)
    env = SimEnv(&quot;beam&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    success = env.spec[&quot;success&quot;]
    check, _ = make_checker(success)
    spec = next(n for n in nodes(success) if n.get(&quot;pred&quot;) == &quot;pose_within&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False

    qadr = env.model.joint(env.model.body(spec[&quot;obj&quot;]).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
    ref = env.data.body(spec[&quot;rel_to&quot;])
    goal_p = ref.xpos + ref.xmat.reshape(3, 3) @ np.asarray(spec[&quot;pos&quot;])
    goal_q = np.empty(4)
    mujoco.mju_mulQuat(goal_q, ref.xquat, np.asarray(spec[&quot;quat&quot;], dtype=float))
    env.data.qpos[qadr : qadr + 3] = goal_p
    env.data.qpos[qadr + 3 : qadr + 7] = goal_q
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True

    env.data.qpos[qadr] += 0.01
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False

    env.data.qpos[qadr] -= 0.01
    env.data.qpos[qadr + 3 : qadr + 7] = R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, 90, degrees=True).as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_touching_part_survives_missing_sleep_contacts(monkeypatch):
    env = _pack_env(&quot;jenga_tower&quot;)
    block = &quot;jenga_1&quot;
    table = &quot;play_table&quot;
    check, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;touching_part&quot;, &quot;a&quot;: block, &quot;b&quot;: table})
    assert check(env)
    monkeypatch.setattr(predicates, &quot;_contact_body_pairs&quot;, lambda _env: iter(()))
    assert check(env)


def test_pose_within_lateral_limit_uses_reference_frame():
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    spec = dict(pred=&quot;pose_within&quot;, obj=&quot;part&quot;, rel_to=&quot;assembly&quot;, pos=[0, 0, 0],
                quat=[1, 0, 0, 0], pos_tol=0.005, pos_tol_xy=0.0006,
                rot_tol_deg=6, sym=2)
    rotation = R.from_euler(&quot;y&quot;, 60, degrees=True)
    ref = SimpleNamespace(xpos=np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.4]), xmat=rotation.as_matrix(),
                          xquat=rotation.as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]])

    def at(offset, angle=0):
        orient = rotation * R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, angle, degrees=True)
        part = SimpleNamespace(xpos=ref.xpos + ref.xmat @ np.asarray(offset),
                               xmat=orient.as_matrix(), xquat=orient.as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]])
        return SimpleNamespace(data=SimpleNamespace(body=lambda name: ref if name == &quot;assembly&quot; else part))

    check = predicates._build(spec)
    assert check(at([0.00059, 0, 0.0012]))
    assert check(at([0, 0, 0.0049]))
    assert not check(at([0.00061, 0, 0]))
    assert not check(at([0.00045, 0.00045, 0]))
    assert not check(at([0, 0, 0.0051]))
    assert check(at([0, 0, 0], 5.9))
    assert not check(at([0, 0, 0], 6.1))
    assert check(at([0, 0, 0], 180))
    assert predicates._build({k: v for k, v in spec.items() if k != &quot;pos_tol_xy&quot;})(at([0.001, 0, 0]))


def test_fabrica_pose_within_axis_only_frees_the_spin():
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    spec = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;pose_within&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;part0&quot;, &quot;pos&quot;: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], &quot;quat&quot;: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
            &quot;pos_tol&quot;: 0.005, &quot;rot_tol_deg&quot;: 15, &quot;axis&quot;: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]}

    def env_with(quat):
        m = np.empty(9)
        mujoco.mju_quat2Mat(m, np.asarray(quat, float))
        body = SimpleNamespace(xquat=np.asarray(quat, float), xmat=m, xpos=np.zeros(3))
        return SimpleNamespace(data=SimpleNamespace(body=lambda name: body), model=None)

    spin = R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, 90, degrees=True).as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]
    tilt = R.from_euler(&quot;x&quot;, 30, degrees=True).as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]
    check = predicates._build(spec)
    assert check(env_with([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])) is True
    assert check(env_with(spin)) is True
    assert check(env_with(tilt)) is False
    assert predicates._build({**spec, &quot;axis&quot;: None})(env_with(spin)) is False
    assert &quot;spin free&quot; in predicates.describe({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [spec]})[1][1]
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/bottles_in_bin/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of bottles in bin.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask

BOTTLES = [&#x27;bottle_slot_a&#x27;, &#x27;bottle_slot_b&#x27;, &#x27;bottle_slot_c&#x27;, &#x27;bottle_slot_d&#x27;]


def count_in_bin(s):
    return sum(s.in_site_box(obj=b, site=&#x27;bin_inside&#x27;, size=[0.12, 0.12, 0.105]) for b in BOTTLES)


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;1 bottle in the bin&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_bin(s) &gt;= 1),
        Subtask(&#x27;2 bottles in the bin&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_bin(s) &gt;= 2),
        Subtask(&#x27;3 bottles in the bin&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_bin(s) &gt;= 3),
        Subtask(&#x27;4 bottles in the bin&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.success()),
    ]
</pre></details>
<details><summary><code>tasks/bottles_in_bin/test.py</code> (3 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the bottles_in_bin task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from core.tasks import CATEGORY_REAL_WORLD, TASKS
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from helpers import (
    set_free_body,
    zero_free_qvel,
)


def test_spd_bottle_randomization_materials_and_contact_are_explicit():
    pack = TASKS / &quot;bottles_in_bin&quot;
    spec = json.loads((pack / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())
    bottles = [f&quot;bottle_slot_{letter}&quot; for letter in &quot;abcd&quot;]
    rnd = spec[&quot;randomization&quot;]

    assert spec[&quot;category&quot;] == CATEGORY_REAL_WORLD
    assert spec[&quot;metadata&quot;][&quot;bottles&quot;] == {
        &quot;container&quot;: &quot;500 ml PET bottle&quot;,
        &quot;fill_state&quot;: &quot;about one-quarter full&quot;,
        &quot;mass_kg&quot;: 0.124,
    }
    assert rnd[&quot;full_rand&quot;] is True
    assert rnd[&quot;groups&quot;] == [[&quot;bin_slot&quot;], *[[bottle] for bottle in bottles]]
    assert rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;] == {&quot;bin_slot&quot;: [{&quot;x&quot;: [0.725, 0.925], &quot;y&quot;: [-0.10, 0.10],
                                                      &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-180, 180]}]}
    assert rnd[&quot;lift_reach&quot;] == {bottle: 0.12 for bottle in bottles}

    root = ET.parse(pack / &quot;scene.xml&quot;).getroot()
    collisions = [default.find(&quot;geom&quot;) for default in root.iter(&quot;default&quot;)
                  if (default.get(&quot;class&quot;) or &quot;&quot;).startswith(&quot;bottle_slot_&quot;)
                  and default.get(&quot;class&quot;).endswith(&quot;__collision&quot;)]
    assert len(collisions) == 4
    assert all(geom is not None and geom.get(&quot;priority&quot;) == &quot;2&quot;
               and geom.get(&quot;condim&quot;) == &quot;6&quot;
               and geom.get(&quot;friction&quot;) == &quot;0.5 0.005 0&quot;
               for geom in collisions)
    pairs = root.findall(&quot;contact/pair&quot;)
    assert len(pairs) == 338 and all(pair.get(&quot;solref&quot;) == &quot;0.004 0.5&quot; and pair.get(&quot;condim&quot;) == &quot;6&quot;
                                     and pair.get(&quot;friction&quot;) == &quot;0.5 0.5 0.005 0.001 0.001&quot;
                                     and pair.get(&quot;geom1&quot;).startswith(&quot;bottle_slot_&quot;)
                                     and (pair.get(&quot;geom2&quot;) == &quot;table_plane&quot; or pair.get(&quot;geom2&quot;).startswith(&quot;bin_col&quot;))
                                     for pair in pairs)

    bodies = {body.get(&quot;name&quot;): body for body in root.iter(&quot;body&quot;) if body.get(&quot;name&quot;)}
    materials = {material.get(&quot;name&quot;): material for material in root.iter(&quot;material&quot;)}
    assigned = []
    rgba = []
    for bottle in bottles:
        visuals = [geom for geom in bodies[bottle + &quot;__object&quot;].findall(&quot;geom&quot;)
                   if geom.get(&quot;type&quot;) == &quot;mesh&quot; and geom.get(&quot;group&quot;) == &quot;1&quot;
                   and (geom.get(&quot;mesh&quot;) or &quot;&quot;).startswith(bottle + &quot;__model_normalized_&quot;)]
        names = {geom.get(&quot;material&quot;) for geom in visuals}
        assert len(names) == 1
        name = names.pop()
        assert name.startswith(bottle + &quot;__opaque_&quot;)
        material = materials[name]
        color = [float(value) for value in material.get(&quot;rgba&quot;).split()]
        assert color[3] == 1.0
        assert float(material.get(&quot;specular&quot;)) &lt;= 0.15
        assert float(material.get(&quot;shininess&quot;)) &lt;= 0.10
        assigned.append(name)
        rgba.append(tuple(color))
    assert len(set(assigned)) == len(bottles)
    assert len(set(rgba)) == len(bottles)


def test_in_site_box_rejects_robot_contact_with_child_body(monkeypatch):
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bottles_in_bin&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    leaf = env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;of&quot;][0]
    obj = leaf[&quot;obj&quot;]
    set_free_body(env, obj, env.data.site(leaf[&quot;site&quot;]).xpos)
    zero_free_qvel(env, obj)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)

    root = env.model.body(obj).id
    child = env.model.body(obj + &quot;__object&quot;).id
    assert env.model.body_rootid[child] == root
    finger = next(iter(env.finger_roots(env.arms[0])))
    monkeypatch.setattr(env, &quot;contact_body_pairs&quot;, lambda: [(finger, child)])
    assert env.robot_clear([obj]) is False

    check, _ = make_checker(leaf)
    assert check(env) is False
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/bowl_on_plate/test.py</code> (12 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the bowl_on_plate task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np
from core.grade_episode import _bbox_world
from helpers import (
    Episode,
    project,
)
import pytest
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from core.tasks import TASKS
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from helpers import (  # noqa: F401 (lift_env is a fixture)
    BOWL,
    PLATE,
    lift_env,
    set_free_body,
    settle_steps,
    zero_free_qvel,
)
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.grade_episode import _footprint_hull, _hull_contains_xy


pytestmark = pytest.mark.e2e


BOWL = &quot;akita_black_bowl_1_main&quot;


PLATE = &quot;plate_1_main&quot;


def _grasp_bowl_rim(ep):
    env, ui, k = ep.env, ep.ui, ep.k
    bowl = k.object_poses()[BOWL]
    grasp = bowl + [0, 0.06, 0.04]
    u, v = project(env, &quot;ring1&quot;, grasp)
    pt = ui.gripper_teleport_via_click(&quot;ring1&quot;, u, v)
    ui.gripper_translate(*(grasp - pt))
    print(f&quot;  click ({u},{v}) -&gt; 3D {np.round(pt, 3)} (bowl {np.round(bowl, 3)})&quot;)
    ep.do(&quot;teleport above bowl rim&quot;)
    ui.gripper_advance_or_retreat(0.10)
    ep.do(&quot;descend to rim&quot;)
    ui.gripper_toggle()
    ep.do(&quot;close gripper&quot;)
    assert 0.002 &lt; env.gripper_width() &lt; 0.06, f&quot;grasp missed (width {env.gripper_width():.3f})&quot;
    return bowl


def test_bowl_grasp_and_lift():
    print(&quot;=== bowl grasp and lift (default interface) ===&quot;)
    ep = Episode(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env, ui = ep.env, ep.ui

    start_z = float(_grasp_bowl_rim(ep)[2])
    ui.gripper_translate(0, 0, 0.15)
    ep.do(&quot;lift&quot;)

    assert env.data.body(BOWL).xpos[2] - start_z &gt; 0.10
    assert not make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])[0](env) and not env.episode_over
    ep.save_video(&quot;bowl_grasp_and_lift&quot;)
    print(f&quot;  PASS: physical lift completed in {env.num_step} steps\n&quot;)


def test_bowl_on_plate():
    print(&quot;=== bowl on plate (default interface) ===&quot;)
    ep = Episode(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env, ui, k = ep.env, ep.ui, ep.k

    bowl = k.object_poses()[BOWL]
    bowl_bottom_offset = float(bowl[2] - _bbox_world(env, BOWL)[:, 2].min())
    _grasp_bowl_rim(ep)
    ui.gripper_translate(0, 0, 0.15)
    ep.do(&quot;lift&quot;)
    held_offset = k.object_poses()[BOWL] - k.proprio().eef_pos
    plate = k.object_poses()[PLATE]
    plate_top = float(_bbox_world(env, PLATE)[:, 2].max())
    target_body = np.array([plate[0], plate[1], plate_top + bowl_bottom_offset + 0.002])
    ui.target_pos = np.array([plate[0] - held_offset[0], plate[1] - held_offset[1],
                              ui.target_pos[2]])
    ep.do(&quot;carry over plate&quot;)
    ui.target_pos = target_body - held_offset
    ep.do(&quot;lower onto plate&quot;)
    ui.gripper_toggle()
    ep.do(&quot;open&quot;)

    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])[0](env), &quot;bowl on plate did not succeed&quot;
    ep.save_video(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;)
    print(f&quot;  PASS: steps={env.num_step}\n&quot;)


def test_bowl_on_plate_success_tree():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    check, hold = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])
    assert hold == 1
    assert check(env) is False

    plate = env.data.body(PLATE).xpos.copy()
    set_free_body(env, BOWL, plate + [0, 0, 0.12])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False

    set_free_body(env, BOWL, plate + [0, 0, 0.05])
    zero_free_qvel(env, BOWL)
    for _ in range(settle_steps(env, 0.6)):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True


def test_libero_on_success_tree():
    if not (TASKS / &quot;bowl_on_plate&quot; / &quot;task.json&quot;).exists():
        pytest.skip(&quot;libero/bowl_on_plate pack not materialized&quot;)
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    check, hold = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])
    assert hold == 1 and check(env) is False

    plate = env.data.body(&quot;plate_1_main&quot;).xpos.copy()
    set_free_body(env, &quot;akita_black_bowl_1_main&quot;, plate + [0, 0, 0.05])
    zero_free_qvel(env, &quot;akita_black_bowl_1_main&quot;)
    for _ in range(settle_steps(env, 0.6)):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True


def _set_body_rot(env, name, rot: R, pos=(0.0, 0.0, 0.9)):
    qadr = env.model.joint(env.model.body(name).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
    env.data.qpos[qadr : qadr + 3] = pos
    q = rot.as_quat()
    env.data.qpos[qadr + 3 : qadr + 7] = [q[3], q[0], q[1], q[2]]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)


def _seq_lift_spec(**extra):
    return {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;sequence&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;lift_above&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_above&quot;: 1.0},
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;z_below&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_below&quot;: 0.85},
    ], **extra}


def _step(check, env, z):
    set_free_body(env, BOWL, [0, 0, z])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    return check(env)


def test_lift_above_threshold(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    lift = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;lift_above&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_above&quot;: 1.0}
    check, hold = make_checker(lift)
    assert hold == 1
    z = lift[&quot;z_above&quot;]
    for cube_z, expect in ((z - 0.02, False), (z, False), (z + 0.001, True)):
        set_free_body(env, BOWL, [0, 0, cube_z])
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        assert check(env) is expect, f&quot;cube z={cube_z} vs threshold {z}&quot;


def test_unknown_pred_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;definitely_not_a_pred&quot;})


def test_axis_up_is_direction_sensitive():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    obj = env._free_objects[0]
    up = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: obj, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 10})[0]
    down = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: obj, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, -1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 10})[0]

    _set_body_rot(env, obj, R.identity())
    assert up(env) is True and down(env) is False

    _set_body_rot(env, obj, R.from_euler(&quot;x&quot;, 180, degrees=True))
    assert up(env) is False and down(env) is True

    _set_body_rot(env, obj, R.from_euler(&quot;x&quot;, 9, degrees=True))
    assert up(env) is True
    _set_body_rot(env, obj, R.from_euler(&quot;x&quot;, 11, degrees=True))
    assert up(env) is False

    _set_body_rot(env, obj, R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, 90, degrees=True))
    assert up(env) is True


def test_gripper_open_fraction():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    check = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;gripper_open&quot;, &quot;min&quot;: 0.8})[0]
    assert check(env) is True

    for qa in env._finger_qadr[env.arms[0]]:
        env.data.qpos[qa] = 0.005
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_hull_contains_xy_is_oriented():
    sq = np.array([[-1, -1], [1, -1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]], float)
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(sq), (0.0, 0.0)) is True
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(sq), (0.99, 0.99)) is True
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(sq), (1.01, 0.0)) is False
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(sq), (1.0, 0.0)) is True

    c, s = np.cos(np.pi / 4), np.sin(np.pi / 4)
    diamond = sq @ np.array([[c, -s], [s, c]]).T
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(diamond), (0.0, 0.0)) is True
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(diamond), (1.3, 0.0)) is True
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(diamond), (0.9, 0.9)) is False
    assert _hull_contains_xy(_footprint_hull(np.array([[0, 0], [1, 1]], float)), (0.5, 0.5)) is False


def test_in_bbox_and_depth_in():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    a, b = env._free_objects[0], env._free_objects[1]
    box_b = _bbox_world(env, b)
    bx, by = box_b[:, 0].mean(), box_b[:, 1].mean()
    b_top, b_bot = box_b[:, 2].max(), box_b[:, 2].min()

    inb = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;in_bbox&quot;, &quot;a&quot;: a, &quot;b&quot;: b})[0]
    set_free_body(env, a, [bx, by, b_top + 0.02])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert inb(env) is True
    set_free_body(env, a, [bx + 0.5, by, b_top + 0.02])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert inb(env) is False
    set_free_body(env, a, [bx, by, b_bot - 0.05])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert inb(env) is False

    deep = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;depth_in&quot;, &quot;a&quot;: a, &quot;b&quot;: b, &quot;z_threshold&quot;: 0.01})[0]
    set_free_body(env, a, [bx, by, b_top + 0.10])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert deep(env) is False
    set_free_body(env, a, [bx, by, b_bot])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert deep(env) is True


def test_sequence_requires_the_stages_in_order(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, hold = make_checker(_seq_lift_spec())
    assert hold == 1
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is False
    assert _step(check, env, 1.05) is False
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is True
    assert _step(check, env, 1.05) is False
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is True


def test_sequence_rejects_the_end_state_alone(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, _ = make_checker(_seq_lift_spec())
    for _ in range(5):
        assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is False


def test_sequence_resets_between_episodes(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, _ = make_checker(_seq_lift_spec())
    _step(check, env, 1.05)
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is True
    check, _ = make_checker(_seq_lift_spec())
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is False


def test_sequence_invariant_kills_progress_for_good(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    spec = _seq_lift_spec(
        invariant={&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;not&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;z_below&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL,
                                         &quot;z_below&quot;: 0.5}})
    check, _ = make_checker(spec)
    assert _step(check, env, 1.05) is False
    for _ in range(5):
        assert _step(check, env, 0.2) is False
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is False
    check, _ = make_checker(spec)
    assert _step(check, env, 1.05) is False and _step(check, env, 0.83) is True
    check, _ = make_checker(spec)
    assert _step(check, env, 1.05) is False
    for _ in range(4):
        assert _step(check, env, 0.2) is False
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is True


def test_sequence_advances_one_stage_per_step(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;sequence&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;z_below&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_below&quot;: 0.9},
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;z_below&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_below&quot;: 0.9},
    ]})
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is False
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83) is True


def test_sequence_stage_hold_requires_consecutive_steps(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;sequence&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;lift_above&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_above&quot;: 1.0, &quot;hold&quot;: 3},
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;z_below&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: BOWL, &quot;z_below&quot;: 0.85},
    ]})
    assert not _step(check, env, 1.05)
    assert not _step(check, env, 1.05)
    assert not _step(check, env, 0.83)
    assert check.at == 0 and check.streak == 0
    assert not _step(check, env, 1.05)
    assert not _step(check, env, 1.05)
    assert not _step(check, env, 1.05)
    assert check.at == 1 and check.streak == 0
    assert _step(check, env, 0.83)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;hold&quot;, [0, -1, 1.5, True])
def test_sequence_stage_hold_must_be_a_positive_integer(hold):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=&quot;positive integer&quot;):
        make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;sequence&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [
            {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;never&quot;, &quot;hold&quot;: hold},
        ]})


def test_grading_state_rewinds_with_the_scene(lift_env):
    env = lift_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    env._check = make_checker(_seq_lift_spec())[0]
    _step(env._check, env, 0.83)
    saved = env.checkpoint()
    assert _step(env._check, env, 1.05) is False
    env.restore(saved)
    assert _step(env._check, env, 0.83) is False


def test_describe_state_rows_align_and_turn_true_on_the_solved_scene():
    from core.grade_episode import describe, describe_state
    env = SimEnv(&quot;bowl_on_plate&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    spec = env.spec[&quot;success&quot;]
    before = describe_state(spec, env)
    assert len(before) == len(describe(spec))
    assert before[0] is False
    plate = env.data.body(PLATE).xpos.copy()
    set_free_body(env, BOWL, plate + [0, 0, 0.05])
    zero_free_qvel(env, BOWL)
    for _ in range(settle_steps(env, 0.6)):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)
    after = describe_state(spec, env)
    assert after[0] is True and all(v is True for v in after if v is not None)

## cooling manifold

Several loose parts lie on the table, but only one belongs to this assembly. Identify the piece missing from the partially assembled symmetric structure, pick it up, and add it to the structure. Then let go and draw the arm back.

<details><summary><code>tasks/cooling_manifold/test.py</code> (11 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the cooling_manifold task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from pathlib import Path
import mujoco
import numpy as np
import pytest
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.grade_episode import _grasped_by
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from helpers import (
    _probe_ik,
    _table_top_z,
)
from core.grade_episode import make_checker


GRIP_TASK = &quot;cooling_manifold&quot;


PIECE = &quot;part5&quot;


GRIP_SPAWNS_X_Y_YAW = [(0.06, -0.12, 0.0), (0.12, 0.08, 0.6), (-0.04, 0.14, -1.1)]


GRIP_CASES = [(GRIP_TASK, PIECE)]


GRIP_POSES = 8


GRIP_SETTLE = 60


JAW_SPINS_DEG = [20, 40, 60, 90]


JAW_SPIN_MAX_DEV_M = 0.030


def _piece_qadr(env, piece):
    return env.model.joint(env.model.body(piece).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]


def _spawn_piece(env, piece, x, y, yaw):
    adr = _piece_qadr(env, piece)
    env.data.qpos[adr:adr + 3] = [x, y, _table_top_z(env) + 0.0175]
    env.data.qpos[adr + 3:adr + 7] = R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, yaw).as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]
    env.data.qvel[:] = 0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    for _ in range(GRIP_SETTLE):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)


def _jaw_axis_yaw(env, arm):
    a, b = (env.data.body(f&quot;{arm}_{side}_finger&quot;).xpos for side in (&quot;left&quot;, &quot;right&quot;))
    return float(np.arctan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]))


def _grasp_piece(env, arm, piece):
    home = env.observe_proprio(arm)
    p = env.data.body(piece).xpos.copy()
    yaw = R.from_quat(env.data.body(piece).xquat[[1, 2, 3, 0]]).as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;)[2]
    delta = (yaw + np.pi / 2) - _jaw_axis_yaw(env, arm)
    grasp_rot = R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, delta) * R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, home.eef_euler)
    e = grasp_rot.as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;)
    above, at = p + [0, 0, 0.12], p.copy()
    env.move_to(above, e, 1.0)
    env.move_to(at, e, 1.0)
    env.move_to(at, e, 0.0)
    env.move_to(p + [0, 0, 0.10], e, 0.0)
    return e


def test_contact_retry_exemption_requires_closed_grasp():
    env = SimEnv(task=GRIP_TASK, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    _spawn_piece(env, PIECE, *GRIP_SPAWNS_X_Y_YAW[0])
    _grasp_piece(env, arm, PIECE)
    assert _grasped_by(env, PIECE, arm)

    payload = {int(g) for g in env._obj_geoms[PIECE]}
    assert env.ctl._held_payload_geoms(arm) == payload

    env.curr_gripper_open[arm] = 1
    assert env.ctl._held_payload_geoms(arm) == set()


def run_grip_trial(spawn, case=None, n_poses=GRIP_POSES, seed=0, verbose=False):
    task, piece = case or (GRIP_TASK, PIECE)
    x, y, yaw = spawn
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    env = SimEnv(task=task, seed=seed)
    env.reset(seed=seed, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    _spawn_piece(env, piece, x, y, yaw)
    _grasp_piece(env, arm, piece)
    if not _grasped_by(env, piece, arm):
        return {&quot;spawn&quot;: spawn, &quot;grasped&quot;: False, &quot;lost_at&quot;: None, &quot;flown&quot;: 0,
                &quot;rot&quot;: [], &quot;unreachable&quot;: 0}

    table_z = _table_top_z(env)
    flown, rots, unreachable = 0, [], 0
    for i in range(n_poses):
        here = env.observe_proprio(arm)
        for _ in range(40):
            pos = np.empty(3)
            pos[:2] = here.eef_pos[:2] + rng.uniform(-0.12, 0.12, 2)
            pos[2] = rng.uniform(table_z + 0.12, table_z + 0.40)
            rot = (R.from_rotvec(rng.uniform(-1, 1, 3) * [0.6, 0.6, np.pi / 2])
                   * R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, here.eef_euler))
            if _probe_ik(env, arm, pos, rot, env.data.qpos[env.ik[arm].qadr].copy(),
                         ignore=(piece,)) is not None:
                break
        else:
            unreachable += 1
            continue
        turn = float(np.degrees(np.linalg.norm(
            (rot * R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, here.eef_euler).inv()).as_rotvec())))
        env.move_to(pos, rot.as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;), 0.0)
        flown += 1
        rots.append(turn)
        if verbose:
            print(f&quot;    pose #{i}: turned {turn:5.1f} deg  &quot;
                  f&quot;held={_grasped_by(env, piece, arm)}&quot;)
        if not _grasped_by(env, piece, arm):
            return {&quot;spawn&quot;: spawn, &quot;grasped&quot;: True, &quot;lost_at&quot;: i, &quot;flown&quot;: flown,
                    &quot;rot&quot;: rots, &quot;unreachable&quot;: unreachable, &quot;lost_after_deg&quot;: turn}
    return {&quot;spawn&quot;: spawn, &quot;grasped&quot;: True, &quot;lost_at&quot;: None, &quot;flown&quot;: flown,
            &quot;rot&quot;: rots, &quot;unreachable&quot;: unreachable}


def _jaw_offset(env, arm, piece):
    a, b = (env.data.body(f&quot;{arm}_{side}_finger&quot;).xpos for side in (&quot;left&quot;, &quot;right&quot;))
    return float(np.linalg.norm(env.data.body(piece).xpos - (a + b) / 2))


class _Excursion:
    def __init__(self, env, arm, at):
        self.env, self.arm, self.at, self.max_dev = env, arm, at, 0.0

    def record(self, *a, **k):
        p = self.env.observe_proprio(self.arm).eef_pos
        self.max_dev = max(self.max_dev, float(np.linalg.norm(p - self.at)))


def run_jaw_spin_trial(spawn, case=None, angles=JAW_SPINS_DEG, seed=0, verbose=False):
    task, piece = case or (GRIP_TASK, PIECE)
    x, y, yaw = spawn
    env = SimEnv(task=task, seed=seed)
    env.reset(seed=seed, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    _spawn_piece(env, piece, x, y, yaw)
    _grasp_piece(env, arm, piece)
    if not _grasped_by(env, piece, arm):
        return {&quot;spawn&quot;: spawn, &quot;grasped&quot;: False, &quot;results&quot;: []}

    here = env.observe_proprio(arm)
    env.move_to(here.eef_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15]), here.eef_euler, 0.0)
    at = env.observe_proprio(arm).eef_pos.copy()
    base = _jaw_offset(env, arm, piece)
    out = []
    carry = env.observe_proprio(arm).eef_euler.copy()
    for deg in angles:
        if not np.allclose(env.observe_proprio(arm).eef_euler, carry, atol=1e-3):
            env.move_to(at, carry, 0.0)
        a, b = (env.data.body(f&quot;{arm}_{side}_finger&quot;).xpos for side in (&quot;left&quot;, &quot;right&quot;))
        axis = (b - a) / np.linalg.norm(b - a)
        rot = R.from_rotvec(axis * np.radians(deg)) * R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, carry)
        if _probe_ik(env, arm, at, rot, env.data.qpos[env.ik[arm].qadr].copy(),
                     ignore=(piece,), check_path=False) is None:
            out.append({&quot;deg&quot;: deg, &quot;held&quot;: _grasped_by(env, piece, arm), &quot;slip_mm&quot;: 0.0,
                        &quot;dev_mm&quot;: 0.0, &quot;unreachable&quot;: True})
            continue
        probe = _Excursion(env, arm, at)
        observe = env.observe
        env.observe = lambda *a, **k: {}
        try:
            env.move_to(at, rot.as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;), 0.0, recorder=probe)
        finally:
            env.observe = observe
        held = _grasped_by(env, piece, arm)
        slip = _jaw_offset(env, arm, piece) - base
        out.append({&quot;deg&quot;: deg, &quot;held&quot;: held, &quot;slip_mm&quot;: slip * 1000,
                    &quot;dev_mm&quot;: probe.max_dev * 1000})
        if verbose:
            print(f&quot;    spin {deg:+4d} deg -&gt; held={held}  slip {slip * 1000:+6.1f} mm  &quot;
                  f&quot;eef wandered {probe.max_dev * 1000:6.1f} mm&quot;)
        if not held:
            break
    return {&quot;spawn&quot;: spawn, &quot;grasped&quot;: True, &quot;results&quot;: out}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;case&quot;, GRIP_CASES, ids=lambda c: c[1])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;spawn&quot;, GRIP_SPAWNS_X_Y_YAW, ids=lambda s: f&quot;xy{s[0]}_{s[1]}&quot;)
def test_held_piece_survives_jaw_axis_rotation(spawn, case):
    r = run_jaw_spin_trial(spawn, case)
    assert r[&quot;grasped&quot;], f&quot;heuristic grasp failed at spawn {spawn} — nothing to test&quot;
    lost = [x for x in r[&quot;results&quot;] if not x[&quot;held&quot;]]
    assert not lost, (
        f&quot;piece spun out of the jaws at {lost[0][&#x27;deg&#x27;]} deg about the opening axis &quot;
        f&quot;(slip {lost[0][&#x27;slip_mm&#x27;]:.0f} mm); trace: &quot;
        + &quot;, &quot;.join(f&quot;{x[&#x27;deg&#x27;]:+d}deg slip {x[&#x27;slip_mm&#x27;]:+.0f}mm&quot; for x in r[&quot;results&quot;]))


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;case&quot;, GRIP_CASES, ids=lambda c: c[1])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;spawn&quot;, GRIP_SPAWNS_X_Y_YAW, ids=lambda s: f&quot;xy{s[0]}_{s[1]}&quot;)
def test_in_place_rotation_stays_in_place(spawn, case):
    r = run_jaw_spin_trial(spawn, case)
    assert r[&quot;grasped&quot;], f&quot;heuristic grasp failed at spawn {spawn} — nothing to test&quot;
    bad = [x for x in r[&quot;results&quot;] if x[&quot;dev_mm&quot;] &gt; JAW_SPIN_MAX_DEV_M * 1000]
    assert not bad, (
        f&quot;&#x27;rotate in place&#x27; moved the gripper {bad[0][&#x27;dev_mm&#x27;]:.0f} mm at &quot;
        f&quot;{bad[0][&#x27;deg&#x27;]} deg (cap {JAW_SPIN_MAX_DEV_M * 1000:.0f} mm); trace: &quot;
        + &quot;, &quot;.join(f&quot;{x[&#x27;deg&#x27;]:+d}deg {x[&#x27;dev_mm&#x27;]:.0f}mm&quot; for x in r[&quot;results&quot;]))


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;case&quot;, GRIP_CASES, ids=lambda c: c[1])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;spawn&quot;, GRIP_SPAWNS_X_Y_YAW, ids=lambda s: f&quot;xy{s[0]}_{s[1]}&quot;)
def test_held_piece_survives_random_poses(spawn, case):
    r = run_grip_trial(spawn, case)
    assert r[&quot;grasped&quot;], f&quot;heuristic grasp failed at spawn {spawn} — nothing to test&quot;
    assert r[&quot;flown&quot;] &gt;= GRIP_POSES // 2, (
        f&quot;only {r[&#x27;flown&#x27;]}/{GRIP_POSES} poses were reachable while carrying the piece &quot;
        f&quot;({r[&#x27;unreachable&#x27;]} rejected) — the trial proved nothing&quot;)
    assert r[&quot;lost_at&quot;] is None, (
        f&quot;piece left the jaws at pose #{r[&#x27;lost_at&#x27;]} of {r[&#x27;flown&#x27;]} &quot;
        f&quot;(that pose turned the wrist {r.get(&#x27;lost_after_deg&#x27;, 0):.0f} deg; &quot;
        f&quot;rotations flown: {[round(x) for x in r[&#x27;rot&#x27;]]})&quot;)


@pytest.fixture(scope=&quot;module&quot;)
def states():
    return np.load(Path(__file__).parent / &quot;manifold_contact_states.npz&quot;)


def test_socket_pairs_preserve_gripper_contacts(states):
    env = SimEnv(&quot;cooling_manifold&quot;)
    m, d = env.model, env.data
    cap, socket = m.body(&quot;part5&quot;).id, m.body(&quot;part1&quot;).id
    assert m.npair &gt; 0
    for g1, g2 in zip(m.pair_geom1, m.pair_geom2):
        assert {int(m.geom_bodyid[g1]), int(m.geom_bodyid[g2])} == {cap, socket}
    np.testing.assert_allclose(m.pair_friction[:, 2], .002)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(m.geom_friction[m.geom_bodyid == cap, 1][1:], .3)
    env.reset_to_sim_state(states[&quot;grasp&quot;])
    mujoco.mj_step(m, d, nstep=round(.2 / m.opt.timestep))
    touched = set()
    for c in d.contact:
        b1, b2 = m.geom_bodyid[[c.geom1, c.geom2]]
        if cap not in (b1, b2):
            continue
        other = int(b2 if b1 == cap else b1)
        if other == socket or env.finger_root(other) is not None:
            touched.add(m.body(other).name)
            expected = .002 if other == socket else .3
            np.testing.assert_allclose(c.friction, [.6, .6, expected, .0001, .0001])
            np.testing.assert_allclose(c.solref, [.004, 1])
            np.testing.assert_allclose(c.solimp[:2], [.998, .998])
    assert touched == {&quot;part1&quot;, &quot;robot0_left_finger&quot;, &quot;robot0_right_finger&quot;}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;torsion,passes&quot;, [(.3, True), (.002, True)])
def test_recorded_cap_seats_after_release(states, torsion, passes):
    env = SimEnv(&quot;cooling_manifold&quot;)
    env.model.pair_friction[:, 2] = torsion
    env.reset_to_sim_state(states[&quot;released&quot;])
    mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data, nstep=round(2 / env.model.opt.timestep))
    assert bool(make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])[0](env)) == passes
    ref, cap = env.data.body(&quot;part1&quot;), env.data.body(&quot;part5&quot;)
    delta = ref.xmat.reshape(3, 3).T @ (cap.xpos - ref.xpos)
    height_error = delta[2] - env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;of&quot;][0][&quot;pos&quot;][2]
    assert abs(height_error) &lt; .001 if passes else height_error &gt; .008

&quot;cup_slot_c&quot;, &quot;cup_slot_e&quot;]}]}
PAIR_MAX_XY_M = 0.12


def bases(s):
    return {body for body, spec in BASES.items() if s.tree(spec)}


def close_pair(s, valid):
    return any(a in valid and b in valid and s.within_dist(a=a, b=b, axes=&quot;xy&quot;, tol=PAIR_MAX_XY_M) for a, b in combinations(BASES, 2))


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick a cup and place it upside down on the table&#x27;, lambda s: bool(bases(s)) or s.tree(TOP)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick a cup and place it upside down next to the previous cup&#x27;, lambda s: close_pair(s, bases(s)) or s.tree(TOP)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick a cup and place it upside down on top of the two, touching both&#x27;, lambda s: s.success()),
    ]

import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import mujoco
import numpy as np
import pytest
from core.tasks import TASKS, load_scene
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
    set_free_body,
    zero_free_qvel,
)


def test_spd_speed_stacks_pack_is_three_randomized_red_cups():
    pack = TASKS / &quot;cup_pyramid&quot;
    spec = json.loads((pack / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())
    cups = [&quot;cup_slot_b&quot;, &quot;cup_slot_c&quot;, &quot;cup_slot_e&quot;]
    assert spec[&quot;category&quot;] == &quot;game&quot;
    assert spec[&quot;objects&quot;] == cups
    assert spec[&quot;termination&quot;][&quot;max_len&quot;] == 5000
    assert spec[&quot;language&quot;] == &quot;Turn the three cups upside down and build a pyramid.&quot;
    assert spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;hold&quot; and spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;steps&quot;] == 20
    assert not any(dash in spec[&quot;language&quot;] for dash in (&quot;\u2013&quot;, &quot;\u2014&quot;, &quot; -- &quot;))

    rnd = spec[&quot;randomization&quot;]
    assert rnd[&quot;full_rand&quot;] is True
    assert rnd[&quot;groups&quot;] == [[cup] for cup in cups]
    assert rnd[&quot;lift_reach&quot;] == {cup: 0.14 for cup in cups}
    assert &quot;placement_regions&quot; not in rnd
    rim_diameter = 2 * 0.0431538
    assert rnd[&quot;min_sep&quot;] == [
        [cups[i], cups[j], rim_diameter]
        for i in range(len(cups)) for j in range(i + 1, len(cups))
    ]
    assert rnd[&quot;grasp_clearance&quot;] == 0.02

    root = ET.parse(pack / &quot;scene.xml&quot;).getroot()
    starts = {
        &quot;cup_slot_b&quot;: (&quot;0.71783 -0.50314 0.83861&quot;,
                       &quot;0.38060 0.00003 -0.00004 -0.92474&quot;),
        &quot;cup_slot_c&quot;: (&quot;0.74727 -0.20242 0.83861&quot;,
                       &quot;0.99901 0.00005 0.00001 -0.04448&quot;),
        &quot;cup_slot_e&quot;: (&quot;0.63930 0.50417 0.83861&quot;,
                       &quot;0.33893 0.00001 0.00005 0.94081&quot;),
    }
    for cup, (expected_pos, expected_quat) in starts.items():
        body = next(body for body in root.find(&quot;worldbody&quot;).iter(&quot;body&quot;)
                    if body.get(&quot;name&quot;) == cup)
        assert body.get(&quot;pos&quot;) == expected_pos
        assert body.get(&quot;quat&quot;) == expected_quat
        material = next(material for material in root.find(&quot;asset&quot;).iter(&quot;material&quot;)
                        if material.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(cup + &quot;__&quot;))
        assert &quot;texture&quot; not in material.attrib
        assert material.get(&quot;rgba&quot;) == &quot;0.80 0.08 0.08 1&quot;
        assert material.get(&quot;specular&quot;) == &quot;0.05&quot;

    model = load_scene(pack).compile()
    for cup in cups:
        root_id = model.body(cup).id
        subtree = []
        for body_id in range(model.nbody):
            ancestor = body_id
            while ancestor and ancestor != root_id:
                ancestor = int(model.body_parentid[ancestor])
            if ancestor == root_id:
                subtree.append(body_id)
        assert sum(float(model.body_mass[body_id]) for body_id in subtree) == pytest.approx(0.050)
        collision_geoms = [gid for gid in range(model.ngeom)
                           if int(model.geom_bodyid[gid]) in subtree
                           and int(model.geom_group[gid]) == 3
                           and int(model.geom_contype[gid]) != 0]
        assert collision_geoms
        assert all(np.allclose(model.geom_solref[gid], [0.004, 1.0])
                   and int(model.geom_priority[gid]) == 1
                   and np.allclose(model.geom_solimp[gid][:2], [0.998, 0.998])
                   for gid in collision_geoms)

    success = spec[&quot;success&quot;]
    assert success[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;hold&quot; and success[&quot;steps&quot;] == 20
    assert any(node[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;robot_clear&quot; and node[&quot;bodies&quot;] == cups
               for node in success[&quot;of&quot;][&quot;of&quot;])

    env = SimEnv(&quot;cup_pyramid&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=True)
    for cup in cups:
        pos = env.data.body(cup).xpos.copy()
        assert cup not in env._placement_regions
        assert len(env.legal_cells([cup]))
        assert env._in_pc_crop([cup])
        assert any(env.reachable(pos, arm) for arm in env.arms)
        assert any(env.reachable(pos + [0, 0, rnd[&quot;lift_reach&quot;][cup]], arm)
                   for arm in env.arms)
        assert any(env.ctl.reaches(arm, pos, env._home_euler[arm])[0]
                   for arm in env.arms)
        assert env.data.body(cup).xmat.reshape(3, 3)[2, 2] &gt; 0.99


def test_spd_pyramid_needs_a_supported_arrangement_held_for_a_second():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;cup_pyramid&quot;)
    cups = [&quot;cup_slot_b&quot;, &quot;cup_slot_c&quot;, &quot;cup_slot_e&quot;]

    def put(body, pos):
        set_free_body(env, body, pos)
        qadr = env.model.joint(env.model.body(body).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
        env.data.qpos[qadr + 3:qadr + 7] = [0, 1, 0, 0]
        zero_free_qvel(env, body)

    check, hold = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])
    assert hold == 20
    assert check(env) is False
    for body, pos in zip(cups, ([0.70, 0.0, 0.87], [0.80, 0.0, 0.87],
                                [0.75, 0.0, 0.95])):
        put(body, pos)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    for _ in range(20):
        for _ in range(env._substeps):
            env._step_physics()
        assert check(env) is False

    for body, pos in zip(cups, ([0.70, 0.0, 0.839], [0.80, 0.0, 0.839],
                                [0.75, 0.0, 0.940])):
        put(body, pos)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True


def test_axis_dot_reads_orientation_and_abs_ignores_which_end():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    up, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_dot&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;cube_red&quot;, &quot;min_dot&quot;: 0.94})
    either, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_dot&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;cube_red&quot;, &quot;min_dot&quot;: 0.94, &quot;abs&quot;: True})
    flat, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_dot&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;cube_red&quot;, &quot;min_dot&quot;: 0.0,
                            &quot;max_dot&quot;: 0.15, &quot;abs&quot;: True})
    a = env._obj_qadr[&quot;cube_red&quot;]
    env.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert up(env) and either(env) and not flat(env)
    env.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [0, 1, 0, 0]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert not up(env) and either(env)
    env.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [0.7071, 0, 0.7071, 0]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert flat(env) and not either(env)

<details><summary><code>tasks/dual_stack/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of dual stack.

The task&#x27;s own success.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import Subtask
from core.grade_episode import _body_pos, _free_joint_qvel, _robot_touching


def dual_stack(base, greens, on_base_dz, dz_tol, xy_tol, same_level_tol, gripper_open_min, lin_vel_max, ang_vel_max):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;both {greens} resting on {base}, level within {same_level_tol} m, gripper open and clear&quot;&quot;&quot;
    blocks = [base, *greens]

    def on_base(gp, rp):
        return abs((gp[2] - rp[2]) - on_base_dz) &lt; dz_tol and np.linalg.norm(gp[:2] - rp[:2]) &lt; xy_tol

    def check(env):
        rp = _body_pos(env, base)
        gp = [_body_pos(env, g) for g in greens]
        if not all(on_base(p, rp) for p in gp) or abs(gp[0][2] - gp[1][2]) &gt;= same_level_tol:
            return False
        if env.gripper_width() &lt;= gripper_open_min or _robot_touching(env, blocks):
            return False
        for b in blocks:
            qv = _free_joint_qvel(env, b)
            if np.linalg.norm(qv[:3]) &gt; lin_vel_max or np.linalg.norm(qv[3:]) &gt; ang_vel_max:
                return False
        return True
    return check


def subtasks():
    return [Subtask(&#x27;Build a structure exactly two blocks tall: the blue block on the table, and BOTH green blocks resting directly on top of it, side by side at the same height&#x27;, lambda s: s.success())]
</pre></details>
<details><summary><code>tasks/dual_stack/test.py</code> (8 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the dual_stack task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from helpers import (
    Episode,
    project,
)
import pytest
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import hold_steps, make_checker
from helpers import (  # noqa: F401 (ds_env and goal_state are fixtures)
    ds_env,
    goal_state,
    set_free_body,
    zero_free_qvel,
)
from core.grade_episode import _robot_touching


pytestmark = pytest.mark.e2e


def _fold(deg, period=90.0):
    return (deg + period / 2) % period - period / 2


def _yaw_deg(env, body):
    q = env.data.body(body).xquat
    return R.from_quat([q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]]).as_euler(&quot;zyx&quot;, degrees=True)[0]


def pick_and_place(ep, green, place_xy, place_z, diamond_yaw, udir, pre_yaw=0):
    env, ui, k = ep.env, ep.ui, ep.k
    gp = k.object_poses()[green]
    u, v = project(env, &quot;agentview&quot;, gp + [0, 0, 0.025])
    ui.gripper_teleport_via_click(&quot;agentview&quot;, u, v)
    ep.do(f&quot;teleport above {green}&quot;)
    gyaw = _fold(_yaw_deg(env, green))
    grasp_rot = _fold(gyaw + pre_yaw, 180.0)
    if abs(grasp_rot) &gt; 0.5:
        ui.gripper_rotate(&quot;z&quot;, grasp_rot)
        ep.do(f&quot;pre-rotate {grasp_rot:.0f}&quot;)
    ui.gripper_advance_or_retreat(0.09)
    ep.do(&quot;descend (coarse)&quot;)
    ui.gripper_advance_or_retreat(0.035)
    ep.do(&quot;descend&quot;)
    ui.gripper_toggle()
    ep.do(&quot;close&quot;)
    assert env.gripper_width() &gt; 0.03, f&quot;grasp missed {green}&quot;
    ui.gripper_translate(0, 0, 0.15)
    ep.do(&quot;lift block&quot;)
    place_rot = _fold(diamond_yaw - grasp_rot, 180.0)
    ui.gripper_rotate(&quot;z&quot;, place_rot)
    ep.do(&quot;rotate to diamond&quot;)
    off = k.object_poses()[green][:2] - k.proprio().eef_pos[:2]
    aim = np.asarray(place_xy) - off
    ui.target_pos = np.array([*aim, ui.target_pos[2]])
    ep.do(&quot;move over red&quot;)
    ui.target_pos = np.array([*aim, place_z + 0.03])
    ep.do(&quot;lower (coarse)&quot;)
    ui.target_pos = np.array([*aim, place_z])
    ep.do(&quot;lower onto red&quot;)
    for _ in range(2):
        err = k.object_poses()[green][:2] - np.asarray(place_xy)
        if np.linalg.norm(err) &lt; 0.0015:
            break
        ui.gripper_translate(-err[0], -err[1], 0)
        ep.do(f&quot;nudge {np.round(err * 1000, 1)}mm&quot;)
    ui.gripper_toggle()
    ep.do(&quot;open&quot;)
    ui.gripper_translate(0, 0, 0.025)
    ep.do(&quot;pop up&quot;)
    vdir = np.array([udir[1], -udir[0]])
    ui.gripper_translate(*(0.0396 * vdir), 0.095)
    ep.do(&quot;retreat&quot;)
    ui.target_pos = np.array([-0.10, 0.0, 1.0])
    ep.do(&quot;park at home&quot;)
    ui.gripper_rotate(&quot;z&quot;, -(grasp_rot + place_rot))
    ep.do(&quot;rotate back&quot;)


def test_dual_stack_predicate():
    print(&quot;=== dual_stack success predicate (state probe) ===&quot;)
    import mujoco
    env = SimEnv(&quot;dual_stack&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset()
    spec = env.spec[&quot;success&quot;]
    rq = env.model.joint(env.model.body(spec[&quot;base&quot;]).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
    env.data.qpos[rq:rq + 3] = [0, 0, 0.825]
    env.data.qpos[rq + 3:rq + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
    for g, s in zip(spec[&quot;greens&quot;], (1, -1)):
        q = env.model.joint(env.model.body(g).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
        env.data.qpos[q:q + 3] = [s * 0.019, s * 0.019, 0.8765]
        quat = R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, 45, degrees=True).as_quat()
        env.data.qpos[q + 3:q + 7] = [quat[3], quat[0], quat[1], quat[2]]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    env._success_streak = 0
    fired = False
    for _ in range(400):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)
        env._success_streak = env._success_streak + 1 if env._check(env) else 0
        fired = fired or env._success_streak &gt;= hold_steps(env)
    assert fired and env._success_streak &gt;= hold_steps(env), &quot;predicate did not fire on the goal state&quot;
    env.reset()
    env._success_streak = 0
    assert not env._check(env), &quot;predicate fired on the initial state&quot;
    print(&quot;  PASS: fires+holds on the diamond goal state; False on the start state\n&quot;)


def test_dual_stack(seed=0):
    print(f&quot;=== dual_stack (default interface, seed {seed}) ===&quot;)
    ep = Episode(&quot;dual_stack&quot;, seed=seed)
    env, k = ep.env, ep.k

    poses = k.object_poses()
    red = poses[&quot;block_blue_main&quot;]
    print(f&quot;  red {np.round(red, 3)}  greens &quot;
          f&quot;{np.round(poses[&#x27;block_green1_main&#x27;], 3)} {np.round(poses[&#x27;block_green2_main&#x27;], 3)}&quot;)

    PLACE_Z = red[2] + 0.055 + 0.006
    D = 0.019 * np.sqrt(2)
    psi = _fold(_yaw_deg(env, &quot;block_blue_main&quot;))
    ang = np.radians(psi + 45.0)
    u = np.array([np.cos(ang), np.sin(ang)])
    pick_and_place(ep, &quot;block_green1_main&quot;, red[:2] + D * u, PLACE_Z,
                   diamond_yaw=psi + 45.0, udir=u)
    poses = k.object_poses()
    red2, g1 = poses[&quot;block_blue_main&quot;], poses[&quot;block_green1_main&quot;]
    psi = _fold(_yaw_deg(env, &quot;block_blue_main&quot;))
    ang = np.radians(psi + 45.0)
    u = np.array([np.cos(ang), np.sin(ang)])
    a2 = min(-D, (g1[:2] - red2[:2]) @ u - 0.05 - 0.010)
    pick_and_place(ep, &quot;block_green2_main&quot;, red2[:2] + a2 * u, PLACE_Z + 0.012,
                   diamond_yaw=psi + 45.0, udir=u, pre_yaw=90)

    ep.wait_success()
    poses = k.object_poses()
    print(f&quot;  settled: red {np.round(poses[&#x27;block_blue_main&#x27;], 3)}  greens &quot;
          f&quot;{np.round(poses[&#x27;block_green1_main&#x27;], 3)} {np.round(poses[&#x27;block_green2_main&#x27;], 3)}&quot;)
    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)[0](env), &quot;dual_stack did not succeed&quot;
    ep.save_video(f&quot;dual_stack_seed{seed}&quot;)
    print(f&quot;  PASS: steps={env.num_step}\n&quot;)


def set_free_qvel_lin(env, name, v):
    jadr = env.model.body(name).jntadr[0]
    vadr = env.model.joint(jadr).dofadr[0]
    env.data.qvel[vadr : vadr + 3] = v


def test_dual_stack_goal_fires(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    assert check(env) is True


def test_dual_stack_start_state_false(ds_env):
    env = ds_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_dual_stack_clause_height(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    g = spec[&quot;greens&quot;][0]
    set_free_body(env, g, [0.019, 0.019, 0.8765 - spec[&quot;dz_tol&quot;] - 0.005], yaw_deg=45)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_dual_stack_clause_xy(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    set_free_body(env, spec[&quot;greens&quot;][0],
                  [0.019 + spec[&quot;xy_tol&quot;] + 0.01, 0.019, 0.8765], yaw_deg=45)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_dual_stack_clause_same_level(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    assert 2 * 0.008 &gt; spec[&quot;same_level_tol&quot;] and 0.008 &lt; spec[&quot;dz_tol&quot;]
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    set_free_body(env, spec[&quot;greens&quot;][0], [0.019, 0.019, 0.8765 + 0.008], yaw_deg=45)
    set_free_body(env, spec[&quot;greens&quot;][1], [-0.019, -0.019, 0.8765 - 0.008], yaw_deg=45)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_dual_stack_clause_gripper_open(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    fingers = [env.model.joint(f&quot;{env.robot_prefix[0]}finger_joint{i}&quot;).qposadr[0] for i in (1, 2)]
    saved = [env.data.qpos[a] for a in fingers]
    for a in fingers:
        env.data.qpos[a] = 0.01
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False
    for a, v in zip(fingers, saved):
        env.data.qpos[a] = v


def test_dual_stack_clause_at_rest(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    set_free_qvel_lin(env, spec[&quot;greens&quot;][0], [spec[&quot;lin_vel_max&quot;] * 3, 0, 0])
    assert check(env) is False
    zero_free_qvel(env, spec[&quot;greens&quot;][0])
    assert check(env) is True


def test_robot_touching_helper(ds_env):
    env = ds_env
    env.reset(seed=0)
    block = env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;greens&quot;][0]
    assert _robot_touching(env, [block]) is False
    hand = env.data.body(f&quot;{env.robot_prefix[0]}hand&quot;).xpos.copy()
    set_free_body(env, block, hand)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert _robot_touching(env, [block]) is True


def test_verdict_pure_function_of_state(goal_state):
    env, spec = goal_state
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;dual_stack&quot;)
    state = env.sim_state()
    first = check(env)
    env.reset(seed=3)
    env.reset_to_sim_state(state)
    assert check(env) is first is True

<details><summary><code>tasks/handover_dominos/grade.py</code> (7 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of handover dominos.

1 to 5 blocks standing on end in one line, each the first time it holds, then the
task&#x27;s own success (the block-to-block cascade after five stood).&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import Subtask
from core.grade_episode import _body_pos, _contact_body_pairs, _free_joint_qvel, _robot_touching

STANDING_DOT, STILL_M, MIN_GAP_M, MAX_GAP_M, LINE_TOL_M = 0.9, 0.002, 0.035, 0.105, 0.02
DOWN_DOT = 0.7
STABLE_LIN_VEL_M_S = 0.01
STABLE_ANG_VEL_RAD_S = 0.1
STANDING_Z_M = (0.0483, 0.0723)
BLOCKS = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 19)]


def line_count(P):
    if len(P) &lt; 2:
        return len(P)
    best = 1
    for i in range(len(P)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(P)):
            d = P[j] - P[i]; L = np.linalg.norm(d)
            if L &lt; 1e-6:
                continue
            d = d / L; off = P - P[i]
            on = np.abs(off[:, 0] * d[1] - off[:, 1] * d[0]) &lt;= LINE_TOL_M
            run = 1
            for g in np.diff(np.sort(off[on] @ d)):
                run = run + 1 if MIN_GAP_M &lt;= g &lt;= MAX_GAP_M else 1
                best = max(best, run)
    return best


class DominoChain:
    def __init__(self, bodies, min, min_gap, max_gap, line_tol):
        self.bodies, self.minimum = tuple(bodies), int(min)
        self.min_gap, self.max_gap, self.line_tol = float(min_gap), float(max_gap), float(line_tol)
        self.members, self.seed, self.connected, self.robot_touched, self.dead = None, None, set(), set(), False

    @staticmethod
    def _axis_dot(env, body):
        return abs(float(env.data.body(body).xmat.reshape(3, 3)[:, 2] @ [0, 0, 1]))

    def _standing(self, env, body):
        qv = _free_joint_qvel(env, body)
        height = float(_body_pos(env, body)[2]) - float(env.spec[&quot;table_z&quot;])
        return (self._axis_dot(env, body) &gt;= STANDING_DOT
                and STANDING_Z_M[0] &lt;= height &lt;= STANDING_Z_M[1]
                and np.linalg.norm(qv[:3]) &lt;= STABLE_LIN_VEL_M_S
                and np.linalg.norm(qv[3:]) &lt;= STABLE_ANG_VEL_RAD_S)

    def _find_line(self, env):
        standing = [body for body in self.bodies if self._standing(env, body)]
        if len(standing) &lt; self.minimum:
            return None
        pos = {body: _body_pos(env, body)[:2].copy() for body in standing}
        best = ()
        for i, first in enumerate(standing):
            for second in standing[i + 1:]:
                delta = pos[second] - pos[first]
                length = float(np.linalg.norm(delta))
                if length &lt; self.min_gap:
                    continue
                axis = delta / length
                normal = np.array([-axis[1], axis[0]])
                aligned = [body for body in standing
                           if abs(float((pos[body] - pos[first]) @ normal))
                           &lt;= self.line_tol]
                aligned.sort(key=lambda body: float(pos[body] @ axis))
                run = [aligned[0]]
                for body in aligned[1:]:
                    gap = float((pos[body] - pos[run[-1]]) @ axis)
                    if self.min_gap &lt;= gap &lt;= self.max_gap:
                        run.append(body)
                    else:
                        if len(run) &gt; len(best):
                            best = tuple(run)
                        run = [body]
                if len(run) &gt; len(best):
                    best = tuple(run)
        return best if len(best) &gt;= self.minimum else None

    def _contacts(self, env):
        m = env.model
        owners = {m.body(name).id: name for name in self.members}
        edges = set()
        for b1, b2 in _contact_body_pairs(env):
            a, b = owners.get(b1), owners.get(b2)
            if a is not None and b is not None and a != b:
                edges.add(frozenset((a, b)))
        return edges

    def __call__(self, env):
        if self.dead:
            return False
        if self.members is None:
            line = self._find_line(env)
            if line is None or _robot_touching(env, line):
                return False
            self.members = tuple(line)
            return False

        touched = {body for body in self.members if _robot_touching(env, [body])}
        self.robot_touched |= touched
        if len(self.robot_touched) &gt; 1:
            self.dead = True
            return False

        dot = {body: self._axis_dot(env, body) for body in self.members}
        tilted = {body for body in self.members if dot[body] &lt; STANDING_DOT}
        if self.seed is None:
            if not tilted:
                return False
            if self.robot_touched:
                candidate = next(iter(self.robot_touched))
                if candidate not in tilted:
                    self.dead = True
                    return False
                self.seed = candidate
            else:
                self.seed = min(tilted, key=dot.get)
            self.connected = {self.seed}

        edges = self._contacts(env)
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for edge in edges:
                if edge &amp; self.connected and not edge &lt;= self.connected:
                    other = next(iter(edge - self.connected))
                    if other not in self.robot_touched:
                        self.connected.add(other)
                        changed = True

        return (len(self.connected) == len(self.members)
                and all(dot[body] &lt;= DOWN_DOT for body in self.members))


def domino_chain(bodies, min, min_gap, max_gap, line_tol):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;at least {min} of {bodies} latched as one stable domino line, then toppled through block-to-block contact after the robot knocks only one&quot;&quot;&quot;
    return DominoChain(bodies, min, min_gap, max_gap, line_tol)


def subtasks():
    state = dict(last=None, line=0, frame=-1, sampled=False)

    def standing(k):
        def check(s):
            if state[&quot;frame&quot;] != s.frame:
                state[&quot;frame&quot;], state[&quot;sampled&quot;] = s.frame, s.frame % 2 == 0
                if state[&quot;sampled&quot;]:
                    pos = np.array([s.env.data.body(b).xpos for b in BLOCKS])
                    zax = np.array([s.env.data.body(b).xmat.reshape(3, 3)[2, 2] for b in BLOCKS])
                    still = np.ones(len(pos), bool) if state[&quot;last&quot;] is None else np.linalg.norm(pos - state[&quot;last&quot;], axis=1) &lt; STILL_M
                    state[&quot;last&quot;] = pos.copy()
                    ok = [i for i, b in enumerate(BLOCKS) if abs(zax[i]) &gt;= STANDING_DOT and still[i] and not _robot_touching(s.env, [b])]
                    state[&quot;line&quot;] = line_count(pos[ok, :2])
            return state[&quot;sampled&quot;] and state[&quot;line&quot;] &gt;= k
        return check

    return [Subtask(label, standing(k), ever=True, objects=tuple(BLOCKS)) for k, label in zip(range(1, 6), [&#x27;1 block standing on end&#x27;, &#x27;2 blocks standing on end in one line&#x27;, &#x27;3 blocks standing on end in one line&#x27;, &#x27;4 blocks standing on end in one line&#x27;, &#x27;5 blocks standing on end in one line&#x27;])] + \
           [Subtask(&#x27;knock the first block&#x27;, lambda s: s.success(), ever=True, needs=(4,))]
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/handover_dominos/test.py</code> (5 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the handover_dominos task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import json
import numpy as np
from core.tasks import CATEGORY_GAME, TASKS
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core import grade_episode as predicates
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
    set_free_body,
    zero_free_qvel,
)


def test_spd_handover_randomizes_one_rigid_pile_per_arm_side():
    task = &quot;handover_dominos&quot;
    spec = json.loads((TASKS / task / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())
    negative = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 13, 17)]
    positive = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in (2, 7, 9, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18)]
    blocks = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 19)]
    rnd = spec[&quot;randomization&quot;]

    assert spec[&quot;category&quot;] == CATEGORY_GAME
    assert rnd[&quot;full_rand&quot;] is True
    assert rnd[&quot;groups&quot;] == [negative, positive]
    assert rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;] == {
        &quot;jenga_1&quot;: [{&quot;x&quot;: [0.62, 0.78], &quot;y&quot;: [-0.34, -0.32],
                     &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-180, 180]}],
        &quot;jenga_2&quot;: [{&quot;x&quot;: [0.62, 0.78], &quot;y&quot;: [0.32, 0.34],
                     &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-180, 180]}],
    }
    assert rnd[&quot;lift_reach&quot;] == {block: 0.14 for block in blocks}
    assert rnd[&quot;min_sep&quot;] == [[a, b, 0.1] for a in negative for b in positive]

    env = SimEnv(task, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    radii = []
    for pile in (negative, positive):
        pivot = np.mean([env.data.body(block).xpos[:2] for block in pile], axis=0)
        points = np.concatenate([env._xy_points(block) for block in pile])
        radii.append(float(np.linalg.norm(points - pivot, axis=1).max()))
    assert -0.32 + radii[0] &lt; -0.06
    assert 0.32 - radii[1] &gt; 0.06


def test_spd_domino_pack_needs_a_line_and_propagated_cascade(monkeypatch):
    env = _pack_env(&quot;handover_dominos&quot;)
    blocks = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 19)]
    line = blocks[:5]
    z_stand, z_down = 0.77921 + 0.0603, 0.77921 + 0.0127
    contact_pairs = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        predicates, &quot;_contact_body_pairs&quot;, lambda _env: iter(contact_pairs))

    def put(body, pos, down=False):
        set_free_body(env, body, pos)
        if down:
            qadr = env.model.joint(env.model.body(body).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
            quat = R.from_euler(&quot;y&quot;, 90, degrees=True).as_quat()
            env.data.qpos[qadr + 3:qadr + 7] = [quat[3], quat[0], quat[1], quat[2]]
        zero_free_qvel(env, body)
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)

    for i, body in enumerate(blocks[5:]):
        put(body, [0.45 + 0.08 * (i % 7), -0.25 + 0.08 * (i // 7), z_down], True)
    for body, pos in zip(line, ([0.50, -0.20, z_stand], [0.62, 0.12, z_stand],
                                [0.75, -0.05, z_stand], [0.88, 0.20, z_stand],
                                [0.98, -0.18, z_stand])):
        put(body, pos)
    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)[0](env) is False

    for i, body in enumerate(line):
        put(body, [0.55 + 0.06 * i, 0.0, z_stand])
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    assert check(env) is False
    robot = env.model.body(&quot;move_link_6&quot;).id
    bids = {body: env.model.body(body).id for body in line}
    for i, body in enumerate(line):
        put(body, [0.55 + 0.06 * i, 0.0, z_stand], True)
        contact_pairs[:] = ([(robot, bids[body])] if i == 0 else
                            [(bids[line[i - 1]], bids[body])])
        assert check(env) is (i == len(line) - 1)


def test_domino_chain_requires_one_contact_propagated_knock(monkeypatch):
    env = _pack_env(&quot;handover_dominos&quot;)
    blocks = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 6)]
    z = 0.77921 + 0.0603
    contact_pairs = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        predicates, &quot;_contact_body_pairs&quot;, lambda _env: iter(contact_pairs))

    def pose(body, x, down=False):
        set_free_body(env, body, [x, 0.0, z])
        if down:
            qadr = env.model.joint(env.model.body(body).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
            quat = R.from_euler(&quot;y&quot;, 90, degrees=True).as_quat()
            env.data.qpos[qadr + 3:qadr + 7] = [quat[3], quat[0], quat[1], quat[2]]
        zero_free_qvel(env, body)
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)

    for i, body in enumerate(blocks):
        pose(body, 0.55 + 0.06 * i)

    spec = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;domino_chain&quot;, &quot;bodies&quot;: blocks, &quot;min&quot;: 5,
            &quot;min_gap&quot;: 0.035, &quot;max_gap&quot;: 0.105, &quot;line_tol&quot;: 0.020}
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;handover_dominos&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False
    robot = env.model.body(&quot;move_link_6&quot;).id
    bids = {body: env.model.body(body).id for body in blocks}

    pose(blocks[0], 0.55, down=True)
    contact_pairs[:] = [(robot, bids[blocks[0]])]
    assert check(env) is False
    for i, body in enumerate(blocks[1:], 1):
        pose(body, 0.55 + 0.06 * i, down=True)
        contact_pairs[:] = [(bids[blocks[i - 1]], bids[body])]
        assert check(env) is (i == len(blocks) - 1)

    contact_pairs.clear()
    for i, body in enumerate(blocks):
        pose(body, 0.55 + 0.06 * i)
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;handover_dominos&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False
    pose(blocks[0], 0.55, down=True)
    contact_pairs[:] = [(robot, bids[blocks[0]])]
    assert check(env) is False
    pose(blocks[1], 0.61, down=True)
    contact_pairs[:] = [(robot, bids[blocks[1]]), (bids[blocks[0]], bids[blocks[1]])]
    assert check(env) is False and check.dead
    for i, body in enumerate(blocks[2:], 2):
        pose(body, 0.55 + 0.06 * i, down=True)
        contact_pairs[:] = [(bids[blocks[i - 1]], bids[body])]
        assert check(env) is False

from core.grade_episode import Subtask


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick mug a and hang it on the tree&#x27;,
                lambda s: ((s.within_dist(a=&#x27;mug_slot_a&#x27;, b=&#x27;mug_tree_slot&#x27;, tol=0.17, axes=&#x27;xy&#x27;)
                    and s.lift_above(obj=&#x27;mug_slot_a&#x27;, z_above=0.84921)
                    and s.touching_part(a=&#x27;mug_slot_a&#x27;, b=&#x27;mug_tree_slot&#x27;))
                and s.robot_clear(bodies=[&#x27;mug_slot_a&#x27;]))),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick mug d and hang it on the tree&#x27;,
                lambda s: ((s.within_dist(a=&#x27;mug_slot_d&#x27;, b=&#x27;mug_tree_slot&#x27;, tol=0.17, axes=&#x27;xy&#x27;)
                    and s.lift_above(obj=&#x27;mug_slot_d&#x27;, z_above=0.84921)
                    and s.touching_part(a=&#x27;mug_slot_d&#x27;, b=&#x27;mug_tree_slot&#x27;))
                and s.robot_clear(bodies=[&#x27;mug_slot_d&#x27;]))),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick plate c and stand it in the rack&#x27;,
                lambda s: ((s.within_dist(a=&#x27;plate_slot_c&#x27;, b=&#x27;rack_slot&#x27;, tol=0.24, axes=&#x27;xy&#x27;)
                    and s.axis_dot(obj=&#x27;plate_slot_c&#x27;, min_dot=0.0, max_dot=0.6947, abs=True)
                    and s.lift_above(obj=&#x27;plate_slot_c&#x27;, z_above=0.79921)

                    and s.touching_part(a=&#x27;plate_slot_c&#x27;, b=&#x27;rack_slot&#x27;))
                and s.robot_clear(bodies=[&#x27;plate_slot_c&#x27;]))),

import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import numpy as np
import pytest
from core.tasks import CATEGORY_REAL_WORLD, TASKS, asset_dir
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.grade_episode import make_checker, nodes
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
    set_free_body,
    zero_free_qvel,
)


def test_spd_kitchen_full_randomizes_only_retained_upright_objects():
    task = &quot;hang_mugs_and_rack&quot;
    pack = TASKS / task
    spec = json.loads((pack / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())
    mugs = [f&quot;mug_slot_{letter}&quot; for letter in &quot;ad&quot;]
    plates = [f&quot;plate_slot_{letter}&quot; for letter in &quot;cd&quot;]
    loose = mugs + plates
    removed = {&quot;mug_slot_b&quot;, &quot;mug_slot_c&quot;, &quot;plate_slot_a&quot;, &quot;plate_slot_b&quot;}
    rnd = spec[&quot;randomization&quot;]

    assert spec[&quot;category&quot;] == CATEGORY_REAL_WORLD
    assert spec[&quot;language&quot;] == (
        &quot;Hang each mug on the mug tree, and stand each plate in the dish rack.&quot;)
    assert not removed &amp; set(spec[&quot;objects&quot;])
    assert rnd[&quot;full_rand&quot;] is True
    assert rnd[&quot;groups&quot;] == [[&quot;rack_slot&quot;, &quot;mug_tree_slot&quot;],
                             *[[body] for body in loose]]
    assert set(rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;]) == {&quot;rack_slot&quot;, *mugs}
    assert rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;][&quot;rack_slot&quot;] == [{
        &quot;x&quot;: [0.794995, 0.794995], &quot;y&quot;: [-0.00002, -0.00002],
        &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [0, 0],
    }]
    for mug in mugs:
        assert rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;][mug] == [{
            &quot;x&quot;: [0.50, 0.75], &quot;y&quot;: [-0.15, 0.15], &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-180, 180]}]
    assert rnd[&quot;region&quot;] == {&quot;x&quot;: [0, 0], &quot;y&quot;: [0, 0],
                             &quot;yaw&quot;: [-np.pi, np.pi]}
    assert rnd[&quot;lift_reach&quot;] == {body: 0.1 for body in loose}
    assert len(rnd[&quot;min_sep&quot;]) == 6
    assert {distance for _a, _b, distance in rnd[&quot;min_sep&quot;]} == {0.1}
    assert &quot;grasp_clearance&quot; not in rnd

    scene_text = (pack / &quot;scene.xml&quot;).read_text()
    root = ET.fromstring(scene_text)
    assert all(name not in scene_text for name in removed)
    rack = next(body for body in root.iter(&quot;body&quot;) if body.get(&quot;name&quot;) == &quot;rack_slot&quot;)
    assert np.allclose([float(value) for value in rack.get(&quot;pos&quot;).split()],
                       [0.77, -0.33, 0.81836])
    rack_object = next(body for body in root.iter(&quot;body&quot;)
                       if body.get(&quot;name&quot;) == &quot;rack_slot__object&quot;)
    rack_collisions = [geom for geom in rack_object.findall(&quot;geom&quot;)
                       if geom.get(&quot;class&quot;) == &quot;rack_slot__collision&quot;]
    assert len(rack_collisions) == 71
    z_bounds = [
        (float(geom.get(&quot;pos&quot;).split()[2]) - float(geom.get(&quot;size&quot;).split()[2]),
         float(geom.get(&quot;pos&quot;).split()[2]) + float(geom.get(&quot;size&quot;).split()[2]))
        for geom in rack_collisions]
    assert min(lo for lo, _hi in z_bounds) == pytest.approx(-0.03915197)
    assert max(hi for _lo, hi in z_bounds) == pytest.approx(0.08857858)
    assert len([geom for geom in rack_object.findall(&quot;geom&quot;)
                if geom.get(&quot;class&quot;) == &quot;rack_slot__visual&quot;]) == 1
    assert not any(path.name.startswith(tuple(removed))
                   or path.name == &quot;plate_texture.png&quot;
                   for path in (asset_dir(pack) / &quot;assets&quot;).iterdir())

    env = SimEnv(task, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    fixtures = {
        name: np.r_[env.data.body(name).xpos, env.data.body(name).xquat].copy()
        for name in (&quot;rack_slot&quot;, &quot;mug_tree_slot&quot;)}
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=True)
    assert all(np.array_equal(
        np.r_[env.data.body(name).xpos, env.data.body(name).xquat], pose)
        for name, pose in fixtures.items())
    assert all(env.data.body(name).xmat.reshape(3, 3)[2, 2] &gt; 0.99
               for name in loose)


def test_spd_kitchen_pad_pairs_carry_the_rolling_term():
    from core.sim_env import SimEnv

    env = SimEnv(&quot;hang_mugs_and_rack&quot;, seed=0)
    m = env.model
    root = lambda g: m.body(int(m.body_rootid[int(m.geom_bodyid[g])])).name or &quot;&quot;
    fingers = [g for g in range(m.ngeom) if &quot;finger&quot; in (m.body(int(m.geom_bodyid[g])).name or &quot;&quot;)
               and (m.geom_contype[g] or m.geom_conaffinity[g])]
    plates = [g for g in range(m.ngeom) if root(g).startswith(&quot;plate_slot&quot;) and m.geom_contype[g]]
    pad = [p for p in range(m.npair) if m.pair_geom1[p] in plates]
    assert len(pad) == len(fingers) * len(plates)
    assert {(m.pair_geom1[p], m.pair_geom2[p]) for p in pad} == {(p, f) for p in plates for f in fingers}
    assert all(m.pair_dim[p] == 6 and abs(m.pair_friction[p][3] - 0.05) &lt; 1e-9 for p in pad)
    assert all(m.geom_friction[g][2] &lt; 0.01 for g in plates)


def test_spd_kitchen_requires_fixture_contact_and_accepts_scripted_goals():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;hang_mugs_and_rack&quot;)

    def put(body, fixture, offset, quat=None):
        pos = env.data.body(fixture).xpos.copy()
        pos += [offset[0], offset[1], offset[2] - pos[2]]
        set_free_body(env, body, pos)
        if quat is not None:
            adr = env._obj_qadr[body]
            env.data.qpos[adr + 3:adr + 7] = quat
        zero_free_qvel(env, body)

    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])[0](env) is False
    for letter in &quot;ad&quot;:
        put(f&quot;mug_slot_{letter}&quot;, &quot;mug_tree_slot&quot;, (0.16, 0.0, 1.01))
    for letter in &quot;cd&quot;:
        put(f&quot;plate_slot_{letter}&quot;, &quot;rack_slot&quot;, (0.0, 0.0, 1.07),
            [np.sqrt(0.5), np.sqrt(0.5), 0, 0])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    for group in env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;of&quot;][:2]:
        for goal in group[&quot;of&quot;]:
            noncontact = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [
                node for node in goal[&quot;of&quot;] if node[&quot;pred&quot;] != &quot;touching_part&quot;]}
            assert make_checker(noncontact)[0](env) is True
    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])[0](env) is False

    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    mug_goals = [(-0.12, -0.05, 0.87), (0.0, 0.04, 0.87)]
    plate_goals = [
        ((-0.000183, 0.020832, 0.882042),
         [0.692568412, -0.721351940, -0.000191331, -0.000579983]),
        ((0.000113, 0.103942, 0.885389),
         [0.696072258, -0.717971459, 0.000626397, 0.000060499]),
    ]
    for letter, offset in zip(&quot;ad&quot;, mug_goals):
        put(f&quot;mug_slot_{letter}&quot;, &quot;mug_tree_slot&quot;, offset)
    for letter, (offset, quat) in zip(&quot;cd&quot;, plate_goals):
        put(f&quot;plate_slot_{letter}&quot;, &quot;rack_slot&quot;, offset, quat)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])[0](env) is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;angle,expected&quot;, [
    (0, False), (45.9, False), (46.1, True), (90, True),
    (133.9, True), (134.1, False), (180, False),
])
def test_spd_kitchen_plates_on_edge_either_face(angle, expected):
    env = _pack_env(&quot;hang_mugs_and_rack&quot;)
    for node in nodes(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;]):
        if node[&quot;pred&quot;] != &quot;axis_dot&quot;:
            continue
        a = env._obj_qadr[node[&quot;obj&quot;]]
        env.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = np.roll(
            R.from_euler(&quot;x&quot;, angle, degrees=True).as_quat(), 1)
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        assert make_checker(node)[0](env) is expected
