<details><summary><code>tasks/jenga_tower/grade.py</code> (3 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of jenga tower.

Layers 2 to 4 laid block by block, each layer three blocks flat across the layer below, alternating
direction, released and supported (layer 1 stands at the start).&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask
from core.grade_episode import _body_pos, _contact_body_pairs, _subtrees_touching

BLOCKS = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 19)]
X, Y = [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]
TABLE = &#x27;play_table&#x27;


def layers(s):
    layer_bands_z_m = next(n[&quot;bands&quot;] for n in s.env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;of&quot;] if n.get(&quot;pred&quot;) == &quot;tower_support&quot;)
    best = (0, 0)
    for first, second in ((X, Y), (Y, X)):
        below, complete, partial = [], 0, 0
        for k, (lo, hi) in enumerate(layer_bands_z_m):
            along = first if k % 2 == 0 else second
            supported = [b for b in BLOCKS
                         if s.lift_above(obj=b, z_above=lo) and s.z_below(obj=b, z_below=hi)
                         and s.axis_dot(obj=b, axis=[0, 0, 1], world_axis=along, abs=True, min_dot=0.9)
                         and s.axis_dot(obj=b, axis=[0, 0, 1], world_axis=[0, 0, 1], abs=True, min_dot=0.0, max_dot=0.15)
                         and s.env.robot_clear([b])
                         and (_subtrees_touching(s.env, b, TABLE) if k == 0
                              else sum(bool(_subtrees_touching(s.env, b, c)) for c in below) &gt;= 2)]
            if len(supported) &lt; 3:
                partial = len(supported)
                break
            complete += 1
            below = supported
        best = max(best, (complete, partial))
    return best


def tower_support(bodies, table, bands):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;every block in one height layer, resting on {table} or on two distinct blocks of the layer below&quot;&quot;&quot;
    bodies, bands = tuple(bodies), tuple(tuple(band) for band in bands)

    def check(env):
        layers = [[] for _ in bands]
        for body in bodies:
            matches = [i for i, (lo, hi) in enumerate(bands)
                       if lo &lt; float(_body_pos(env, body)[2]) &lt; hi]
            if len(matches) != 1:
                return False
            layers[matches[0]].append(body)
        needed = {frozenset((body, table)) for body in layers[0]}
        needed |= {frozenset((body, below)) for i in range(1, len(layers))
                   for body in layers[i] for below in layers[i - 1]}
        m = env.model
        owners = {m.body(name).id: name for name in (*bodies, table)}
        def owner(bid):
            while bid &gt; 0 and bid not in owners:
                bid = int(m.body_parentid[bid])
            return owners.get(bid)
        edges = {frozenset((a, b)) for b1, b2 in _contact_body_pairs(env)
                 if (a := owner(b1)) and (b := owner(b2)) and a != b}
        edges |= {pair for pair in needed - edges
                  if _subtrees_touching(env, *tuple(pair))}
        return (all(frozenset((body, table)) in edges for body in layers[0])
                and all(sum(frozenset((body, below)) in edges for below in layers[i - 1]) &gt;= 2
                        for i in range(1, len(layers)) for body in layers[i]))
    return check


def subtasks():
    def laid(layer, n):
        return lambda s: (lambda c, p: c &gt;= layer or c == layer - 1 and p &gt;= n)(*layers(s))
    return [Subtask(f&#x27;{n} block{&quot;s&quot; * (n &gt; 1)} of layer {layer} laid flat across layer {layer - 1}&#x27;,
                    (lambda s: s.success()) if (layer, n) == (4, 3) else laid(layer, n), objects=tuple(BLOCKS))
            for layer in (2, 3, 4) for n in (1, 2, 3)]

<details><summary><code>tasks/jenga_tower/test.py</code> (3 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the jenga_tower task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import json
import numpy as np
from core.tasks import CATEGORY_GAME, TASKS
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
    zero_free_qvel,
)
from helpers import (
    ROYGBIV,
)


def test_spd_tower_randomizes_two_rigid_piles_and_keeps_build_strip_clear():
    task = &quot;jenga_tower&quot;
    spec = json.loads((TASKS / task / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())
    negative = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in (1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18)]
    positive = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in (4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)]
    blocks = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 19)]
    rnd = spec[&quot;randomization&quot;]

    assert spec[&quot;category&quot;] == CATEGORY_GAME
    assert rnd[&quot;full_rand&quot;] is True
    assert rnd[&quot;groups&quot;] == [negative, positive]
    assert rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;] == {
        &quot;jenga_1&quot;: [{&quot;x&quot;: [0.62, 0.74], &quot;y&quot;: [-0.44, -0.36],
                     &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-180, 180]}],
        &quot;jenga_4&quot;: [{&quot;x&quot;: [0.62, 0.74], &quot;y&quot;: [0.34, 0.39],
                     &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-180, 180]}],
    }
    assert rnd[&quot;lift_reach&quot;] == {block: 0.14 for block in blocks}
    assert rnd[&quot;min_sep&quot;] == [[a, b, 0.1] for a in negative for b in positive]

    env = SimEnv(task, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    radii = []
    for pile in (negative, positive):
        pivot = np.mean([env.data.body(block).xpos[:2] for block in pile], axis=0)
        points = np.concatenate([env._xy_points(block) for block in pile])
        radii.append(float(np.linalg.norm(points - pivot, axis=1).max()))
    assert -0.36 + radii[0] &lt; -0.10
    assert 0.34 - radii[1] &gt; 0.10


def test_spd_tower_rejects_separate_columns_and_accepts_supported_tower():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;jenga_tower&quot;)
    blocks = [f&quot;jenga_{i}&quot; for i in range(1, 19)]
    table = 0.77921
    qx = [2 ** -0.5, 0, 2 ** -0.5, 0]
    qy = [0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5]

    def put(body, pos, quat):
        qadr = env.model.joint(env.model.body(body).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
        env.data.qpos[qadr:qadr + 3] = pos
        env.data.qpos[qadr + 3:qadr + 7] = quat
        zero_free_qvel(env, body)

    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)[0](env) is False
    for layer in range(6):
        quat = qx if layer % 2 == 0 else qy
        for column, body in enumerate(blocks[3 * layer:3 * layer + 3]):
            put(body, [0.55 + 0.20 * column, 0.0,
                       table + 0.0127 + 0.0254 * layer], quat)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)[0](env) is False

    for layer in range(4):
        along_x = layer % 2 == 0
        quat = qx if along_x else qy
        for offset, body in zip((-0.04064, 0.0, 0.04064),
                                blocks[3 * layer:3 * layer + 3]):
            pos = [0.75, 0.0, table + 0.0127 + 0.0254 * layer]
            pos[1 if along_x else 0] += offset
            put(body, pos, quat)
    for k, body in enumerate(blocks[12:]):
        put(body, [0.50 + 0.06 * k, -0.35, table + 0.0127], qy)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    for _ in range(10):
        env._step_physics()
    assert make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)[0](env) is True


def _put(env, body, pos):
    j = env.model.joint(env.model.body(body).jntadr[0])
    env.data.qpos[j.qposadr[0]:j.qposadr[0] + 3] = pos
    env.data.qvel[j.dofadr[0]:j.dofadr[0] + 6] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)


def test_count_is_at_least_k_of_n():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    cubes = ROYGBIV[:5]
    spec = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;count&quot;, &quot;min&quot;: 3,
            &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;lift_above&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: c, &quot;z_above&quot;: 0.90} for c in cubes]}
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;jenga_tower&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False
    for c in cubes[:2]:
        _put(env, c, [0.02, 0.0, 0.95])
    assert check(env) is False
    _put(env, cubes[2], [0.02, 0.1, 0.95])
    assert check(env) is True

from core.grade_episode import Subtask

COINS = [f&#x27;coin{i}&#x27; for i in range(6)]


def count_in_cavity(s):
    return sum(s.in_site_box(site=&#x27;cavity&#x27;, size=[0.064, 0.049, 0.018], obj=c) for c in COINS)


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the key and insert it in the keyway&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.pose_within(obj=&#x27;key&#x27;, rel_to=&#x27;case&#x27;, pos=[0.07500000000000001, 0.0, 0.115], quat=[0.707107, 0.0, 0.707107, 0.0], pos_tol=0.006, rot_tol_deg=8.0),
                ever=True),
        Subtask(&#x27;turn the key to unlock&#x27;,
                lambda s: (s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;j_rotor&#x27;, lo=1.54, hi=1.62)
                and s.over_site(obj=&#x27;key&#x27;, site=&#x27;keyway&#x27;, lo=[-0.022, -0.011, -0.016], hi=[0.022, 0.011, 0.016])),
                ever=True,
                needs=(0,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;1 coin in the cavity&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_cavity(s) &gt;= 1),
        Subtask(&#x27;2 coins in the cavity&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_cavity(s) &gt;= 2),
        Subtask(&#x27;3 coins in the cavity&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_cavity(s) &gt;= 3),
        Subtask(&#x27;4 coins in the cavity&#x27;, lambda s: count_in_cavity(s) &gt;= 4),
        Subtask(&#x27;close the lid&#x27;,
                lambda s: (s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;j_lid&#x27;, lo=-0.01, hi=0.08)
                and count_in_cavity(s) &gt;= 4),
                needs=(),
                end_needs=(1, 5)),
        Subtask(&#x27;turn the key to relock&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.success(),
                needs=(6,),
                end_needs=(6,)),
    ]

<details><summary><code>tasks/lock_the_coins_in_the_strongbox/test.py</code> (15 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the lock_the_coins_in_the_strongbox task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
import json
import pytest
from core import tasks
from core.sim_env import PHYSICS_DT


LOCKBOX_TASK = &quot;lock_the_coins_in_the_strongbox&quot;


def _lockbox_lid_contact(one_pad=False):
    env = SimEnv(task=LOCKBOX_TASK, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    lid = env.model.body(&quot;lid&quot;).id
    target = env.data.geom(&quot;lid_grip&quot;).xpos.copy()
    case_rot = R.from_matrix(env.data.body(&quot;case&quot;).xmat.reshape(3, 3))
    down = (case_rot * R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, np.pi).inv()
            * R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, np.deg2rad(75))
            * R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, env._home_euler[arm])).as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;)
    env.move_to(target + [0, 0, 0.10], down, 1)
    env.move_to(target, down, 1)
    env.move_to(target, down, 0)
    if one_pad:
        env.data.qpos[env.model.joint(&quot;j_lid&quot;).qposadr[0]] = 0.0
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    fingers = set()
    for contact in env.data.contact[: env.data.ncon]:
        for finger, other in ((contact.geom1, contact.geom2),
                              (contact.geom2, contact.geom1)):
            body = int(env.model.geom_bodyid[finger])
            root = env.finger_root(body, arm)
            if (env._ancestor_in(int(env.model.geom_bodyid[other]), {lid})
                    and root is not None):
                fingers.add(root)
    lid_geoms = {g for g in range(env.model.ngeom)
                 if env._ancestor_in(int(env.model.geom_bodyid[g]), {lid})}
    return env, arm, fingers, lid_geoms


def test_closed_two_pad_grasp_exempts_articulated_lid():
    env, arm, fingers, lid_geoms = _lockbox_lid_contact()
    assert fingers == env.finger_roots(arm)
    assert env.ctl._held_payload_geoms(arm) == lid_geoms


def test_closed_one_pad_brush_does_not_exempt_articulated_lid():
    env, arm, fingers, _ = _lockbox_lid_contact(one_pad=True)
    assert len(fingers) == 1
    assert env.ctl._held_payload_geoms(arm) == set()


def test_open_jaw_does_not_exempt_articulated_lid():
    env, arm, fingers, _ = _lockbox_lid_contact()
    assert fingers == env.finger_roots(arm)
    env.curr_gripper_open[arm] = 1
    assert env.ctl._held_payload_geoms(arm) == set()


TASK = &quot;lock_the_coins_in_the_strongbox&quot;
PACK = tasks.resolve_task(TASK)
SCENE = PACK / &quot;scene.xml&quot;
LANGUAGE = &quot;Unlock the chest with the key, put four coins inside, and lock it again.&quot;
ROT_HI = 1.5708
BOLT_TRAVEL = 0.030
LID_OPEN = 1.7453
CASE_POS = np.array([0.739, 0.055, 0.77921])
OUTSIDE_FACE_X = 0.076
LOCK_X = 0.064
LOCK_Z = 0.115
KEY_SEATED_X = 0.075
KEY_SEATED_QUAT = np.array([0.707107, 0.0, 0.707107, 0.0])


@pytest.fixture(scope=&quot;module&quot;)
def mechanism():
    model = tasks.load_scene(PACK).compile()
    model.opt.timestep = PHYSICS_DT
    return model, mujoco.MjData(model)


def _qpos(model, name):
    return model.joint(name).qposadr[0]


def _dof(model, name):
    return model.joint(name).dofadr[0]


def _settle(model, data, steps=800):
    for _ in range(round(steps * .002 / model.opt.timestep)):
        mujoco.mj_step(model, data)


def _quat_mul(left, right):
    w1, x1, y1, z1 = left
    w2, x2, y2, z2 = right
    return np.array([
        w1 * w2 - x1 * x2 - y1 * y2 - z1 * z2,
        w1 * x2 + x1 * w2 + y1 * z2 - z1 * y2,
        w1 * y2 - x1 * z2 + y1 * w2 + z1 * x2,
        w1 * z2 + x1 * y2 - y1 * x2 + z1 * w2,
    ])


def _seat_key(model, data, rotor):
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    case = data.body(&quot;case&quot;)
    key_qpos = model.jnt_qposadr[model.body(&quot;key&quot;).jntadr[0]]
    local_pos = np.array([KEY_SEATED_X, 0.0, LOCK_Z])
    data.qpos[key_qpos : key_qpos + 3] = (
        case.xpos + case.xmat.reshape(3, 3) @ local_pos)
    turn = np.array([np.cos(rotor / 2), np.sin(rotor / 2), 0.0, 0.0])
    data.qpos[key_qpos + 3 : key_qpos + 7] = _quat_mul(
        case.xquat, _quat_mul(turn, KEY_SEATED_QUAT))
    data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_depth_pin&quot;)] = .010


def _prepare(model, data, *, rotor, lid, plunger, key_out=True):
    mujoco.mj_resetData(model, data)
    data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_rotor&quot;)] = rotor
    data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_bolt_slide&quot;)] = BOLT_TRAVEL * rotor / ROT_HI
    data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_lid&quot;)] = lid
    data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_plunger&quot;)] = plunger
    data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_depth_pin&quot;)] = .010
    if key_out:
        data.qfrc_applied[_dof(model, &quot;j_depth_pin&quot;)] = .12
    if key_out:
        key_qpos = model.jnt_qposadr[model.body(&quot;key&quot;).jntadr[0]]
        data.qpos[key_qpos] += 0.20
    else:
        _seat_key(model, data, rotor)
    data.qvel[:] = 0
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    _settle(model, data)


def _apply_joint_torque(model, data, joint, torque, steps=1600):
    address = _dof(model, joint)
    qpos = _qpos(model, joint)
    low = high = float(data.qpos[qpos])
    for _ in range(round(steps * .002 / model.opt.timestep)):
        data.qfrc_applied[address] = torque
        mujoco.mj_step(model, data)
        value = float(data.qpos[qpos])
        low, high = min(low, value), max(high, value)
    data.qfrc_applied[:] = 0
    return low, high, float(data.qpos[qpos])


def test_treasure_chest_declaration_and_generated_visuals():
    task = json.loads((PACK / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())

    scene = SCENE.read_text()

    assert task[&quot;language&quot;] == LANGUAGE
    assert task[&quot;category&quot;] == &quot;real_world&quot;

        (&quot;move&quot;, &quot;i2rt_yam&quot;), (&quot;hold&quot;, &quot;i2rt_yam&quot;)]
    assert {camera.get(&quot;robot&quot;) for camera in task[&quot;cameras&quot;]
            if camera[&quot;role&quot;] == &quot;wrist&quot;} == {&quot;move&quot;, &quot;hold&quot;}

    assert &quot;thumb-screw&quot; not in task[&quot;language&quot;]

    assert &quot;j_lid&quot; in scene

    assert scene.count(&#x27;name=&quot;lid_shell_&#x27;) == 12

    assert &#x27;name=&quot;front_brass_lock_plate&quot;&#x27; not in scene

def test_key_cavity_is_open_through_insertion_and_quarter_turn(mechanism):
    model, _ = mechanism
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    key = model.body(&quot;key&quot;).id
    qa = model.jnt_qposadr[model.body(&quot;key&quot;).jntadr[0]]
    for angle, x in ([(0., x) for x in np.linspace(.135, .075, 121)]
                     + [(a, .075) for a in np.linspace(0, np.pi/2, 91)]):
        data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_rotor&quot;)] = angle
        data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_bolt_slide&quot;)] = BOLT_TRAVEL * angle / ROT_HI
        _seat_key(model, data, angle)
        data.qpos[qa:qa+3] += data.body(&quot;case&quot;).xmat.reshape(3, 3)[:, 0] * (x-.075)
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        for c in data.contact:
            if key in (model.geom_bodyid[c.geom1], model.geom_bodyid[c.geom2]):
                assert c.dist &gt;= -1e-6, (angle, x, model.geom(c.geom1).name,
                                        model.geom(c.geom2).name, c.dist)


def test_locked_lid_physically_stays_shut_and_unlocked_lid_reaches_stop(mechanism):
    model, data = mechanism
    for i in range(12):
        shell = model.geom(f&quot;lid_shell_{i:02d}&quot;)
        assert shell.contype and shell.conaffinity
        assert model.body(int(shell.bodyid[0])).name == &quot;lid&quot;

    _prepare(model, data, rotor=0.0, lid=0.0, plunger=0.0)
    _, locked_peak, locked_end = _apply_joint_torque(model, data, &quot;j_lid&quot;, 0.6)

    _prepare(model, data, rotor=ROT_HI, lid=0.0, plunger=0.0)
    _, unlocked_peak, unlocked_end = _apply_joint_torque(model, data, &quot;j_lid&quot;, 0.6)

    assert locked_peak &lt; 0.0065
    assert locked_end &lt; 0.0045
    assert unlocked_peak &gt; 1.70
    assert unlocked_end &gt; 1.70


def test_open_lid_physically_blocks_locking_but_closed_lid_does_not(mechanism):
    model, data = mechanism

    _prepare(model, data, rotor=ROT_HI, lid=0.0, plunger=0.0)
    closed_low, _, closed_end = _apply_joint_torque(
        model, data, &quot;j_rotor&quot;, -0.20, steps=2400)

    _prepare(model, data, rotor=ROT_HI, lid=LID_OPEN, plunger=0.022)
    open_low, _, open_end = _apply_joint_torque(
        model, data, &quot;j_rotor&quot;, -0.20, steps=2400)

    assert closed_low &lt; 0.05
    assert closed_end &lt; 0.05
    assert open_low &gt; 0.60
    assert open_end &gt; 0.60
    assert data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_plunger&quot;)] &gt; 0.020


def test_key_drives_rotor_and_bolt_slave_without_leaving_keyway(mechanism):
    model, data = mechanism
    _prepare(model, data, rotor=0.0, lid=0.0, plunger=0.0, key_out=False)
    key = model.body(&quot;key&quot;).id
    keyway = model.site(&quot;keyway&quot;).id
    axis = data.body(&quot;case&quot;).xmat.reshape(3, 3)[:, 0]

    for _ in range(round(4000 * .002 / model.opt.timestep)):
        data.xfrc_applied[key, :3] = -.12 * axis
        data.xfrc_applied[key, 3:] = 0.12 * axis
        mujoco.mj_step(model, data)
    data.xfrc_applied[:] = 0

    rotor = float(data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_rotor&quot;)])
    bolt = float(data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_bolt_slide&quot;)])
    assert rotor &gt; 1.50
    assert bolt &gt; 0.029
    assert np.all(np.abs(data.xpos[key] - data.site_xpos[keyway]) &lt; [0.022, 0.011, 0.016])


def test_depth_pin_blocks_direct_rotor_torque_without_a_seated_key(mechanism):
    model, _ = mechanism
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    _, peak, final = _apply_joint_torque(model, data, &quot;j_rotor&quot;, .12, steps=1000)
    assert peak &lt; .005
    assert abs(final) &lt; .005
    assert abs(data.qpos[_qpos(model, &quot;j_depth_pin&quot;)]) &lt; 1e-5


def _fresh_env():
    env = SimEnv(TASK, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    return env


def _set_lock(env, rotor):
    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_rotor&quot;)] = rotor
    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_bolt_slide&quot;)] = BOLT_TRAVEL * rotor / ROT_HI
    _seat_key(env.model, env.data, rotor)


def _set_coins_inside(env, count=6):
    cavity = env.data.site(&quot;cavity&quot;).xpos.copy()
    for coin in range(count):
        qpos = env.model.jnt_qposadr[env.model.body(f&quot;coin{coin}&quot;).jntadr[0]]
        env.data.qpos[qpos : qpos + 3] = cavity + [
            0.036 * (coin % 3 - 1),
            0.030 * (coin // 3 - 0.5),
            0.006,
        ]
        env.data.qpos[qpos + 3 : qpos + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]


def _forward_and_check(env, repeats=3):
    env.data.qvel[:] = 0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    for _ in range(repeats):
        env._check(env)


def test_four_stage_sequence_rejects_three_coins_and_accepts_five():
    env = _fresh_env()
    check = env._check
    assert (check.at, check.dead) == (0, False)

    _set_lock(env, 0.0)
    _forward_and_check(env)
    assert (check.at, check.dead) == (1, False)

    _set_lock(env, 1.56)
    _forward_and_check(env)
    assert (check.at, check.dead) == (2, False)

    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_lid&quot;)] = 1.70
    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_plunger&quot;)] = 0.022
    _set_coins_inside(env, 3)
    _forward_and_check(env)
    assert (check.at, check.dead) == (2, False)

    _set_coins_inside(env, 5)
    _forward_and_check(env)
    assert (check.at, check.dead) == (3, False)

    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_lid&quot;)] = 0.0
    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_plunger&quot;)] = 0.0
    _set_lock(env, 0.0)
    _forward_and_check(env)
    assert (check.at, check.dead) == (4, False)


def test_randomized_key_starts_flat_on_table_with_independent_yaw():
    headings = []
    for seed in range(12):
        env = SimEnv(TASK, seed=seed)
        env.reset(seed=seed, randomize_init=True)
        key = env.data.body(&quot;key&quot;)
        case = env.data.body(&quot;case&quot;)
        rotation = key.xmat.reshape(3, 3)
        headings.append(float(np.arctan2(rotation[1, 0], rotation[0, 0])))
        assert key.xpos[2] == pytest.approx(CASE_POS[2] + 0.006, abs=0.001)
        assert abs(rotation[2, 1]) &gt; 0.98
        assert np.linalg.norm(key.xpos[:2] - case.xpos[:2]) &gt;= 0.18 - 1e-6
        assert key.xpos[1] &lt; case.xpos[1] - 0.15
    assert np.ptp(np.unwrap(sorted(headings))) &gt; np.deg2rad(90)


def test_partial_wrong_order_brush_is_forgiven_not_permanently_dead():
    env = _fresh_env()
    env.data.qpos[_qpos(env.model, &quot;j_lid&quot;)] = 0.05
    _set_lock(env, 0.40)
    _forward_and_check(env)
    assert (env._check.at, env._check.dead) == (0, False)

Direct pad and coin contact fixtures hold the engaged rotor. The rotor drives the lid bolt, and the separate lid plunger prevents relocking with the lid open. @pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;q0,target_pos,target_euler,expected&quot;, [
    pytest.param(
        [1.9739983787759254, -0.27041572686230403, -1.3670175668588296,
         -2.421531146521584, -2.897153939643744, 2.316703164764432,
         1.9767882756770085],
        [-0.1050, -0.0746, 1.2500],
        [-1.56 - np.pi, -0.06, 2.37],
        False,
        id=&quot;free_space_branch_flip&quot;,
    ),
    pytest.param(
        [0.6114371318788033, 0.8518804283835558, 0.36223387077778324,
         -1.9017305712842716, -1.6302688883831606, 1.3043718969531366,
         2.0114067431041134],
        [-0.1329, 0.2582, 1.0088],
        [-1.57 - np.pi, -0.08, 0.80],
        True,
        id=&quot;reachable_contact_stop&quot;,
    ),
])
def test_reaches_replays_recorded_drawer_paths(q0, target_pos, target_euler, expected):
    env = SimEnv(task=&quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot;, seed=1000008)
    env.reset(seed=1000008)

    ok, _, _ = env.ctl.reaches(
        env.arms[0], np.asarray(target_pos), np.asarray(target_euler), q0=np.asarray(q0))

    assert ok is expected

def _states():
    raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(&quot;&quot;.join(_STATE_B64.split())))
    return np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=&quot;&lt;f4&quot;).reshape(len(CASES), 100)


def _red_states():
    raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(&quot;&quot;.join(_RED_STATE_B64.split())))
    return np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=&quot;&lt;f4&quot;).reshape(len(RED_CASES), 100)


def _restore(env, row):
    m, d = env.model, env.data
    i = 0
    d.time = float(row[i])
    i += 1
    d.qpos[:] = row[i:i + m.nq]
    i += m.nq
    d.qvel[:] = row[i:i + m.nv]
    i += m.nv
    d.ctrl[:] = row[i:i + m.nu]
    d.qacc_warmstart[:] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    arm = env.arms[0]
    env.ik[arm].q_des = d.qpos[env.ik[arm].qadr].copy()
    env.curr_gripper_open[arm] = 1
    env.num_step = 0
    env.max_len = 10**9
    env.phase = Phase.RUNNING


def _under(model, body, root):
    while body &gt; 0:
        if body == root:
            return True
        body = int(model.body_parentid[body])
    return False


def _arm_touches_cabinet(env, arm):
    root = env.model.body(&quot;wooden_cabinet_1_main&quot;).id
    return any(
        _under(env.model, int(env.model.geom_bodyid[g]), root)
        for g in env.ctl._arm_contacts(arm)
    )


def _cabinet_motion(env, action):
    root = env.model.body(&quot;wooden_cabinet_1_main&quot;).id
    start = env.data.xpos[root].copy()
    maximum = 0.0
    original = env._step_physics

    def step():
        nonlocal maximum
        original()
        maximum = max(maximum, float(np.linalg.norm(env.data.xpos[root] - start)))

    env._step_physics = step
    try:
        action()
    finally:
        env._step_physics = original
    return maximum * 1000.0


def test_home_pose_config_is_exact_fk_and_does_not_mutate_live_state():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    arm = env.arms[0]
    qpos = env.data.qpos.copy()
    pos, euler = env.ctl.home_pose(arm)

    bot = InteractiveBot.__new__(InteractiveBot)
    bot.env = env
    bot._ui_z_offset = float(env.pc[&quot;z_offset&quot;])
    pose = bot.collect_home_poses()[arm]

    np.testing.assert_array_equal(env.data.qpos, qpos)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(
        bot.transform_uiframe_to_robotframe(
            np.asarray(pose[&quot;fingertip_pos_ui&quot;]).reshape(1, 3)).squeeze(),
        pos,
        atol=1e-12,
    )
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pose[&quot;ee_euler_ui&quot;], euler + [np.pi, 0.0, 0.0])
    assert not hasattr(env.ctl, &quot;go_home&quot;)
    assert hasattr(env.ctl, &quot;_reconfigure_home&quot;)


def test_all_red_archived_homes_use_joint_fallback(monkeypatch):
    env = SimEnv(&quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    env._check = lambda _env: False
    arm = env.arms[0]
    target_pos, target_euler = env.ctl.home_pose(arm)
    ik = env.ik[arm]

    def reject_straight(*_args, **_kwargs):
        pytest.fail(&quot;red home called the straight move&quot;)

    monkeypatch.setattr(env.ctl, &quot;move_to&quot;, reject_straight)
    seen = []
    for ident, row in zip(RED_CASES, _red_states(), strict=True):
        _restore(env, row)
        assert not env.ctl.reaches(arm, target_pos, target_euler)[0], ident
        gripper_ctrl = env.data.ctrl[env._grip_act[arm]].copy()

        env.ctl.home(arm)

        seen.append(ident)
        assert 100 &lt;= env.num_step &lt;= 200, ident
        np.testing.assert_allclose(ik.q_des, ik.q_home, atol=1e-12)
        if env.num_step &lt; 200:
            assert np.max(np.abs(env.data.qpos[ik.qadr] - ik.q_home)) &lt; env.ctl.HOME_TOL, ident
        np.testing.assert_allclose(env.data.ctrl[ik.act], ik.q_home, atol=1e-12)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(env.data.ctrl[env._grip_act[arm]], gripper_ctrl)
        assert env.curr_gripper_open[arm] == 1
    assert seen == list(RED_CASES)


def test_only_the_home_flag_uses_controller_home(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    env = SimEnv(&quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot;, seed=0)
    arm = env.arms[0]
    homes, moves = [], []
    monkeypatch.setattr(env.ctl, &quot;home&quot;, lambda *a, **k: homes.append((a, k)))
    monkeypatch.setattr(env, &quot;move_to&quot;, lambda *a, **k: moves.append((a, k)))
    bot = InteractiveBot.__new__(InteractiveBot)
    bot.env = env
    bot.demo_folder = str(tmp_path)
    bot._ui_z_offset = float(env.pc[&quot;z_offset&quot;])
    bot._rec_paused = True
    bot._rec_stopped = False
    bot.recorder = SimpleNamespace(waypoint_idx=0)
    ui = bot.collect_home_poses()[arm]
    x, y, z = ui[&quot;fingertip_pos_ui&quot;]
    e0, e1, e2 = ui[&quot;ee_euler_ui&quot;]
    cmd = {&quot;arm&quot;: arm, &quot;gripper_open&quot;: 1.0, &quot;position&quot;: {&quot;x&quot;: x, &quot;y&quot;: y, &quot;z&quot;: z},
           &quot;orientation&quot;: {&quot;x&quot;: e0, &quot;y&quot;: e2, &quot;z&quot;: -e1}}

    bot.apply_waypoint_mode({**cmd, &quot;home&quot;: True})
    bot.apply_waypoint_mode(cmd)

    assert len(homes) == 1 and len(moves) == 1
    (called_arm, jaw), kw = homes[0]
    assert called_arm == arm and jaw == 1.0 and kw[&quot;recorder&quot;] is None and callable(kw[&quot;stream_fn&quot;])


def test_archived_disturbed_green_homes_use_straight_waypoints(monkeypatch):
    env = SimEnv(&quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    env._check = lambda _env: False
    arm = env.arms[0]
    target_pos, target_euler = env.ctl.home_pose(arm)
    results = {}

    def reject_fallback(*_args, **_kwargs):
        pytest.fail(&quot;green home called the joint fallback&quot;)

    monkeypatch.setattr(env.ctl, &quot;_reconfigure_home&quot;, reject_fallback)

    for ident, row in zip(CASES, _states(), strict=True):
        _restore(env, row)
        cabinet_contact = _arm_touches_cabinet(env, arm)
        green = env.ctl.reaches(arm, target_pos, target_euler)[0]
        if not green:
            results[ident] = (False, cabinet_contact, None, None)
            continue
        straight_mm = _cabinet_motion(
            env, lambda: env.ctl.home(arm))
        straight_steps = env.num_step

        _restore(env, row)
        start = env.observe_proprio(arm)
        start_rot = R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, start.eef_euler)
        idle_mm = _cabinet_motion(
            env,
            lambda: [env.ctl._hold_pose(start.eef_pos, start_rot, 1, arm)
                     for _ in range(straight_steps)],
        )
        results[ident] = (green, cabinet_contact, straight_mm, idle_mm)

    red = {ident for ident, (green, *_rest) in results.items() if not green}
    assert red == {(&quot;GO&quot;, 8, 7), (&quot;GS&quot;, 7, 47)}

    hooked = {
        ident
        for ident, (green, contact, straight_mm, _idle_mm) in results.items()
        if green and contact and straight_mm &gt;= 10.0
    }
    assert hooked == {
        (&quot;GO&quot;, 1, 24),
        (&quot;GO&quot;, 1, 28),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 8, 10),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 8, 36),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 9, 28),
    }

    falling = results[(&quot;GS&quot;, 7, 48)]
    assert falling[0] and not falling[1]
    assert falling[2] &gt;= 10.0 and falling[3] &gt;= 10.0
    assert abs(falling[2] - falling[3]) &lt; 1.0

    eligible = {
        ident
        for ident, (green, contact, _straight_mm, idle_mm) in results.items()
        if green and not contact and idle_mm &lt; 10.0
    }
    assert eligible == {
        (&quot;GO&quot;, 1, 5),
        (&quot;GO&quot;, 1, 42),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 3, 30),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 4, 14),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 8, 18),
        (&quot;GS&quot;, 9, 1),
    }
    for ident in eligible:
        assert results[ident][2] &lt; 10.0, f&quot;{ident}: straight home moved the cabinet&quot;


def test_libero_open_drawer_region_specific():
    if not (TASKS / &quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot; / &quot;task.json&quot;).exists():
        pytest.skip(&quot;libero/open_middle_drawer_halfway pack not materialized&quot;)
    env = SimEnv(&quot;open_middle_drawer_halfway&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    spec = env.spec[&quot;success&quot;]
    assert spec[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;joint_in&quot;
    check, _ = make_checker(spec)
    assert check(env) is False

    open_q = (spec[&quot;lo&quot;] + spec[&quot;hi&quot;]) / 2
    top = env.model.joint(&quot;wooden_cabinet_1_top_level&quot;).qposadr[0]
    mid = env.model.joint(spec[&quot;joint&quot;]).qposadr[0]
    env.data.qpos[top] = open_q
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False
    env.data.qpos[top] = 0.0
    env.data.qpos[mid] = open_q
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True

<details><summary><code>tasks/organize_table_and_plug_in_charger/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of organize table and plug in charger.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask


def tips_in(a, b, tips, z_below):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;both blade tips of {a} less than {z_below} m above the base of {b}&quot;&quot;&quot;
    def check(env):
        base = env.data.body(b)
        return all((base.xmat.reshape(3, 3).T @ (env.data.geom(t).xpos - base.xpos))[2] &lt; z_below for t in tips)
    return check


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the headphones and place them on the stand&#x27;,
                lambda s: ((s.in_bbox(a=&#x27;headphones&#x27;, b=&#x27;headset_stand&#x27;)) and s.robot_clear(bodies=[&#x27;headphones&#x27;]))),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the charger and plug it into the socket&#x27;,
                lambda s: ((s.touching(a=&#x27;charger&#x27;, b=&#x27;socket&#x27;)
                    and s.in_bbox(a=&#x27;charger&#x27;, b=&#x27;socket&#x27;)
                    and s.tips_in(a=&#x27;charger&#x27;, b=&#x27;socket&#x27;, tips=[&#x27;charger_tip_0&#x27;, &#x27;charger_tip_1&#x27;], z_below=0.013)
                    and s.axis_up(obj=&#x27;charger&#x27;, axis=[0, 1, 0], tol_deg=20))
                and s.robot_clear(bodies=[&#x27;charger&#x27;]))),
    ] + [Subtask(f&#x27;{k} pen{&quot;s&quot; * (k &gt; 1)} in the holder&#x27;, lambda s, k=k: pens(s) &gt;= k) for k in (1, 2, 3)] + [
        Subtask(&#x27;4 pens in the holder&#x27;, lambda s: s.success()),
    ]


def pens(s):
    return sum(s.in_bbox(a=p, b=&#x27;holder&#x27;) and s.depth_in(a=p, b=&#x27;holder&#x27;, z_threshold=0.04) and s.robot_clear(bodies=[p])
               for p in (&#x27;pen0&#x27;, &#x27;pen1&#x27;, &#x27;pen2&#x27;, &#x27;pen3&#x27;))
</pre></details>

## pack tools into toolboxes

There are two conveyor belts, one carrying tools and the other carrying boxes with cutouts for them. Use both arms to seat every tool in its matching cutout so both boxes are fully packed, then open both grippers and bring both arms back where they started. The task is complete once two boxes are fully packed.

<details><summary><code>tasks/pack_tools_into_toolboxes/dynamics.py</code> (14 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;The conveyor belts of pack tools into toolboxes.

The pack tools conveyor: belts that carry tools and toolboxes in, release a dealt queue, and either wrap riders
back to the start or (`exit: remove`) carry a toolbox off stage with its contents. task.json&#x27;s `conveyor` declares
the belt body, axis, speed, start, end, spawn queue and exit mode.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import _bbox_world, _footprint_hull, _hull_contains_xy

OFF_STAGE_SHIFT_M = 10.0


class Dynamics:
    def __init__(self, env):
        self.cfg = env.spec[&quot;conveyor&quot;]
        self.spawn_schedule, self.exit_poses, self.off_stage = (), {}, {}
        self.contype, self.conaffinity = env.model.geom_contype.copy(), env.model.geom_conaffinity.copy()

    def restore(self, env):
        axis = np.asarray(self.cfg[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
        axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
        beyond = float(self.cfg[&quot;end&quot;]) + OFF_STAGE_SHIFT_M / 2
        self.off_stage = {}
        for name in env._free_objects:
            a = env._obj_qadr[name]
            if float(env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] @ axis) &gt; beyond:
                self.off_stage[name] = env.data.qpos[a:a + 7].copy()
        self.sync_contacts(env)

    def sync_contacts(self, env):
        m = env.model
        for name in env._free_objects:
            g = env._subtree_geoms(name)
            on = name not in self.off_stage
            m.geom_contype[g] = self.contype[g] * on
            m.geom_conaffinity[g] = self.conaffinity[g] * on

    def deal(self, env):
        cfg = self.cfg.get(&quot;spawn&quot;) if self.cfg else None
        self.off_stage = {}
        if cfg is None:
            self.spawn_schedule = ()
            self.exit_poses = {}
            return
        axis = np.asarray(self.cfg[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
        axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis) or 1.0
        initial = cfg.get(&quot;initial&quot;)
        queue = cfg[&quot;queue&quot;]
        jitter, case_yaws_deg = cfg.get(&quot;jitter&quot;), cfg.get(&quot;box_yaw_deg&quot;)
        lateral = np.cross([0.0, 0.0, 1.0], axis)
        tools = set(initial[&quot;shuffle&quot;] if initial is not None else ()) | set(queue[&quot;poses&quot;])
        cases = set(initial[&quot;phase&quot;][&quot;items&quot;] if initial is not None else ()) | set(cfg[&quot;items&quot;])

        def dealt(pose, body):
            pose = np.array(pose, float)
            if jitter and body in tools:
                pose[:3] += lateral * env._rng.uniform(-jitter[&quot;lateral&quot;], jitter[&quot;lateral&quot;])
                yaw = np.radians(env._rng.uniform(-jitter[&quot;yaw_deg&quot;], jitter[&quot;yaw_deg&quot;]))
            elif case_yaws_deg and body in cases:
                yaw = np.radians(float(env._rng.choice(case_yaws_deg)))
            else:
                return pose
            turn = np.array([np.cos(yaw / 2), 0.0, 0.0, np.sin(yaw / 2)])
            mujoco.mju_mulQuat(pose[3:7], turn, pose[3:7].copy())
            return pose
        if self.cfg.get(&quot;exit&quot;) == &quot;remove&quot;:
            removable = list(initial[&quot;shuffle&quot;] if initial is not None else ())
            removable += list(queue[&quot;poses&quot;])
            self.exit_poses = {
                body: env.data.qpos[
                    env._obj_qadr[body]:env._obj_qadr[body] + 7].copy()
                for body in removable
            }
        else:
            self.exit_poses = {}
        initial_schedule = []
        if initial is not None:
            bodies = list(initial[&quot;shuffle&quot;])
            if self.cfg.get(&quot;exit&quot;) == &quot;remove&quot;:
                for body in bodies:
                    a = env._obj_qadr[body]
                    env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = env.model.qpos0[a:a + 7]
            stations = [float(
                env.data.qpos[env._obj_qadr[b]:env._obj_qadr[b] + 3] @ axis)
                for b in bodies]
            order = [bodies[int(i)] for i in env._rng.permutation(len(bodies))]
            phase = float(env._rng.uniform(*initial[&quot;phase&quot;][&quot;range&quot;]))
            pitched = &quot;spacing&quot; in initial and bool(self.exit_poses)
            if pitched:
                leader = order[0]
                pos = env.data.qpos[
                    env._obj_qadr[leader]:env._obj_qadr[leader] + 3]
                pos += axis * (max(stations) - float(pos @ axis))
                for body in order[1:]:
                    a = env._obj_qadr[body]
                    env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = self.exit_poses[body]
                phase_items = [
                    body for body in initial[&quot;phase&quot;][&quot;items&quot;] if body not in bodies]
                phase_items.append(leader)
            else:
                for body, station in zip(order, stations):
                    a = env._obj_qadr[body]
                    pos = env.data.qpos[a:a + 3]
                    pos += axis * (station - float(pos @ axis))
                    env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = dealt(env.data.qpos[a:a + 7], body)
                phase_items = initial[&quot;phase&quot;][&quot;items&quot;]
            for body in phase_items:
                a, dof = env._obj_qadr[body], env._obj_dofadr[body]
                env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] += axis * phase
                env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = dealt(env.data.qpos[a:a + 7], body)
                env.data.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
            env.forward()
            if pitched:
                spacing = float(initial[&quot;spacing&quot;])
                lead = float(env.data.qpos[
                    env._obj_qadr[leader]:env._obj_qadr[leader] + 3] @ axis)
                first = spacing - (lead - float(self.cfg[&quot;start&quot;]))
                if first &lt; 0:
                    raise ValueError(&quot;initial conveyor leader is more than one pitch past start&quot;)
                initial_schedule = [
                    (first + (i - 1) * spacing, body,
                     dealt(env.model.qpos0[env._obj_qadr[body]:
                                            env._obj_qadr[body] + 7], body))
                    for i, body in enumerate(order[1:], 1)
                ]
        after = float(cfg[&quot;after&quot;])
        schedule = initial_schedule
        schedule += [(after, body, dealt(pose, body)) for body, pose in cfg[&quot;items&quot;].items()]
        order = list(queue[&quot;poses&quot;])
        if queue[&quot;shuffle&quot;]:
            order = [order[int(i)] for i in env._rng.permutation(len(order))]
        spacing = float(queue[&quot;spacing&quot;])
        schedule += [(float(queue[&quot;after&quot;]) + i * spacing, body, dealt(queue[&quot;poses&quot;][body], body))
                     for i, body in enumerate(order)]
        self.spawn_schedule = tuple(
            (distance, body, np.asarray(pose, float),
             env.data.qpos[env._obj_qadr[body]:env._obj_qadr[body] + 3].copy())
            for distance, body, pose in sorted(schedule))

    def spawn(self, env, c, axis):
        if not self.spawn_schedule:
            return
        travelled = max(0.0, (float(env.data.time) - env.episode_t0) * float(c[&quot;speed&quot;]))
        for distance, body, authored, parked in self.spawn_schedule:
            a, dof = env._obj_qadr[body], env._obj_dofadr[body]
            if body in self.exit_poses \
                    and travelled &gt;= distance + float(c[&quot;end&quot;]) - float(c[&quot;start&quot;]):
                continue
            if distance &gt; travelled or np.linalg.norm(
                    env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] - parked) &gt; 0.02:
                continue
            pose = authored.copy()
            pose[:3] += axis * (float(c[&quot;start&quot;]) - float(np.dot(pose[:3], axis)))
            candidate = _bbox_world(env, body) + pose[:3] - env.data.qpos[a:a + 3]
            if self.entry_occupied(env, candidate, {body}):
                break
            env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = pose
            env.data.qvel[dof:dof + 3] = axis * float(c[&quot;speed&quot;])
            env.data.qvel[dof + 3:dof + 6] = 0.0

    def physics_step(self, env):
        c = self.cfg
        axis = np.asarray(c[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
        axis = axis / (np.linalg.norm(axis) or 1.0)
        self.spawn(env, c, axis)
        belt = {int(g) for g in env._subtree_geoms(c[&quot;body&quot;])}
        m, d, root = env.model, env.data, env.model.body_rootid
        for name, pose in self.off_stage.items():
            a, dof = env._obj_qadr[name], env._obj_dofadr[name]
            d.qpos[a:a + 7] = pose
            d.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
        free = {m.body(name).id for name in env._free_objects}
        riding, slab = {}, {}
        held = set()
        for k in range(d.ncon):
            con = d.contact[k]
            g1, g2 = int(con.geom1), int(con.geom2)
            b1, b2 = int(root[m.geom_bodyid[g1]]), int(root[m.geom_bodyid[g2]])
            on1, on2 = g1 in belt, g2 in belt
            if on1 != on2:
                body, belt_geom = (b2, g1) if on1 else (b1, g2)
                if body in free:
                    riding[body] = max(riding.get(body, 0.0),
                                       float(m.geom_friction[belt_geom, 0]))
                    slab[body] = belt_geom
            elif not on1:
                r1 = m.body(b1).name.startswith(env.robot_prefix)
                if r1 != m.body(b2).name.startswith(env.robot_prefix):
                    body = b2 if r1 else b1
                    if body in free:
                        held.add(body)
        for body in held:
            riding.pop(body, None)

        carrier_groups = []
        if self.exit_poses:
            for name in env._free_objects:
                if name in self.exit_poses:
                    continue
                geoms = np.fromiter(env._subtree_geoms(name), dtype=int)
                sphere_edge = np.max(
                    d.geom_xpos[geoms] @ axis + m.geom_rbound[geoms])
                if sphere_edge &gt; c[&quot;end&quot;] \
                        and float(np.max(_bbox_world(env, name) @ axis)) &gt; c[&quot;end&quot;]:
                    carrier_groups.append(self.carry_group(env, name, held))
        contained = {name for group in carrier_groups for name in group
                     if name in self.exit_poses}
        for name in contained:
            riding.pop(m.body(name).id, None)

        gravity = float(np.linalg.norm(m.opt.gravity))
        for name in env._free_objects:
            body = m.body(name).id
            applied = d.xfrc_applied[body, :3]
            applied -= axis * float(np.dot(applied, axis))
            if body not in riding:
                continue
            dof = env._obj_dofadr[name]
            v = d.qvel[dof:dof + 3]
            along = float(np.dot(v, axis))
            mass = float(m.body_subtreemass[body])
            gain = mass / m.opt.timestep
            limit = riding[body] * mass * gravity
            target = c.get(&quot;slab_speeds&quot;, {}).get(m.geom(slab[body]).name, c[&quot;speed&quot;])
            force = float(np.clip(gain * (float(target) - along), -limit, limit))
            applied += axis * force
        wrapped = set()
        for name in env._free_objects:
            a = env._obj_qadr[name]
            if m.body(name).id not in riding or name in wrapped or name in self.off_stage \
                    or float(np.dot(d.qpos[a:a + 3], axis)) &lt;= c[&quot;end&quot;]:
                continue
            if name in self.exit_poses:
                if any(name in group for group in carrier_groups):
                    continue
                dof = env._obj_dofadr[name]
                d.qpos[a:a + 7] = self.exit_poses[name]
                d.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
                d.xfrc_applied[m.body(name).id] = 0.0
                wrapped.add(name)
                continue
            group = self.carry_group(env, name, held) - wrapped
            if c.get(&quot;exit&quot;) == &quot;remove&quot;:
                for n in group:
                    qa, dof = env._obj_qadr[n], env._obj_dofadr[n]
                    d.qpos[qa:qa + 3] += axis * OFF_STAGE_SHIFT_M
                    d.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
                    d.xfrc_applied[m.body(n).id] = 0.0
                    self.off_stage[n] = d.qpos[qa:qa + 7].copy()
                self.sync_contacts(env)
                wrapped |= group
                continue
            group_box = np.vstack([_bbox_world(env, n) for n in group])
            start_shift = axis * (float(c[&quot;start&quot;])
                                  - float(np.dot(d.qpos[a:a + 3], axis)))
            target = c[&quot;end&quot;] if self.entry_occupied(env, 
                group_box + start_shift, group) else c[&quot;start&quot;]
            shift = axis * (float(target) - float(np.dot(d.qpos[a:a + 3], axis)))
            for n in group:
                qa, dof = env._obj_qadr[n], env._obj_dofadr[n]
                d.qpos[qa:qa + 3] += shift
                d.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
            wrapped |= group

    def carry_group(self, env, name, held):
        box = _bbox_world(env, name)
        hull = _footprint_hull(box)
        group = {name}
        m, d, root = env.model, env.data, env.model.body_rootid
        carrier = m.body(name).id
        carrier_geoms = {int(g) for g in env._subtree_geoms(name)}
        belt_geoms = ({int(g) for g in env._subtree_geoms(self.cfg[&quot;body&quot;])}
                      if self.cfg else set())
        free = {m.body(other).id for other in env._free_objects}
        supported_elsewhere = set()
        for contact in d.contact[:d.ncon]:
            g1, g2 = int(contact.geom1), int(contact.geom2)
            b1 = int(root[m.geom_bodyid[g1]])
            b2 = int(root[m.geom_bodyid[g2]])
            for candidate, external in ((b1, g2), (b2, g1)):
                if candidate == carrier or candidate not in free:
                    continue
                external_root = int(root[m.geom_bodyid[external]])
                if external in carrier_geoms or external in belt_geoms \
                        or external_root in free \
                        or m.body(external_root).name.startswith(env.robot_prefix):
                    continue
                supported_elsewhere.add(candidate)
        for other in env._free_objects:
            if other == name or other not in self.exit_poses \
                    or m.body(other).id in held:
                continue
            p = d.xpos[m.body(other).id]
            if m.body(other).id not in supported_elsewhere \
                    and _hull_contains_xy(hull, p[:2]) \
                    and box[:, 2].min() &lt; p[2] &lt; box[:, 2].max():
                group.add(other)
        return group

    def entry_occupied(self, env, candidate, excluded):
        gmin, gmax = np.min(candidate, axis=0), np.max(candidate, axis=0)
        for other in env._free_objects:
            if other in excluded:
                continue
            box = _bbox_world(env, other)
            omin, omax = np.min(box, axis=0), np.max(box, axis=0)
            if np.all(gmax &gt;= omin) and np.all(omax &gt;= gmin):
                return True
        return False

    def over(self, env) -&gt; bool:
        c = self.cfg
        spawn = c.get(&quot;spawn&quot;) if c else None
        if not spawn or c.get(&quot;exit&quot;) != &quot;remove&quot;:
            return False
        initial = spawn.get(&quot;initial&quot;) or {}
        cases = set((initial.get(&quot;phase&quot;) or {}).get(&quot;items&quot;, ())) | set(spawn.get(&quot;items&quot;, {}))
        return bool(cases) and cases &lt;= set(self.off_stage)

<details><summary><code>tasks/pack_tools_into_toolboxes/test.py</code> (10 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the pack_tools_into_toolboxes task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np
import pytest
from core.sim_env import SimEnv


@pytest.fixture()
def toolbox_conveyor():
    e = SimEnv(&quot;pack_tools_into_toolboxes&quot;, seed=0)
    e.reset(seed=0)
    e.max_len = 10 ** 9
    return e


def _put_tool_past_conveyor_end(env, name):
    axis = np.asarray(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
    axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
    a, dof = env._obj_qadr[name], env._obj_dofadr[name]
    kind = name[:-1]
    pose = np.asarray(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;spawn&quot;][&quot;queue&quot;][&quot;poses&quot;][f&quot;{kind}1&quot;], float).copy()
    pose[:3] += axis * (float(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;end&quot;]) + 0.005 - pose[:3] @ axis)
    pose[2] -= 0.0005
    env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = pose
    env.data.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    belt = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;body&quot;])))
    tool = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(name)))
    assert any((int(c.geom1) in belt and int(c.geom2) in tool)
               or (int(c.geom2) in belt and int(c.geom1) in tool)
               for c in env.data.contact[:env.data.ncon])


def test_toolbox_conveyor_remove_is_one_way(toolbox_conveyor):
    env, name = toolbox_conveyor, &quot;hammer1&quot;
    park = env.dynamics.exit_poses[name].copy()
    distance = next(d for d, body, _pose, _park in env.dynamics.spawn_schedule
                    if body == name)
    span = float(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;end&quot;]) - float(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;start&quot;])
    env.data.time = env.episode_t0 + (distance + span + 0.01) / env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;speed&quot;]
    _put_tool_past_conveyor_end(env, name)

    env._step_physics()
    np.testing.assert_allclose(env.data.qpos[env._obj_qadr[name]:env._obj_qadr[name] + 7],
                               park, atol=2e-3)
    for _ in range(50):
        env._step_physics()
    np.testing.assert_allclose(env.data.qpos[env._obj_qadr[name]:env._obj_qadr[name] + 3],
                               park[:3], atol=2e-3)


def test_toolbox_conveyor_seated_rider_leaves_with_box(toolbox_conveyor):
    env = toolbox_conveyor
    env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;speed&quot;] = 0.01
    axis = np.asarray(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
    axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
    tray, tool = &quot;toolbox0&quot;, &quot;tape_measure1&quot;
    ta, td = env._obj_qadr[tray], env._obj_dofadr[tray]
    tray_pose = env.model.qpos0[ta:ta + 7].copy()
    tray_pose[:3] += axis * (float(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;end&quot;]) - 0.050
                             - float(tray_pose[:3] @ axis))
    tray_pose[2] += 0.005
    env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 7] = tray_pose
    env.data.qvel[td:td + 6] = 0.0

    pa, pd = env._obj_qadr[tool], env._obj_dofadr[tool]
    tool_pose = np.asarray(
        env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;spawn&quot;][&quot;queue&quot;][&quot;poses&quot;][tool], float).copy()
    tool_pose[:2] = tray_pose[:2]
    tool_pose[:3] += axis * 0.075
    env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 7] = tool_pose
    env.data.qvel[pd:pd + 6] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert tool in env.dynamics.carry_group(env, tray, set())
    belt = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;body&quot;])))
    root = env.model.body_rootid
    riding = set()
    for con in env.data.contact[:env.data.ncon]:
        g1, g2 = int(con.geom1), int(con.geom2)
        if (g1 in belt) != (g2 in belt):
            riding.add(int(root[env.model.geom_bodyid[g2 if g1 in belt else g1]]))
    assert env.model.body(tool).id not in riding
    assert env.model.body(tray).id not in riding

    rel = env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 3] - env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3]
    env.dynamics.physics_step(env)
    force = env.data.xfrc_applied[env.model.body(tool).id, :3]
    assert float(force @ axis) == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(
        env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 3] - env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3], rel, atol=1e-9)
    assert np.linalg.norm(env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 3]
                          - env.dynamics.exit_poses[tool][:3]) &gt; 1.0

    env.data.qpos[ta + 2] -= 0.005
    rel = env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 3] - env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3]
    shift = axis * 0.055
    env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3] += shift
    env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 3] += shift
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    before = float(env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3] @ axis)
    unparked = env.checkpoint()
    env.dynamics.physics_step(env)

    assert float(env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3] @ axis) == pytest.approx(before + 10.0, abs=0.01)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(
        env.data.qpos[pa:pa + 3] - env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 3], rel, atol=1e-9)
    assert {tray, tool} &lt;= set(env.dynamics.off_stage)
    assert not env.scene_over
    gone = env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 7].copy()
    for _ in range(40):
        env._step_physics()
    np.testing.assert_allclose(env.data.qpos[ta:ta + 7], gone, atol=1e-5)

    other = &quot;toolbox1&quot;
    oa, od = env._obj_qadr[other], env._obj_dofadr[other]
    pose = env.model.qpos0[oa:oa + 7].copy()
    pose[:3] += axis * (float(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;end&quot;]) + 0.03 - float(pose[:3] @ axis))
    pose[2] -= 0.0005
    env.data.qpos[oa:oa + 7] = pose
    env.data.qvel[od:od + 6] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    env.dynamics.physics_step(env)
    assert other in env.dynamics.off_stage and env.scene_over
    parked_geoms = np.concatenate([env._subtree_geoms(n) for n in (tray, tool, other)])
    assert not env.model.geom_contype[parked_geoms].any()

    env.restore(unparked)
    assert not env.dynamics.off_stage and not env.scene_over
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(env.model.geom_contype, env.dynamics.contype)

    env.dynamics.physics_step(env)
    env.reset(seed=1)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(env.model.geom_contype, env.dynamics.contype)
    fresh = SimEnv(&quot;pack_tools_into_toolboxes&quot;, seed=1)
    fresh.reset(seed=1)
    for name in (&quot;toolbox0&quot;, &quot;toolbox1&quot;):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(env.data.body(name).xpos, fresh.data.body(name).xpos, atol=1e-6)


def test_toolbox_conveyor_static_rail_rider_does_not_leave_with_box(
        toolbox_conveyor):
    env = toolbox_conveyor
    env.dynamics.spawn_schedule = ()
    axis = np.asarray(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
    axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)

                             - float(tray_pose[:3] @ axis))

    pa, pd = env._obj_qadr[tool], env._obj_dofadr[tool]

    tool_pose = env.model.qpos0[pa:pa + 7].copy()
    tool_pose[:3] = [-0.100, tray_pose[1], rail_top + 0.01654]

def test_toolbox_conveyor_does_not_remove_held_rider(toolbox_conveyor):
    env, name, arm = toolbox_conveyor, &quot;pliers0&quot;, toolbox_conveyor.arms[0]
    env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;speed&quot;] = 0.0
    a, dof = env._obj_qadr[name], env._obj_dofadr[name]
    env.data.qpos[a:a + 7] = env.model.qpos0[a:a + 7]
    env.data.qpos[a + 1] = 0.0
    env.data.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    euler = env._home_euler[arm]
    for height, grip in ((0.12, 1), (0.006, 1), (0.006, 0)):
        env.move_to(env.data.body(name).xpos.copy() + [0.0, 0.0, height],
                    euler, grip, arm=arm)

    belt = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;body&quot;])))
    body = env.model.body(name).id
    root = env.model.body_rootid
    belt_contact = robot_contact = False
    for con in env.data.contact[:env.data.ncon]:
        g1, g2 = int(con.geom1), int(con.geom2)
        b1 = int(root[env.model.geom_bodyid[g1]])
        b2 = int(root[env.model.geom_bodyid[g2]])
        if body not in (b1, b2):
            continue
        belt_contact |= g1 in belt or g2 in belt
        other = b2 if b1 == body else b1
        robot_contact |= env.model.body(other).name.startswith(env.robot_prefix)
    assert belt_contact and robot_contact

    axis = np.asarray(env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;axis&quot;], float)
    coord = float(env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] @ axis)
    env.dynamics.cfg[&quot;end&quot;] = coord - 0.001
    before = env.data.qpos[a:a + 3].copy()
    env._step_physics()
    assert np.linalg.norm(env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] - before) &lt; 0.01
    assert np.linalg.norm(env.data.qpos[a:a + 3]
                          - env.dynamics.exit_poses[name][:3]) &gt; 1.0


def test_toolbox_conveyor_case_belt_runs_at_its_own_speed(toolbox_conveyor):

    assert travel[&quot;toolbox0&quot;] == pytest.approx(0.020, abs=0.003)

from core.grade_episode import Subtask


def lights_out(rows, cols):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Lights Out {rows}x{cols}: every button red&quot;&quot;&quot;
    return lambda env: not env.data.userdata[:rows * cols].any()


def subtasks():
    return [Subtask(&#x27;turn all 24 cells red&#x27;, lambda s: s.success(), objects=tuple(f&#x27;button_{k}&#x27; for k in range(24)), presses=True)]
</pre></details>
<details><summary><code>tasks/puzzle_4x6/dynamics.py</code> (2 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Lights Out: deals the board, toggles it on presses and paints the buttons.

The board lives in data.userdata so every saved state carries it: userdata[:n] is the board (1 for a blue button) and
userdata[n:2n] marks the buttons that were down at the last control step, so a held press toggles once. The reset RNG
deals a board that a unique press set in task.json&#x27;s `lights_out` press band turns all red, which is the goal.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import logging

import numpy as np

RGBA = np.array(((0.96, 0.26, 0.33, 1.0), (0.35, 0.55, 0.91, 1.0)))
DOWN_M = -0.02

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def toggle_matrix(rows, cols):
    n = rows * cols
    matrix = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(n):
        r, c = divmod(i, cols)
        for dr, dc in ((0, 0), (1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
            if 0 &lt;= r + dr &lt; rows and 0 &lt;= c + dc &lt; cols:
                matrix[(r + dr) * cols + c + dc, i] = 1
    return matrix


def deal(rng, rows, cols, presses):
    n = rows * cols
    lo, hi = (int(v) for v in presses)
    if not 0 &lt;= lo &lt;= hi &lt;= n:
        raise ValueError(f&quot;invalid Lights Out press band [{lo}, {hi}] for {rows}x{cols}&quot;)
    k = int(rng.integers(lo, hi + 1))
    solution = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.uint8)
    solution[np.asarray(rng.choice(n, size=k, replace=False), dtype=int)] = 1
    return ((toggle_matrix(rows, cols) @ solution) &amp; 1).tolist(), k


class Dynamics:
    def __init__(self, env):
        self.cfg = env.spec[&quot;lights_out&quot;]
        rows, cols = self.cfg[&quot;rows&quot;], self.cfg[&quot;cols&quot;]
        self.n = rows * cols
        self.toggles = toggle_matrix(rows, cols)
        self.qadr = [env.model.joint(f&quot;buttonbox_joint_{i}&quot;).qposadr[0] for i in range(self.n)]
        self.geoms = [env.model.geom(f&quot;btngeom_{i}&quot;).id for i in range(self.n)]

    def down(self, env):
        return env.data.qpos[self.qadr] &lt;= DOWN_M

    def deal(self, env):
        board, k = deal(env._rng, self.cfg[&quot;rows&quot;], self.cfg[&quot;cols&quot;], self.cfg[&quot;presses&quot;])
        env.data.userdata[:self.n] = board
        env.data.userdata[self.n:2 * self.n] = self.down(env)
        logger.info(f&quot;[lights_out] dealt {self.cfg[&#x27;rows&#x27;]}x{self.cfg[&#x27;cols&#x27;]} with unique {k}-press solution&quot;)
        self.paint(env)

    def control_step(self, env):
        board, was_down = env.data.userdata[:self.n], env.data.userdata[self.n:2 * self.n]
        down = self.down(env)
        board[:] = (board + self.toggles @ (down &amp; (was_down == 0))) % 2
        was_down[:] = down
        self.paint(env)

    def paint(self, env):
        env.model.geom_rgba[self.geoms] = RGBA[env.data.userdata[:self.n].astype(int)]

    def restore(self, env):
        self.paint(env)
</pre></details>
<details><summary><code>tasks/puzzle_4x6/test.py</code> (3 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the puzzle_4x6 task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np
import pytest
from tasks.puzzle_4x6.dynamics import RGBA, toggle_matrix
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import describe, make_checker
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
    _press,
)


@pytest.fixture(scope=&quot;module&quot;)
def puzzle_4x6():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;puzzle_4x6&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    return env


def board(env):
    return env.data.userdata[:24].astype(int).tolist()


def test_reset_redeals_deterministically_and_speaks_goal(puzzle_4x6):
    env = puzzle_4x6
    env.reset(seed=7)
    first = (board(env), env.language_instruction)
    env.reset(seed=7)
    assert (board(env), env.language_instruction) == first
    assert first[1].endswith(&quot;Make every button red.&quot;)
    env.reset(seed=8)
    assert board(env) != first[0]


def test_static_pack_description_says_goal_is_dealt():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;puzzle_4x6&quot;, seed=0)
    assert describe(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task) == [
        (0, &quot;Lights Out 4x6: every button red&quot;)]


def test_reset_paints_dealt_init_in_first_rendered_frame(puzzle_4x6):
    env = puzzle_4x6
    env.reset(seed=0)
    init = board(env)
    assert any(init)
    for i, state in enumerate(init):
        assert tuple(env.model.geom(f&quot;btngeom_{i}&quot;).rgba) == pytest.approx(RGBA[state])

    rgb = env.observe_camera(depth=False)[&quot;agentview_image&quot;]
    intrinsic = env.get_camera_intrinsics(&quot;agentview&quot;)
    world_to_camera = np.linalg.inv(env.get_camera_extrinsics(&quot;agentview&quot;))
    screen_x = []
    for i, state in enumerate(init):
        world = np.r_[env.data.site(f&quot;btntop_{i}&quot;).xpos, 1.0]
        camera = world_to_camera @ world
        pixel = intrinsic @ camera[:3]
        x, y = np.rint(pixel[:2] / pixel[2]).astype(int)
        patch = rgb[y - 2:y + 3, x - 2:x + 3].mean(axis=(0, 1))
        assert bool(patch[2] &gt; patch[0]) is bool(state), (i, state, patch)
        screen_x.append(x)

    assert screen_x[0] &lt; screen_x[5]


def test_lights_out_press_toggles_plus_shape():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;puzzle_4x6&quot;)
    before = board(env)
    _press(env, env.dynamics.control_step, &quot;buttonbox_joint_8&quot;)
    changed = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(before, board(env))) if a != b]
    assert changed == [2, 7, 8, 9, 14]
    for i in (0, 8):
        assert tuple(env.model.geom(f&quot;btngeom_{i}&quot;).rgba) == pytest.approx(RGBA[board(env)[i]])


def test_lights_out_hold_is_one_toggle():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;puzzle_4x6&quot;)
    before = board(env)
    adr = env.model.joint(&quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;).qposadr[0]
    for _ in range(10):
        env.data.qpos[adr] = -0.024
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        env.dynamics.control_step(env)
    changed = [i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(before, board(env))) if a != b]
    assert changed == [0, 1, 6]


def test_lights_out_solve_then_overshoot_and_replay_from_saved_state():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;puzzle_4x6&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    solution = (0, 5, 8, 9, 14, 15, 18, 23)
    press_bits = np.zeros(24, dtype=np.uint8)
    press_bits[list(solution)] = 1
    env.data.userdata[:24] = toggle_matrix(4, 6) @ press_bits % 2
    assert check(env) is False
    for i in solution:
        _press(env, env.dynamics.control_step, f&quot;buttonbox_joint_{i}&quot;)
    assert check(env) is True
    solved = env.sim_state()
    _press(env, env.dynamics.control_step, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False
    assert board(env)[0] == 1
    env.reset_to_sim_state(solved)
    assert check(env) is True
    assert tuple(env.model.geom(&quot;btngeom_0&quot;).rgba) == pytest.approx(RGBA[0])
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/puzzle_6x7/test.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the puzzle_6x7 task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np
import pytest
from core.sim_env import SimEnv


@pytest.fixture(scope=&quot;module&quot;)
def puzzle_6x7():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;puzzle_6x7&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    return env


def press(env, button):
    adr = env.model.joint(f&quot;buttonbox_joint_{button}&quot;).qposadr[0]
    env.data.qpos[adr] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    env.dynamics.control_step(env)
    before = env.data.userdata[:42].astype(np.uint8)
    env.data.qpos[adr] = -0.024
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    env.dynamics.control_step(env)
    after = env.data.userdata[:42].astype(np.uint8)
    env.data.qpos[adr] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    env.dynamics.control_step(env)
    return set(np.flatnonzero(before ^ after))


def test_6x7_language_camera_convention_and_corner_edge_toggles(puzzle_6x7):
    env = puzzle_6x7
    env.reset(seed=0)
    assert env.language_instruction.endswith(&quot;Make every button red.&quot;)

    intrinsic = env.get_camera_intrinsics(&quot;agentview&quot;)
    world_to_camera = np.linalg.inv(env.get_camera_extrinsics(&quot;agentview&quot;))
    screen_x = []
    for i in (0, 6):
        camera = world_to_camera @ np.r_[env.data.site(f&quot;btntop_{i}&quot;).xpos, 1.0]
        pixel = intrinsic @ camera[:3]
        screen_x.append(float(pixel[0] / pixel[2]))
    assert screen_x[0] &lt; screen_x[1], &quot;+y columns must read left-to-right in agentview&quot;

    assert press(env, 0) == {0, 1, 7}
    assert press(env, 3) == {2, 3, 4, 10}
    assert press(env, 17) == {10, 16, 17, 18, 24}
    assert press(env, 41) == {34, 40, 41}

<details><summary><code>tasks/serve_warm_drinks/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of serve warm drinks.

Door open, mug inside, door closed on it, start pressed with the mug in and
the door closed, then served on the plate.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask
from core.grade_episode import PressEdge

DOOR = {&quot;joint&quot;: &quot;microwave_1_microjoint&quot;, &quot;comparison&quot;: &quot;less_than&quot;, &quot;value&quot;: -1.3}
MUG_INSIDE = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;over_site&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;white_yellow_mug_1_main&quot;, &quot;site&quot;: &quot;microwave_1_heating_region&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: [-0.12, -0.0835, -0.09], &quot;hi&quot;: [0.12, 0.0835, 0.08]}
DOOR_CLOSED = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;microwave_1_microjoint&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: -0.05, &quot;hi&quot;: 0.0}
START = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;press_edge&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;microwave_1_start_key&quot;}


def press_edge(joint):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;joint {joint} pressed (counts once, at a quarter of its travel)&quot;&quot;&quot;
    return PressEdge(joint).update


def subtasks():
    edge = PressEdge(START[&quot;joint&quot;])

    def pressed(s):
        down = bool(edge.update(s.env))
        return down and s.tree(MUG_INSIDE) and s.tree(DOOR_CLOSED)
    door = lambda s: s.env.data.qpos[s.env.model.joint(DOOR[&quot;joint&quot;]).qposadr[0]] &lt; DOOR[&quot;value&quot;]
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;open the microwave door&#x27;, door, ever=True, objects=(DOOR[&quot;joint&quot;],)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the mug and place it inside the microwave&#x27;, lambda s: s.tree(MUG_INSIDE), ever=True, needs=(0,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;close the door&#x27;, lambda s: s.tree(MUG_INSIDE) and s.tree(DOOR_CLOSED), ever=True, needs=(1,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;press start&#x27;, pressed, ever=True, needs=(2,), objects=(START[&quot;joint&quot;],)),
        Subtask(&quot;pick the mug out of the microwave and place it on the plate to the robot&#x27;s right&quot;, lambda s: s.success(), needs=(3,), end_needs=(3,)),
    ]


def INVARIANT(s):
    return s.tree({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;white_yellow_mug_1_main&quot;, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 30})
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/serve_warm_drinks/test.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the serve_warm_drinks task.

&quot;&quot;&quot;

import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from helpers import (
    _pack_env,
)



def test_press_edge_latches_only_with_live_conditions():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    key = env.model.joint(&quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    door = env.model.joint(&quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;)
    key_adr, key_lo = key.qposadr[0], env.model.jnt_range[key.id][0]
    door_adr, door_lo = door.qposadr[0], env.model.jnt_range[door.id][0]
    closed = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: -0.001,
              &quot;hi&quot;: 0.001}
    check, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;sequence&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [closed,
                                  {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;press_edge&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;}]},
        closed,
    ]}, &quot;serve_warm_drinks&quot;)

    for door_q in (door_lo, 0.0):
        env.data.qpos[door_adr] = door_q
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        assert check(env) is False

    env.data.qpos[door_adr] = door_lo
    for key_q in (key_lo, key_lo, 0.0):
        env.data.qpos[key_adr] = key_q
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        assert check(env) is False
    env.data.qpos[door_adr] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False

    env.data.qpos[key_adr] = key_lo
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False
    env.data.qpos[key_adr] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True
</pre></details>

}

## set up pcr run

Seat the PCR plate on the block of the thermal cycler, close the lid, pull the green lever down to latch it, then turn the beige force knob on the lid to tighten it. Finish with the arm clear of the machine.

from core.grade_episode import Subtask


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the plate and seat it in the machine&#x27;,
                lambda s: (s.over_site(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, site=&#x27;plate_seat&#x27;, lo=[-0.00125, -0.00125, -0.001], hi=[0.00125, 0.00125, 0.001])
                and s.axis_up(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[0, 0, 1], tol_deg=10.0)
                and s.axis_dot(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[1, 0, 0], world_axis=[1, 0, 0], min_dot=0.9848, abs=True))),
        Subtask(&#x27;close the lid&#x27;,
                lambda s: ((s.over_site(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, site=&#x27;plate_seat&#x27;, lo=[-0.00125, -0.00125, -0.001], hi=[0.00125, 0.00125, 0.001])
                    and s.axis_up(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[0, 0, 1], tol_deg=10.0)
                    and s.axis_dot(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[1, 0, 0], world_axis=[1, 0, 0], min_dot=0.9848, abs=True))
                and s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;lid&#x27;, lo=-1.95, hi=-1.85))),
        Subtask(&#x27;latch the lever&#x27;,
                lambda s: (((s.over_site(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, site=&#x27;plate_seat&#x27;, lo=[-0.00125, -0.00125, -0.001], hi=[0.00125, 0.00125, 0.001])
                        and s.axis_up(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[0, 0, 1], tol_deg=10.0)
                        and s.axis_dot(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[1, 0, 0], world_axis=[1, 0, 0], min_dot=0.9848, abs=True))
                    and s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;lid&#x27;, lo=-1.95, hi=-1.85))
                and s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;lid_lever&#x27;, lo=-0.95, hi=-0.85))),
        Subtask(&#x27;tighten the force knob&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.success()),
    ]


def INVARIANT(s):
    return s.axis_up(obj=&#x27;pcr_plate&#x27;, axis=[0, 0, 1], tol_deg=30.0)

<details><summary><code>tasks/set_up_pcr_run/test.py</code> (2 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the set_up_pcr_run task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.sim_env import SimEnv



PCR_TASK = &quot;set_up_pcr_run&quot;


def test_nested_articulated_lid_is_one_payload_and_self_contact_is_not_an_obstacle():
    env = SimEnv(task=PCR_TASK, seed=1)
    env.reset(seed=1, randomize_init=True)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm, m, d = env.arms[0], env.model, env.data
    lid = m.body(&quot;lid&quot;).id
    corners = np.array([[i, j, k] for i in (-1, 0, 1)
                        for j in (-1, 0, 1) for k in (-1, 0, 1)])
    cloud = []
    for g in range(m.ngeom):
        if m.geom_group[g] == 3 and env._ancestor_in(int(m.geom_bodyid[g]), {lid}):
            centre, half = m.geom_aabb[g][:3], m.geom_aabb[g][3:]
            cloud.append((centre + corners * half) @ d.geom_xmat[g].reshape(3, 3).T
                         + d.geom_xpos[g])
    points = np.vstack(cloud)
    start = np.array([-0.12, points[:, 1].max() - 0.028,
                      points[:, 2].max() - 0.021])
    down = R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, [np.pi, 0, 0]).as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;)
    env.move_to(start + [0, 0, 0.06], down, 0)
    env.move_to(start, down, 0)
    for s in np.arange(0.01, 0.06, 0.01):
        env.move_to(start - [0, s, 0.30 * s], down, 0)

    touched = {f&quot;{arm}_{side}_finger&quot;: set() for side in (&quot;left&quot;, &quot;right&quot;)}
    for contact in d.contact[: d.ncon]:
        for finger, other in ((contact.geom1, contact.geom2),
                              (contact.geom2, contact.geom1)):
            name = m.body(int(m.geom_bodyid[finger])).name or &quot;&quot;
            other_body = int(m.geom_bodyid[other])
            if name in touched and env._ancestor_in(other_body, {lid}):
                touched[name].add(m.body(other_body).name)
    assert &quot;lid&quot; in touched[f&quot;{arm}_left_finger&quot;]
    assert &quot;lid_lever&quot; in touched[f&quot;{arm}_right_finger&quot;]

    same_arm_geoms = {g for g in range(m.ngeom)
                      if (m.body(int(m.geom_bodyid[g])).name or &quot;&quot;).startswith(arm + &quot;_&quot;)}
    assert not env.ctl._arm_contacts(arm) &amp; same_arm_geoms
    lid_geoms = {g for g in range(m.ngeom)
                 if env._ancestor_in(int(m.geom_bodyid[g]), {lid})}
    assert env.ctl._held_payload_geoms(arm) == lid_geoms
