Upstream&#x27;s visual is 120.00 x 80.00 x 20.20 mm, with its short side exactly equal to the Panda jaw&#x27;s 80.00 mm maximum opening, so it cannot be released reliably. PLATE_SHRINK=0.85 drives the visual mesh, collision stack, exact-mesh inertia and seat height together. The resulting watertight 11.623 cm^3 mesh compiles to 10.519 g at polypropylene density 905 kg/m^3; collision is a mesh-section-derived stepped silhouette rather than upstream&#x27;s solid full-flange lattice. The resized 85.85 x 55.25 mm foot fits the reaction block&#x27;s 110.74 x 73.96 mm top. A standard SBS plate is about 127.8 x 85.5 mm, so the physical seat follows the shipped plate rather than that incompatible nominal footprint. Four collision-backed trapezoidal rails surround the measured 85.85 x 55.25 mm lower skirt with 1.00 mm clearance per side. Their 12.25 mm height and 4.25 mm outward lead-in accept a centre offset of 5 mm, while an insertion 7 mm outside the centre parks at least 6.09 mm above the seated height. The rails use the reaction block&#x27;s stiff 4 ms contact and sliding friction 0.6. Quasi-static lateral loads of 0.01 to 0.10 N left the plate at most 0.005 mm beyond the 1.00 mm bottom clearance, with at most 0.013 mm rail penetration. Thus only 0.005 mm of the graded +/-1.25 mm band is measured rail compliance; the remaining 0.245 mm is pose tolerance. Its +/-1 mm z box is the guide&#x27;s physical interior, and touching_part requires support by the block. Four drops from 10 mm up and 5 mm off centre all self-seated at |x| &lt;=0.760 mm and |y| &lt;=0.553 mm. A massless collision-backed heated platen fills the missing underside of the upstream lid, clears a seated plate by at least 1.00 mm, and holds at lid q=+0.00129 when a plate is parked on a rail instead of letting the lid enter its [-1.95,-1.85] closed band.\nThe rejected delivery used a +8 mm grasp and one 170 mm lift: the plate crept from about 3 to 9 mm deep in the tool onto a finger-tooth ledge, and opening dragged it sideways. At a +12 mm release it seated 2/4; the failures were 21.69 and 27.46 mm outside the old seat-frame y band. The accepted delivery grasps at the plate mid-plane, uses &lt;=50 mm carry legs and re-reads the live grasp transform before each leg. Across 12 drawn starts, lift-to-release creep was at most 1.24 mm/1.16 deg. From the remeasured +16 mm release, guide contact occurred in 52--54 ms after opening; its first 20 ms integrated to 7.52--9.14 mN s normal and 5.53--5.98 mN s tangential impulse (35.84 N peak normal). The at-most 2.30 mm post-open translation is the guide centring the plate, and all 12 plates seated with |dx| &lt;=0.72 mm, |dy| &lt;=0.46 mm and tilt &lt;=0.02 deg. Twelve complete arm solves (pick, place, lid, lever, knob and retreat) remained true after 1,250 settled steps and used 1,192--1,431 of the 3,200-step budget; their final plate extrema were |dx| &lt;=0.74 mm, |dy| &lt;=0.43 mm and zero measurable tilt. The success tree makes loading its first stage, restates the seated clauses through every machine-control stage, and finally requires the robot clear of pcr_plate. The C1000 comes from instruments.py&#x27;s mirror; its lid is over-centre, its lever uses the native replacement detent, and its force knob holds by frictionloss after one wrist roll. A deterministic UV-mapped decal labels the moving knob face FORCE with a pointer mark; it is a massless, non-colliding child of the knob and changes no joint or control geometry. ## shell game

Shell game, and you deal it. Seven cubes, one each of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet, sit in a shuffled row with seven identical white shells parked behind them. Press the GREEN button once: a shell is carried over every cube and set down on it. Then press the BLUE button 5 times; each press down triggers one shuffle, two shells swapping spots with whatever they hide. Keep the arm clear while pieces move. Then build the rainbow. Uncover the cubes in rainbow order: lift the shell off the red cube first, then the one hiding orange, and so on to violet. Leave the seven of them in a straight line running from the GREEN button to the BLUE button, in that same order, with red nearest the green button.

<details><summary><code>tasks/shell_game/grade.py</code> (3 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of shell game.

Uncover the cubes in rainbow order after the cover press and the shuffles, then line
them up in rainbow order.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import Subtask
from core.grade_episode import _body_pos

SETUP = [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;press_count&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;, &quot;count&quot;: 1}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;press_count&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;, &quot;count&quot;: 5}]
REVEAL = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;uncover_order&quot;, &quot;order&quot;: [&quot;cube_red&quot;, &quot;cube_orange&quot;, &quot;cube_yellow&quot;, &quot;cube_green&quot;, &quot;cube_blue&quot;, &quot;cube_indigo&quot;, &quot;cube_violet&quot;], &quot;by&quot;: [&quot;shell_0&quot;, &quot;shell_1&quot;, &quot;shell_2&quot;, &quot;shell_3&quot;, &quot;shell_4&quot;, &quot;shell_5&quot;, &quot;shell_6&quot;]}


UNCOVER_TOL = 0.045
UNCOVER_DZ = 0.05


class UncoverOrder:
    def __init__(self, order, by):
        self.order, self.by = list(order), list(by)
        self.covered, self.revealed, self.broken = set(), set(), False

    def _hidden(self, env, name):
        p = _body_pos(env, name)
        return any(abs(p[2] - q[2]) &lt; UNCOVER_DZ
                   and float(np.hypot(p[0] - q[0], p[1] - q[1])) &lt; UNCOVER_TOL
                   for q in (_body_pos(env, o) for o in self.by))

    def __call__(self, env):
        for i, name in enumerate(self.order):
            if self._hidden(env, name):
                self.covered.add(name)
            elif name in self.covered and name not in self.revealed:
                if any(o not in self.revealed for o in self.order[:i]):
                    self.broken = True
                self.revealed.add(name)
        return not self.broken and len(self.revealed) == len(self.order)


def uncover_order(order, by):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;cubes revealed in the order {order}&quot;&quot;&quot;
    return UncoverOrder(order, by)


def lateral_order(first, second, axis, min_gap, max_gap, align_tol):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;{second} {min_gap} to {max_gap} m past {first} along {axis}, within {align_tol} m of its row&quot;&quot;&quot;
    axis = &quot;xyz&quot;.index(axis)
    other = 1 if axis == 0 else 0

    def check(env):
        pa, pb = _body_pos(env, first), _body_pos(env, second)
        gap = float(pb[axis] - pa[axis])
        return bool(min_gap &lt;= gap &lt;= max_gap and abs(float(pb[other] - pa[other])) &lt;= align_tol)
    return check


COLOURS = [c.removeprefix(&quot;cube_&quot;) for c in REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;]]


def subtasks():
    setup_at = [0]
    firsts = [dict(REVEAL, order=REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][:k]) for k in range(1, 8)]

    def uncovered(k):
        def check(s):
            if k == 1 and setup_at[0] &lt; 2 and s.tree(SETUP[setup_at[0]]):
                setup_at[0] += 1
            return setup_at[0] == 2 and s.tree(firsts[k - 1])
        return check
    lined = lambda k: lambda s: all(s.lateral_order(first=a, second=b, axis=&quot;y&quot;, min_gap=0.045, max_gap=0.15, align_tol=0.06)
                                    for a, b in zip(REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][:k - 1], REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][1:k])) \
        and s.robot_clear(bodies=REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][:k])
    return [Subtask(f&#x27;lift the shell off the {c} cube&#x27; + (f&#x27;, after the {COLOURS[k - 2]} one&#x27; if k &gt; 1 else &#x27; first&#x27;),
                    uncovered(k), ever=True, objects=tuple(REVEAL[&quot;by&quot;])) for k, c in enumerate(COLOURS, 1)] + \
           [Subtask(f&#x27;line up the cubes {COLOURS[0]} to {COLOURS[k - 1]} in rainbow order&#x27;, lined(k), needs=(6,), end_needs=(6,),
                    objects=tuple(REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][:k] if k == 2 else REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][k - 1:k])) for k in range(2, 7)] + \
           [Subtask(&#x27;line up all seven cubes in rainbow order&#x27;, lambda s: s.success(), needs=(6,), end_needs=(6,), objects=(REVEAL[&quot;order&quot;][6],))]
</pre></details>
<details><summary><code>tasks/shell_game/dynamics.py</code> (5 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Shell game: deals the colours and moves the shells.

Shell game motion: the reset RNG deals which colour starts in which slot and which slot pair trades on each
shuffle press; the shells and cubes then move along scripted legs, each opened by a press of a button.
task.json&#x27;s `scene_script_gen` declares the game (cubes, shells, slot row, detour rows, buttons, press count).&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import PressEdge


class Dynamics:
    def __init__(self, env):
        self.cfg = env.spec[&quot;scene_script_gen&quot;]
        self.build(env, [])

    def deal(self, env):
        cfg, rng, m = self.cfg, env._rng, env.model
        cubes, shells = list(cfg[&quot;cubes&quot;]), list(cfg[&quot;shells&quot;])
        slot_y = [float(y) for y in cfg[&quot;slot_y&quot;]]
        n = len(slot_y)
        assert len(cubes) == len(shells) == n
        cover_x, start_x = float(cfg[&quot;cover_x&quot;]), float(cfg[&quot;start_x&quot;])
        front_x, back_x = float(cfg[&quot;front_x&quot;]), float(cfg[&quot;back_x&quot;])
        cube_z, shell_z, carry_z = (float(cfg[k]) for k in (&quot;cube_z&quot;, &quot;shell_z&quot;, &quot;carry_z&quot;))
        cover_btn, shuffle_btn = cfg[&quot;cover_btn&quot;], cfg[&quot;shuffle_btn&quot;]

        perm = rng.permutation(n)
        cube_at = {}
        for i, name in enumerate(cubes):
            slot = int(perm[i])
            cube_at[slot] = name
            a = m.joint(m.body(name).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
            env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] = [cover_x, slot_y[slot], cube_z]
            env.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        shell_at = {s: shells[s] for s in range(n)}

        segs = []
        def move(body, press, t0, t1, x, y, z, btn):
            segs.append({&quot;body&quot;: body, &quot;after&quot;: [btn], &quot;press&quot;: press,
                         &quot;from&quot;: round(t0, 2), &quot;to&quot;: round(t1, 2),
                         &quot;pos&quot;: [round(x, 4), round(y, 4), z]})

        for slot in range(n):
            sh = shell_at[slot]
            move(sh, 1, 0.3, 0.7, start_x, slot_y[slot], carry_z, cover_btn)
            move(sh, 1, 0.7, 1.1, cover_x, slot_y[slot], carry_z, cover_btn)
            move(sh, 1, 1.1, 1.5, cover_x, slot_y[slot], shell_z, cover_btn)

        for k in range(1, int(cfg[&quot;presses&quot;]) + 1):
            a, b = (int(v) for v in rng.choice(n, size=2, replace=False))
            for src, dst, row in ((a, b, front_x), (b, a, back_x)):
                for body, z in ((shell_at[src], shell_z), (cube_at[src], cube_z)):
                    move(body, k, 0.2, 0.6, row, slot_y[src], z, shuffle_btn)
                    move(body, k, 0.6, 1.2, row, slot_y[dst], z, shuffle_btn)
                    move(body, k, 1.2, 1.6, cover_x, slot_y[dst], z, shuffle_btn)
            cube_at[a], cube_at[b] = cube_at[b], cube_at[a]
            shell_at[a], shell_at[b] = shell_at[b], shell_at[a]
        self.build(env, segs)
        env.forward()

    def build(self, env, segs):
        self.script = {}
        for seg in sorted(segs, key=lambda s: (len(s.get(&quot;after&quot;) or ()), s.get(&quot;press&quot;, 1), s[&quot;from&quot;])):
            seg = dict(seg)
            after = seg.get(&quot;after&quot;)
            seg[&quot;after&quot;] = [after] if isinstance(after, str) else list(after or ())
            self.script.setdefault(seg[&quot;body&quot;], []).append(seg)
        m = env.model
        self.adr = {b: (m.joint(m.body(b).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0], m.joint(m.body(b).jntadr[0]).dofadr[0])
                    for b in self.script}
        self.edges = [PressEdge(j) for j in dict.fromkeys(
            t for segs_ in self.script.values() for seg in segs_ for t in seg[&quot;after&quot;])]
        self.pressed = {}

    def physics_step(self, env):
        now = float(env.data.time)
        for e in self.edges:
            if e.update(env):
                self.pressed.setdefault(e.joint, []).append(now)
            ts = self.pressed.get(e.joint, [])
            kept = [t for t in ts if t &lt;= now]
            if len(kept) != len(ts):
                self.pressed[e.joint], e.down = kept, False

        for body, segs in self.script.items():
            active = t0 = None
            best = (-1, -1.0)
            for seg in segs:
                epoch = self.epoch(env, seg)
                if epoch is None:
                    continue
                t_open = epoch + seg[&quot;from&quot;]
                rank = (len(seg[&quot;after&quot;]), t_open)
                if now &gt;= t_open and rank &gt;= best:
                    active, t0, best = seg, epoch, rank
            if active is None:
                continue
            if active is segs[-1] and now &gt; t0 + active[&quot;to&quot;]:
                continue
            a, dof = self.adr[body]
            start = active.get(&quot;_start&quot;)
            if start is None:
                start = active[&quot;_start&quot;] = env.data.qpos[a:a + 3].copy()
            goal = start if active[&quot;pos&quot;] is None else np.asarray(active[&quot;pos&quot;], float)
            f = float(np.clip((now - t0 - active[&quot;from&quot;]) / max(active[&quot;to&quot;] - active[&quot;from&quot;], 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0))
            env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] = start + (goal - start) * f
            env.data.qvel[dof:dof + 6] = 0.0

    def epoch(self, env, seg):
        if not seg.get(&quot;after&quot;):
            return env.episode_t0
        n = int(seg.get(&quot;press&quot;, 1))
        times = []
        for j in seg[&quot;after&quot;]:
            ts = self.pressed.get(j, ())
            if len(ts) &lt; n:
                return None
            times.append(ts[n - 1])
        return max(times)
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/shell_game/test.py</code> (11 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the shell_game task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from helpers import (
    ROYGBIV,
    _pack_env,
    _press,
)
import logging
import pytest
from core.sim_env import SimEnv


def _rainbow(env, order):
    for i, n in enumerate(order):
        env.data.qpos[env._obj_qadr[n]:env._obj_qadr[n] + 3] = [0.18, -0.27 + 0.09 * i, 0.8167]
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)


def _shell(env, i, xy):
    a = env._obj_qadr[f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;]
    env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] = [*xy, 0.80]


def _cover(env, check):
    for i, n in enumerate(ROYGBIV):
        _shell(env, i, env.data.body(n).xpos[:2])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    check(env)


def _uncover(env, check, order):
    for i, n in enumerate(order):
        _shell(env, ROYGBIV.index(n), [-0.30, -0.27 + 0.09 * i])
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        check(env)


def test_shell_game_needs_both_press_stages_then_the_rainbow():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    _rainbow(env, ROYGBIV)
    assert check(env) is False
    _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False
    for _ in range(4):
        _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False
    _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;)
    _rainbow(env, ROYGBIV)
    _cover(env, check)
    _uncover(env, check, ROYGBIV)
    check(env)
    assert check(env) is True


def test_shell_game_wrong_order_fails():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    for _ in range(5):
        _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;)
    _rainbow(env, list(reversed(ROYGBIV)))
    check(env)
    assert check(env) is False


def _to_the_row(env, check):
    env.reset(seed=0)
    _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;, times=5)
    _rainbow(env, ROYGBIV)


def test_shell_game_row_never_uncovered_fails():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    _to_the_row(env, check)
    _cover(env, check)
    assert check(env) is False
    assert check(env) is False


def test_shell_game_uncover_out_of_turn_fails():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    _to_the_row(env, check)
    _cover(env, check)
    swapped = ROYGBIV[:5] + [ROYGBIV[6], ROYGBIV[5]]
    _uncover(env, check, swapped)
    check(env)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_shell_game_reveal_survives_a_shell_parked_alongside(env=None):
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;], env.task)
    _to_the_row(env, check)
    _cover(env, check)
    _uncover(env, check, ROYGBIV)
    _shell(env, 6, env.data.body(&quot;cube_red&quot;).xpos[:2] + np.array([0.0, 0.03]))
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    check(env)
    assert check(env) is True


logging.getLogger(&quot;core.sim_env&quot;).setLevel(logging.ERROR)

TASK = &quot;shell_game&quot;
CUBES = [&quot;cube_red&quot;, &quot;cube_orange&quot;, &quot;cube_yellow&quot;, &quot;cube_green&quot;,
         &quot;cube_blue&quot;, &quot;cube_indigo&quot;, &quot;cube_violet&quot;]
GREEN, BLUE = &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;, &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;


@pytest.fixture(scope=&quot;module&quot;)
def env():
    e = SimEnv(TASK, seed=7)
    e.reset(seed=7)
    return e


def _steps(e, seconds):
    for _ in range(round(seconds / e.model.opt.timestep)):
        e._step_physics()
        e._check(e)


def _push(e, joint):
    adr = e.model.joint(joint).qposadr[0]
    for _ in range(round(0.06 / e.model.opt.timestep)):
        e.data.qpos[adr] = -0.02
        e._step_physics()
        e._check(e)
    _steps(e, 0.08)


def _row(e):
    return sorted(CUBES, key=lambda n: float(e.data.body(n).xpos[1]))


def test_deal_is_seeded_and_permuted(env):
    assert _row(env) != CUBES, &quot;seed 7 dealt the solved rainbow — the deal did nothing&quot;
    e2 = SimEnv(TASK, seed=7); e2.reset(seed=7)
    assert _row(e2) == _row(env), &quot;same seed must deal the same row&quot;
    e3 = SimEnv(TASK, seed=8); e3.reset(seed=8)
    assert _row(e3) != _row(env), &quot;a different seed dealt the identical row&quot;


def test_green_covers_and_release_is_inert(env):
    _push(env, GREEN)
    _steps(env, 1.6)
    cover_x = float(env.spec[&quot;scene_script_gen&quot;][&quot;cover_x&quot;])
    for i in range(7):
        p = env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos
        assert abs(float(p[0]) - cover_x) &lt; 0.01, f&quot;shell_{i} never covered its slot&quot;
    before = _row(env)
    _steps(env, 0.8)
    assert _row(env) == before, &quot;the row moved with no button pressed&quot;


def test_each_blue_press_swaps_exactly_two(env):
    prev = _row(env)
    for k in range(5):
        _push(env, BLUE)
        _steps(env, 1.8)
        cur = _row(env)
        moved = sum(a != b for a, b in zip(prev, cur))
        assert moved == 2, f&quot;blue press {k+1} changed {moved} positions, not 2&quot;
        prev = cur


def test_wrong_row_then_rainbow(env):
    def place(order):
        for i, n in enumerate(order):
            a = env.model.joint(env.model.body(n).jntadr[0]).qposadr[0]
            env.data.qpos[a:a + 3] = [0.18, -0.27 + 0.09 * i, 0.8167]
            env.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        _steps(env, 0.4)

    place(list(reversed(CUBES)))
    assert not bool(env._check(env)), &quot;VIBGYOR graded as ROYGBIV&quot;
    place(CUBES)
    assert bool(env._check(env)), &quot;ROYGBIV row after both press stages must grade success&quot;


@pytest.fixture()
def scripted():
    e = SimEnv(&quot;shell_game&quot;, seed=0)
    e.reset(seed=0)
    e.max_len = 10 ** 9
    return e


def dwell(env, seconds):
    t = float(env.data.time)
    while float(env.data.time) - t &lt; seconds:
        env.apply_action(np.zeros(3), np.zeros(3), 1.0)


def press(env, joint):
    adr = env.model.joint(joint).qposadr[0]
    t = float(env.data.time)
    while float(env.data.time) - t &lt; 0.06:
        env.data.qpos[adr] = -0.024
        env.apply_action(np.zeros(3), np.zeros(3), 1.0)
    dwell(env, 0.1)


def test_script_waits_for_its_trigger(scripted):
    env = scripted
    dwell(env, 8.0)
    for i in range(7):
        assert env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[0] == pytest.approx(-0.22, abs=2e-3)


def test_cover_runs_on_the_press_and_release_is_inert(scripted):
    env = scripted
    press(env, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    dwell(env, 1.8)
    for i in range(7):
        assert env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[0] == pytest.approx(-0.04, abs=2e-3)
    row0 = sorted(float(env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[1]) for i in range(7))
    dwell(env, 4.0)
    row1 = sorted(float(env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[1]) for i in range(7))
    assert np.allclose(row0, row1, atol=2e-3)


def test_each_press_edge_runs_one_swap_and_the_last_hands_back(scripted):
    env = scripted
    press(env, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    dwell(env, 1.8)
    for k in range(5):
        before = {i: float(env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[1]) for i in range(7)}
        press(env, &quot;buttonbox_joint_1&quot;)
        dwell(env, 2.0)
        after = {i: float(env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[1]) for i in range(7)}
        moved = sum(abs(before[i] - after[i]) &gt; 0.02 for i in range(7))
        assert moved == 2, f&quot;press {k + 1} moved {moved} shells, not the swapped pair&quot;
    env.data.qpos[env._obj_qadr[&quot;shell_0&quot;] + 2] = 0.95
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    dwell(env, 0.5)
    assert env.data.body(&quot;shell_0&quot;).xpos[2] &lt; 0.9, &quot;script re-pinned a released shell&quot;


def test_pieces_stay_pinned_until_their_last_leg(scripted):
    env = scripted
    press(env, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    dwell(env, 1.8)
    pinned = next(b for b, segs in env.dynamics.script.items()
                  if b.startswith(&quot;shell_&quot;) and env.dynamics.epoch(env, segs[-1]) is None)
    adr = env._obj_qadr[pinned]
    env.data.qpos[adr + 2] = 0.95
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    dwell(env, 0.3)
    assert env.data.body(pinned).xpos[2] &lt; 0.85, f&quot;{pinned} should be script-held&quot;


def test_script_does_not_sag_between_control_steps(scripted):
    env = scripted
    press(env, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    t0 = env.dynamics.pressed[&quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;][0]
    dwell(env, max(0.0, t0 + 0.35 - float(env.data.time)))
    for _ in range(5):
        z0 = env.data.body(&quot;shell_0&quot;).xpos[2]
        env.apply_action(np.zeros(3), np.zeros(3), 1.0)
        t = float(env.data.time) - t0 - env.model.opt.timestep
        want = 0.800 + (0.865 - 0.800) * (t - 0.3) / 0.4
        got = env.data.body(&quot;shell_0&quot;).xpos[2]
        assert got &gt; z0, f&quot;shell fell during the carry: {z0:.4f} -&gt; {got:.4f}&quot;
        assert abs(got - want) &lt; 1e-4, f&quot;t={t:.2f} off the ramp by {(got - want) * 1000:.2f} mm&quot;


def test_a_reset_rearms_the_schedule(scripted):
    env = scripted
    press(env, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    dwell(env, 2.0)
    row = sorted(float(env.data.body(n).xpos[1])
                 for n in env.spec[&quot;scene_script_gen&quot;][&quot;cubes&quot;])
    env.reset(seed=0)
    assert env.dynamics.pressed == {}
    assert float(env.data.time) - env.episode_t0 == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-9)
    for i in range(7):
        assert env.data.body(f&quot;shell_{i}&quot;).xpos[0] == pytest.approx(-0.22, abs=2e-3)
    row2 = sorted(float(env.data.body(n).xpos[1])
                  for n in env.spec[&quot;scene_script_gen&quot;][&quot;cubes&quot;])
    assert np.allclose(row, row2, atol=1e-6), &quot;same seed must re-deal the same hand&quot;


def test_trigger_leg_outranks_clock_legs(scripted):
    env = scripted
    body, btn = &quot;shell_0&quot;, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;
    env.dynamics.build(env, [
        {&quot;body&quot;: body, &quot;from&quot;: 0.5, &quot;to&quot;: 1.5, &quot;pos&quot;: [-0.16, 0.10, 0.80]},
        {&quot;body&quot;: body, &quot;from&quot;: 3.0, &quot;to&quot;: 4.0, &quot;pos&quot;: [-0.16, -0.27, 0.80]},
        {&quot;body&quot;: body, &quot;after&quot;: [btn], &quot;from&quot;: 0.0, &quot;to&quot;: 1e9, &quot;pos&quot;: None},
    ])
    dwell(env, 1.6)
    assert env.data.body(body).xpos[1] == pytest.approx(0.10, abs=5e-3)
    press(env, btn)
    y = float(env.data.body(body).xpos[1])
    dwell(env, 4.0)
    assert env.data.body(body).xpos[1] == pytest.approx(y, abs=5e-3), \
        &quot;a clock leg that opened after the press stole the body from the stop hold&quot;


def _put(env, body, pos):
    j = env.model.joint(env.model.body(body).jntadr[0])
    env.data.qpos[j.qposadr[0]:j.qposadr[0] + 3] = pos
    env.data.qvel[j.dofadr[0]:j.dofadr[0] + 6] = 0.0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)


def test_press_count_needs_a_release_between_presses():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;press_count&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;, &quot;count&quot;: 1})
    j = env.model.joint(&quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    adr, lo = j.qposadr[0], env.model.jnt_range[j.id][0]
    for _ in range(20):
        env.data.qpos[adr] = lo
        mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
        assert check(env) is True
    _press(env, check, &quot;buttonbox_joint_0&quot;)
    assert check(env) is False


def test_lateral_order_needs_the_gap_and_the_row():
    env = _pack_env(&quot;shell_game&quot;)
    _put(env, &quot;cube_red&quot;, [0.02, -0.18, 0.8167])
    _put(env, &quot;cube_orange&quot;, [0.02, -0.06, 0.8167])
    fwd = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;lateral_order&quot;, &quot;first&quot;: &quot;cube_red&quot;, &quot;second&quot;: &quot;cube_orange&quot;,
           &quot;axis&quot;: &quot;y&quot;, &quot;min_gap&quot;: 0.05, &quot;max_gap&quot;: 0.20, &quot;align_tol&quot;: 0.05}
    check, _ = make_checker(fwd, &quot;shell_game&quot;)
    assert check(env) is True
    back, _ = make_checker({**fwd, &quot;first&quot;: &quot;cube_orange&quot;, &quot;second&quot;: &quot;cube_red&quot;}, &quot;shell_game&quot;)
    assert back(env) is False
    _put(env, &quot;cube_orange&quot;, [0.30, -0.06, 0.8167])
    assert check(env) is False

<details><summary><code>tasks/sort_lego_bricks/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of sort lego bricks.

1 to 9 bricks in the bin of their colour, released.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask

BRICKS = [(f&quot;{c}_brick_{i}&quot;, f&quot;{c}_bin&quot;) for c in (&quot;red&quot;, &quot;green&quot;, &quot;yellow&quot;) for i in (1, 2, 3)]


def sorted_count(s):
    return sum(s.in_bbox(a=b, b=bin) and s.depth_in(a=b, b=bin, z_threshold=0.02) and s.robot_clear(bodies=[b])
               for b, bin in BRICKS)


def subtasks():
    return [Subtask(&quot;1 brick in the bin of its colour&quot; if k == 1 else f&quot;{k} bricks in the bins of their colour&quot;,
                    (lambda s: s.success()) if k == 9 else (lambda s, k=k: sorted_count(s) &gt;= k)) for k in range(1, 10)]
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/sort_pills/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of sort pills.

Both caps off, Saturday and Sunday each get exactly two capsules and one tablet, every
organizer lid closed.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask

DOSE = dict(capsule=2, tablet=1)


def cap_off(s, kind):
    return not s.within_dist(a=f&#x27;{kind}_lid&#x27;, b=f&#x27;{kind}_bottle_lid_seat&#x27;, tol=0.05) and not s.touching_part(a=f&#x27;{kind}_lid&#x27;, b=f&#x27;{kind}_bottle&#x27;)


def dosed(s, day, kind):
    box = f&#x27;{day}_compartment&#x27;
    n = sum(s.in_bbox(a=p, b=box) and s.depth_in(a=p, b=box, z_threshold=0.006) and not s.grasped(obj=p)
            for p in (f&#x27;bottle_{kind}_{i}&#x27; for i in range(1, 7)))
    return n == DOSE[kind]


def subtasks():
    return [Subtask(&#x27;take the cap off the first container&#x27;, lambda s: cap_off(s, &#x27;capsule&#x27;)),
            Subtask(&#x27;take the cap off the second container&#x27;, lambda s: cap_off(s, &#x27;tablet&#x27;))] + [
            Subtask(f&#x27;fill the {d.title()} compartment, {nth} kind&#x27;, lambda s, d=d, k=k: dosed(s, d, k))
            for d in (&#x27;saturday&#x27;, &#x27;sunday&#x27;) for nth, k in ((&#x27;first&#x27;, &#x27;capsule&#x27;), (&#x27;second&#x27;, &#x27;tablet&#x27;))] + [
            Subtask(&#x27;close the organizer lids&#x27;, lambda s: s.success())]
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/square/test.py</code> (2 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the square task.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np
import pytest
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from helpers import (
    POS_TOL,
)
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from helpers import (
    set_free_body,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;deg&quot;, [0.0, 0.2, 45.0])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;dist&quot;, [0.0, 0.0005, 0.002, 0.01, 0.20])
def test_small_waypoints_do_not_break_the_pacer(dist, deg):
    env = SimEnv(task=&quot;square&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    home = env.observe_proprio(arm)
    tgt = home.eef_pos + np.array([dist, 0.0, 0.0])
    rot = R.from_euler(&quot;z&quot;, deg, degrees=True) * R.from_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;, home.eef_euler)
    env.move_to(tgt, rot.as_euler(&quot;xyz&quot;), 1.0)
    err = float(np.linalg.norm(env.observe_proprio(arm).eef_pos - tgt))
    assert err &lt; POS_TOL, f&quot;{dist * 1000:.1f} mm / {deg} deg waypoint landed {err * 1000:.1f} mm off&quot;


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;dist&quot;, [0.0005, 0.0010, 0.0015])
def test_sub_arrival_translation_actually_moves(dist):
    env = SimEnv(task=&quot;square&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    start = env.observe_proprio(arm)
    steps_before = env.num_step
    target = start.eef_pos + np.array([dist, 0.0, 0.0])

    env.move_to(target, start.eef_euler, 1.0)

    delta = env.observe_proprio(arm).eef_pos - start.eef_pos
    assert env.num_step &gt; steps_before, f&quot;{dist * 1000:.1f} mm correction was a zero-step no-op&quot;
    assert delta[0] &gt; 0.5 * dist, (
        f&quot;{dist * 1000:.1f} mm correction moved only {delta[0] * 1000:.2f} mm toward target&quot;)


def test_resending_reset_pose_is_zero_step():
    env = SimEnv(task=&quot;square&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0, randomize_init=False)
    env.max_len = 10**9
    arm = env.arms[0]
    start = env.observe_proprio(arm)
    steps_before = env.num_step

    env.move_to(start.eef_pos, start.eef_euler, 1.0)

    assert env.num_step == steps_before
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(env.observe_proprio(arm).eef_pos, start.eef_pos)


def test_square_success_tree():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;square&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    check, hold = make_checker(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;])
    assert hold == 1
    assert check(env) is False

    tree = {c[&quot;pred&quot;]: c for c in env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;of&quot;]}
    peg = tree[&quot;within_dist&quot;][&quot;b&quot;]
    nut = tree[&quot;within_dist&quot;][&quot;a&quot;]
    peg_pos = env.data.body(peg).xpos.copy()
    set_free_body(env, nut, [peg_pos[0], peg_pos[1], tree[&quot;z_below&quot;][&quot;z_below&quot;] - 0.02])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True

    set_free_body(env, nut, [peg_pos[0] + 0.05, peg_pos[1], tree[&quot;z_below&quot;][&quot;z_below&quot;] - 0.02])
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False
</pre></details>

## start incubation

PRESS_JOINT = &#x27;button_prog_1_key&#x27;


def in_start_site(obj, sites, size):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;{obj} released and at rest back in the hole it started in&quot;&quot;&quot;
    size = np.asarray(size)
    return _Baseline(lambda env: next((s for s in sites if _in_site_geom(env, obj, s, size)), None),
                     lambda env, site: site is not None and _in_site_geom(env, obj, site, size) and _released_at_rest(env, obj))


def in_start_site_goal_reader(env, obj, sites, size):
    d, ob = env.data, env.model.body(obj).id
    start_site = env.model.site(next(s for s in sites if _in_site_geom(env, obj, s, np.asarray(size)))).id
    return lambda: (max(float(np.linalg.norm((d.xpos[ob] - d.site_xpos[start_site])[:2])) - float(max(size[:2])), 0.0), None)


in_start_site.goal_reader = in_start_site_goal_reader


def subtasks():
    edge, state = PressEdge(PRESS_JOINT), dict(presses=0, ready=False, step=-1, valid=False)

    def press(s):
        down = bool(edge.update(s.env)) and s.step &gt; 0
        state[&quot;presses&quot;] += int(down)
        both = all(s.tree(t) for t in LOADED) and s.tree(DISTINCT_WELLS)
        valid = state[&quot;ready&quot;] and both and down and state[&quot;presses&quot;] == 1
        state[&quot;ready&quot;] = state[&quot;ready&quot;] or (both and state[&quot;presses&quot;] == 0)
        return valid
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the first tube and seat it in a machine well&#x27;, lambda s: s.tree(LOADED[0]), ever=True),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the second tube and seat it in a machine well&#x27;, lambda s: s.tree(LOADED[1]), ever=True),
        Subtask(&#x27;press program 1 once&#x27;, press, ever=True, objects=(PRESS_JOINT,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the first tube out of the well and return it to its own rack hole&#x27;, lambda s: s.tree(RETURNED[0]) and state[&quot;presses&quot;] == 1, needs=(2,), end_needs=(2,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the second tube out of the well and return it to its own rack hole&#x27;, lambda s: s.success(), needs=(2,), end_needs=(2,)),
    ]


def INVARIANT(s):
    return s.tree({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube_rack&quot;, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 15.0}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;over_site&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube_rack&quot;, &quot;site&quot;: &quot;table_top&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: [-0.297, -0.297, 0.0005], &quot;hi&quot;: [0.297, 0.297, 0.0185]}]}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 15.0}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube_2&quot;, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 15.0}]})

from pathlib import Path
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import numpy as np
from core.grade_episode import nodes
from core.tasks import ASSETS, TASKS, robot_kinematics
import mujoco
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from helpers import (
    set_free_body,
)

import pytest


def test_autobio_start_incubation_has_physical_wells_and_ordered_return():
    pack = TASKS / &quot;start_incubation&quot;
    spec = json.loads((pack / &quot;task.json&quot;).read_text())
    root = ET.parse(pack / &quot;scene.xml&quot;).getroot()

    block = next(body for body in root.find(&quot;worldbody&quot;).iter(&quot;body&quot;)
                 if body.get(&quot;name&quot;) == &quot;thermoblock&quot;)
    geoms = list(block.findall(&quot;geom&quot;))
    assert len(geoms) == 3110
    assert all(g.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(&quot;thermoblock_&quot;) for g in geoms)
    assert all(g.get(&quot;class&quot;) == &quot;collision&quot; for g in geoms)
    assert len([g for g in geoms if &quot;_level_&quot; in g.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;)]) == 2688
    deck_geoms = [g for g in geoms if g.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(
        &quot;thermoblock_deck_&quot;)]
    assert len(deck_geoms) == 417
    assert len([g for g in deck_geoms if &quot;_lip_&quot; in g.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;)]) == 384
    machine_sites = [s for s in block.findall(&quot;site&quot;)
                     if s.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(&quot;machine_well_&quot;)]
    assert len(machine_sites) == 24 and len({s.get(&quot;name&quot;) for s in machine_sites}) == 24

    rack = next(body for body in root.find(&quot;worldbody&quot;).iter(&quot;body&quot;)
                if body.get(&quot;name&quot;) == &quot;tube_rack&quot;)
    rack_sites = [s for s in rack.iter(&quot;site&quot;)
                  if s.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(&quot;rack_hole_&quot;)]
    assert len(rack_sites) == 60 and len({s.get(&quot;name&quot;) for s in rack_sites}) == 60
    rack_deck = [g for g in rack.iter(&quot;geom&quot;)
                 if g.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(&quot;tube_rack_deck_rack_hole_&quot;)]
    assert len(rack_deck) == 2880
    assert all(g.get(&quot;mass&quot;) == &quot;0&quot; for g in rack_deck)

    vortex_root = ET.parse(
        TASKS / &quot;vortex_sample&quot; / &quot;scene.xml&quot;).getroot()
    vortex_rack = next(body for body in vortex_root.find(&quot;worldbody&quot;).iter(&quot;body&quot;)
                       if body.get(&quot;name&quot;) == &quot;tube_rack&quot;)
    vortex_deck = [g for g in vortex_rack.iter(&quot;geom&quot;)
                   if g.get(&quot;name&quot;, &quot;&quot;).startswith(&quot;tube_rack_deck_rack_hole_&quot;)]
    assert [{**g.attrib, &quot;friction&quot;: None} for g in vortex_deck] == [
        {**g.attrib, &quot;friction&quot;: None} for g in rack_deck]
    assert {g.get(&quot;friction&quot;) for g in rack_deck} == {&quot;1 0.002 0.0001&quot;}

    rnd = spec[&quot;randomization&quot;]
    assert spec[&quot;objects&quot;] == [&quot;tube_rack&quot;, &quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;tube_2&quot;]
    assert rnd[&quot;groups&quot;] == [[&quot;tube_rack&quot;, &quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;tube_2&quot;]]
    assert rnd[&quot;slots&quot;][&quot;parent&quot;] == &quot;tube_rack&quot;
    assert rnd[&quot;slots&quot;][&quot;members&quot;] == [&quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;tube_2&quot;]
    assert len(rnd[&quot;slots&quot;][&quot;poses&quot;]) == 60
    assert len({tuple(pose) for pose in rnd[&quot;slots&quot;][&quot;poses&quot;]}) == 60
    rack_site_pos = [np.fromstring(site.get(&quot;pos&quot;), sep=&quot; &quot;) for site in rack_sites]
    expected_slots = [np.r_[pos[:2], pos[2] + 0.002, 0.0]
                      for pos in rack_site_pos]
    assert all(np.allclose(pose, expected, atol=1e-9)
               for pose, expected in zip(rnd[&quot;slots&quot;][&quot;poses&quot;], expected_slots))
    assert rnd[&quot;full_rand&quot;] is True
    assert rnd[&quot;placement_regions&quot;][&quot;tube_rack&quot;] == [{
        &quot;x&quot;: [-0.15, -0.03], &quot;y&quot;: [-0.26, -0.16],
        &quot;yaw_offset_deg&quot;: [-15.0, 15.0]}]
    assert set(s.get(&quot;name&quot;) for s in machine_sites + rack_sites) &lt;= set(rnd[&quot;reach_sites&quot;])
    assert not any(dash in spec[&quot;language&quot;] for dash in (&quot;-&quot;, &quot;\u2013&quot;, &quot;\u2014&quot;))

    success = spec[&quot;success&quot;]
    assert success[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;sequence&quot; and len(success[&quot;of&quot;]) == 4
    assert success[&quot;invariant&quot;][&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;all&quot;
    for i, stage in enumerate(success[&quot;of&quot;]):
        counts = [node for node in nodes(stage) if node[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;press_count&quot;]
        assert len(counts) == 1 and counts[0][&quot;count&quot;] == (0 if i == 0 else 1)
    for stage in success[&quot;of&quot;][:2]:
        contacts = {(node.get(&quot;a&quot;), node.get(&quot;b&quot;)) for node in nodes(stage)
                    if node[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;touching_part&quot;}
        assert contacts == {(&quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;thermoblock&quot;), (&quot;tube_2&quot;, &quot;thermoblock&quot;)}
    final = list(nodes(success[&quot;of&quot;][-1]))
    assert any(node[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;eef_near_start&quot; for node in final)
    assert any(node[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;gripper_open&quot; for node in final)
    assert any(node[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;robot_clear&quot;
               and node[&quot;bodies&quot;] == [&quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;tube_2&quot;, &quot;tube_rack&quot;, &quot;mixer&quot;]
               for node in final)


def test_in_start_site_requires_the_hole_the_layout_dealt():
    from core.grade_episode import _build, _in_site_geom
    env = SimEnv(&quot;start_incubation&quot;, seed=1)
    env.reset(seed=1)
    for _ in range(int(0.05 / env.model.opt.timestep)):
        env._step_physics()
    leaf = next(n for n in nodes(env.spec[&quot;success&quot;]) if n.get(&quot;pred&quot;) == &quot;in_start_site&quot; and n[&quot;obj&quot;] == &quot;tube_1&quot;)
    start = {obj: next((s for s in leaf[&quot;sites&quot;] if _in_site_geom(env, obj, s, np.asarray(leaf[&quot;size&quot;]))), None)
             for obj in (&quot;tube_1&quot;, &quot;tube_2&quot;)}
    assert None not in start.values() and start[&quot;tube_1&quot;] != start[&quot;tube_2&quot;]
    check = _build(leaf, &quot;start_incubation&quot;)
    assert check(env) is True
    other = next(s for s in leaf[&quot;sites&quot;] if s not in start.values())
    home, there = env.data.site(start[&quot;tube_1&quot;]).xpos.copy(), env.data.site(other).xpos.copy()
    pos = env.data.body(&quot;tube_1&quot;).xpos.copy()
    set_free_body(env, &quot;tube_1&quot;, pos + (there - home))
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is False
    set_free_body(env, &quot;tube_1&quot;, pos)
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True


def robot_model(name):
    return mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(ASSETS / &quot;robots&quot; / name / robot_kinematics(name)[&quot;mjcf&quot;]))


@pytest.fixture(scope=&quot;module&quot;)
def robots():
    return robot_model(&quot;franka_panda&quot;), robot_model(&quot;franka_panda_low_torsion&quot;)


def test_low_torsion_robot_changes_only_torsional_coefficients(robots):
    old, new = robots
    changed = [name for name in dir(old) if not name.startswith(&quot;_&quot;)
               and isinstance(getattr(old, name), np.ndarray)
               and not np.array_equal(getattr(old, name), getattr(new, name))]
    assert changed == [&quot;geom_friction&quot;]
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(old.geom_friction[:, [0, 2]], new.geom_friction[:, [0, 2]])
    fingers = np.isin(old.geom_bodyid, [old.body(&quot;left_finger&quot;).id, old.body(&quot;right_finger&quot;).id])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(new.geom_friction[:, 1],
                                  np.minimum(old.geom_friction[:, 1], np.where(fingers, .01, .002)))
    assert np.max(old.geom_friction[:, 1]) == .3


def test_start_incubation_caps_every_torsional_coefficient():
    m = SimEnv(&quot;start_incubation&quot;).model
    fingers = np.isin(m.geom_bodyid, [m.body(&quot;robot0_left_finger&quot;).id, m.body(&quot;robot0_right_finger&quot;).id])
    assert np.max(m.geom_friction[~fingers, 1]) == .002
    assert np.max(m.geom_friction[fingers, 1]) == .01
    assert m.npair == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;case,name&quot;, [(&quot;launch&quot;, &quot;tube_1&quot;), (&quot;one_pad&quot;, &quot;tube_2&quot;)])
def test_recorded_incubation_contact_failures(case, name):
    states = np.load(Path(__file__).parent / &quot;incubation_contact_states.npz&quot;)
    env = SimEnv(&quot;start_incubation&quot;)
    m, d = env.model, env.data
    env.reset_to_sim_state(states[case])
    body = m.body(name).id
    dof = env._obj_dofadr[name]
    inertia_rot = np.empty(9)
    mujoco.mju_quat2Mat(inertia_rot, m.body_iquat[body])
    z0, energies = float(d.xipos[body, 2]), []
    for step in range(801):
        mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
        mujoco.mj_subtreeVel(m, d)
        velocity = d.subtree_linvel[body]
        omega = inertia_rot.reshape(3, 3).T @ d.qvel[dof+3:dof+6]
        energies.append(.5*m.body_mass[body]*(velocity @ velocity)
                        + .5*np.dot(m.body_inertia[body], omega*omega)
                        + m.body_mass[body]*9.81*(d.xipos[body, 2]-.8))
        if step &lt; 800:
            mujoco.mj_step(m, d)
    assert max(energies)-energies[0] &lt; .0001
    assert d.xipos[body, 2] &lt; z0-.02
    for contact in d.contact:
        if body not in (m.geom_bodyid[contact.geom1], m.geom_bodyid[contact.geom2]):
            continue
        other = contact.geom1 if m.geom_bodyid[contact.geom2] == body else contact.geom2
        assert env.finger_root(int(m.geom_bodyid[other])) is None


def test_recorded_tube_seats_after_release():
    states = np.load(Path(__file__).parent / &quot;incubation_contact_states.npz&quot;)
    env = SimEnv(&quot;start_incubation&quot;)
    env.reset_to_sim_state(states[&quot;insertion_jam&quot;])
    for _ in range(round(1/env.model.opt.timestep)):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)
    tip = env.data.body(&quot;tube_2&quot;).xpos
    floor = env.data.site(&quot;machine_well_r1_c1&quot;).xpos
    assert abs(tip[2]-floor[2]) &lt; .001
    assert np.linalg.norm(tip[:2]-floor[:2]) &lt; .001


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;heading&quot;, [0, 90, 180, 270])
def test_round_tip_topples_between_holes(heading):
    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    env = SimEnv(&quot;start_incubation&quot;)
    m, d = env.model, env.data
    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    b = m.body(&quot;tube_2&quot;).id
    a = int(m.jnt_qposadr[int(m.body(b).jntadr[0])])
    centre = (d.site(&quot;machine_well_r1_c1&quot;).xpos +
              d.site(&quot;machine_well_r2_c2&quot;).xpos)/2
    deck = max(d.geom_xpos[g, 2]+m.geom_size[g, 2] for g in range(m.ngeom)
               if m.geom(g).name.startswith(&quot;thermoblock_deck_row_strip&quot;))
    axis = np.array([np.cos(np.radians(heading)), np.sin(np.radians(heading)), 0.])
    d.qpos[a:a+3] = [centre[0], centre[1], deck+.001]
    d.qpos[a+3:a+7] = Rotation.from_rotvec(axis*np.radians(.1)).as_quat()[[3, 0, 1, 2]]
    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    for _ in range(round(3/m.opt.timestep)):
        mujoco.mj_step(m, d)
    assert d.xmat[b].reshape(3, 3)[2, 2] &lt; np.cos(np.radians(45))
    assert m.body_mass[b] == pytest.approx(.007810109237082784, abs=1e-14)

from core.grade_episode import Subtask


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;turn the stove dial to the mark&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;flat_stove_1_button&#x27;, lo=0.95, hi=1.65)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the first moka pot and place it on the cook region&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.on_site(obj=&#x27;moka_pot_1_main&#x27;, site=&#x27;flat_stove_1_cook_region&#x27;, size=[0.075, 0.075, 0.0025], parent=&#x27;flat_stove_1_main&#x27;)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the second moka pot and place it on the cook region&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.on_site(obj=&#x27;moka_pot_2_main&#x27;, site=&#x27;flat_stove_1_cook_region&#x27;, size=[0.075, 0.075, 0.0025], parent=&#x27;flat_stove_1_main&#x27;)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the bread and place it on the plate&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.success()),
    ]

&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
from core.grade_episode import make_checker
from core.sim_env import SimEnv


def test_on_site_fires_on_a_settled_placement():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;start_making_breakfast&quot;, seed=1)
    env.reset(seed=1)
    leaf = next(p for p in env.spec[&quot;success&quot;][&quot;of&quot;] if p[&quot;pred&quot;] == &quot;on_site&quot;)
    check, _ = make_checker(leaf)
    assert check(env) is False

    adr = env._obj_qadr[leaf[&quot;obj&quot;]]
    target = env.data.site(leaf[&quot;site&quot;]).xpos.copy()
    env.data.qpos[adr : adr + 3] = [target[0], target[1], target[2] + 0.15]
    env.data.qpos[adr + 3 : adr + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
    env.data.qvel[:] = 0
    mujoco.mj_forward(env.model, env.data)
    for _ in range(2000):
        mujoco.mj_step(env.model, env.data)
    assert check(env) is True
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/stool_circular/grade.py</code> (1 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of stool circular.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import Subtask
from core.grade_episode import _body_pos


def position_within(obj, pos, pos_tol, rel_to=None):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;{obj} within {pos_tol} m of its goal position (rotation ignored)&quot;&quot;&quot;
    local_goal = np.asarray(pos)

    def check(env):
        goal = local_goal
        if rel_to is not None:
            ref = env.data.body(rel_to)
            goal = ref.xpos + ref.xmat.reshape(3, 3) @ local_goal
        return bool(np.linalg.norm(_body_pos(env, obj) - goal) &lt;= pos_tol)
    return check


def position_within_goal_reader(env, obj, pos, pos_tol, rel_to=None):
    d, ob, ref, local_goal = env.data, env.model.body(obj).id, env.model.body(rel_to).id if rel_to else None, np.array(pos)

    def read():
        goal = d.xpos[ref] + d.xmat[ref].reshape(3, 3) @ local_goal if ref is not None else local_goal
        return float(np.linalg.norm(d.xpos[ob] - goal)), None
    return read


position_within.goal_reader = position_within_goal_reader


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the missing part among the loose parts and seat it on the structure, release&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.success()),
    ]

      &lt;/worldbody&gt;&lt;/mujoco&gt;&#x27;&#x27;&#x27;)
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    env = SimpleNamespace(model=model, data=data)
    spec = dict(pred=&#x27;position_within&#x27;, obj=&#x27;piece&#x27;, rel_to=&#x27;ref&#x27;, pos=[.1, 0, 0], pos_tol=.005)
    check = _build(spec, &quot;stool_circular&quot;)
    for quat in ([1,0,0,0], [0,1,0,0], [.70710678,.70710678,0,0]):
        data.qpos[:] = [1,2.1,3,*quat]
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        assert check(env)
        assert not _build(dict(spec, pred=&#x27;pose_within&#x27;, quat=[1,0,0,0], rot_tol_deg=15))(env)
        data.qpos[0] += .006
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        assert not check(env)

from core.grade_episode import Subtask


def subtasks():
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the wine bottle and place it on the cabinet top&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.on_site(obj=&#x27;wine_bottle_1_main&#x27;, site=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_top_side&#x27;, size=[0.12534, 0.09438, 0.00147], parent=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_main&#x27;)
                and s.axis_up(obj=&#x27;wine_bottle_1_main&#x27;, axis=[0, 0, 1], tol_deg=20.0)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the bowl and place it in the top drawer&#x27;,
                lambda s: (s.in_site_box(obj=&#x27;akita_black_bowl_1_main&#x27;, site=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_top_region&#x27;, size=[0.02993, 0.07561, 0.10224])
                and (not s.grasped(obj=&#x27;akita_black_bowl_1_main&#x27;))
                and s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_middle_level&#x27;, lo=-0.01, hi=0.01)
                and s.joint_in(joint=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_bottom_level&#x27;, lo=-0.01, hi=0.01))),
        Subtask(&#x27;close the drawer with the bottle upright on top and the bowl inside&#x27;,
                lambda s: s.success(),
                needs=(1,), end_needs=(0,)),
    ]


def INVARIANT(s):
    return (not (s.grasped(obj=&#x27;akita_black_bowl_1_main&#x27;)
            and s.over_site(obj=&#x27;akita_black_bowl_1_main&#x27;, site=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_body_region&#x27;, lo=[-0.127, -0.1105, -0.109], hi=[0.127, 0.1105, 0.1])
            and (not s.over_site(obj=&#x27;akita_black_bowl_1_main&#x27;, site=&#x27;wooden_cabinet_1_top_region&#x27;, lo=[-0.2, -0.085, -0.11], hi=[0.055, 0.085, 0.11]))))
</pre></details>

def test_tidy_bowl_invariant_is_the_cabinet_volume_below_its_top():
    import mujoco
    import numpy as np
    from core.grade_episode import make_checker
    from core.sim_env import SimEnv
    env = SimEnv(&quot;tidy_counter&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    inside, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;over_site&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;akita_black_bowl_1_main&quot;, &quot;site&quot;: &quot;wooden_cabinet_1_body_region&quot;,
                              &quot;lo&quot;: [-0.127, -0.1105, -0.109], &quot;hi&quot;: [0.127, 0.1105, 0.1]})
    m, d = env.model, env.data
    adr = m.joint(&quot;akita_black_bowl_1_joint0&quot;).qposadr[0]
    site = d.site(&quot;wooden_cabinet_1_body_region&quot;)
    R, c0 = site.xmat.reshape(3, 3).copy(), site.xpos.copy()

    def place(rel):
        d.qpos[adr:adr + 3] = c0 + R @ np.asarray(rel)
        d.qpos[adr + 3:adr + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
        mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)

    place([0.0, 0.0, 0.05])
    assert inside(env)
    place([0.0, 0.0, 0.107])
    assert not inside(env)
    place([0.0, 0.0, 0.25])
    assert not inside(env)
    place([0.0, -0.25, 0.05])
    assert not inside(env)
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/vortex_sample/grade.py</code> (2 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Subtasks of vortex sample.

Speed knob set, mixer on, tube held in the cup until mixed (in that order), then the
mixer off and the tube back in the rack.&quot;&quot;&quot;
from core.grade_episode import Subtask

CHECKS = {&quot;knob_set&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;knob&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: 2.07, &quot;hi&quot;: 4.7}, &quot;mixer_on&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;any&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;switch&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: 0.3, &quot;hi&quot;: 0.45}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;switch&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: -0.45, &quot;hi&quot;: -0.3}]}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;knob&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: 2.07, &quot;hi&quot;: 4.7}]}, &quot;mixing_complete&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;userdata_in&quot;, &quot;index&quot;: 0, &quot;lo&quot;: 5, &quot;hi&quot;: 5}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;knob&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: 2.07, &quot;hi&quot;: 4.7}]}, &quot;tube_returned&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;in_site_box&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube&quot;, &quot;site&quot;: &quot;rack_wells&quot;, &quot;size&quot;: [0.0947, 0.032, 0.008]}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube&quot;, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 15.0}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;robot_clear&quot;, &quot;bodies&quot;: [&quot;tube&quot;]}]}, &quot;mixer_off&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;switch&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: -0.1, &quot;hi&quot;: 0.1}}


def joint_speed_in(joint, lo, hi):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;joint {joint} speed within [{lo}, {hi}] rad/s&quot;&quot;&quot;
    def check(env):
        j = env.model.joint(joint)
        return bool(lo &lt;= float(env.data.qvel[j.dofadr[0]]) &lt;= hi)
    return check


def userdata_in(index, lo, hi):
    &quot;&quot;&quot;scene state {index} within [{lo}, {hi}]&quot;&quot;&quot;
    return lambda env: bool(lo &lt;= env.data.userdata[index] &lt;= hi)


def subtasks():
    c = lambda name: lambda s: s.tree(CHECKS[name])
    return [
        Subtask(&#x27;turn the speed knob into range&#x27;, c(&quot;knob_set&quot;)),
        Subtask(&#x27;switch the mixer on&#x27;, c(&quot;mixer_on&quot;), ever=True, needs=(0,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;pick the tube and hold it in the mixer cup until mixing completes&#x27;, c(&quot;mixing_complete&quot;), ever=True, needs=(1,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;switch the mixer off&#x27;, c(&quot;mixer_off&quot;), needs=(2,), end_needs=(2,)),
        Subtask(&#x27;return the tube to the rack&#x27;, lambda s: s.success(), needs=(2,), end_needs=(2,)),
    ]


def INVARIANT(s):
    return s.tree({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;all&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;axis_up&quot;, &quot;obj&quot;: &quot;tube&quot;, &quot;axis&quot;: [0, 0, 1], &quot;tol_deg&quot;: 15.0}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;any&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: [{&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;not&quot;, &quot;of&quot;: {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;robot_clear&quot;, &quot;bodies&quot;: [&quot;tube&quot;]}}, {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;touching_part&quot;, &quot;a&quot;: &quot;tube&quot;, &quot;b&quot;: &quot;tube_rack&quot;}]}]})
</pre></details>
<details><summary><code>tasks/vortex_sample/dynamics.py</code> (4 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;The vortex mixer&#x27;s motor and display.

The vortex mixer: motor and display for the declared eccentric cup. The knob picks a speed, the switch runs it,
and a tube held pressed in the cup mixes; a lamp and a tilting liquid show the progress. task.json&#x27;s `vortex`
declares the joints, geoms, speeds and thresholds.&quot;&quot;&quot;
import mujoco
import numpy as np

from core.grade_episode import _grasped


class Dynamics:
    def __init__(self, env):
        self.cfg = c = env.spec[&quot;vortex&quot;]
        m = env.model
        self.actuator = m.actuator(c[&quot;actuator&quot;]).id
        self.switch = m.joint(c[&quot;switch&quot;]).qposadr[0]
        self.knob = m.joint(c[&quot;knob&quot;]).qposadr[0]
        self.velocity = m.joint(c[&quot;joint&quot;]).dofadr[0]
        self.cup = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(c[&quot;cup&quot;])))
        root = int(m.body_rootid[m.body(c[&quot;cup&quot;]).id])
        self.instrument = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(m.body(root).name)))
        self.sample = set(map(int, env._subtree_geoms(c[&quot;sample&quot;])))
        self.lamp = m.geom(c[&quot;lamp&quot;]).id
        self.liquid = m.geom(c[&quot;liquid&quot;]).id
        self.liquid_quat = m.geom_quat[self.liquid].copy()

    def state(self, env):
        start = self.cfg[&quot;state_index&quot;]
        return env.data.userdata[start:start + 4]

    def reset(self, env):
        state = self.state(env)
        state[:] = [0, -1, 0, env.episode_t0]
        env.data.ctrl[self.actuator] = 0
        self.paint(env)

    def forces(self, env):
        total = sample = 0.0
        wrench = np.empty(6)
        for i, contact in enumerate(env.data.contact[:env.data.ncon]):
            g1, g2 = int(contact.geom1), int(contact.geom2)
            if g1 in self.cup and g2 not in self.instrument:
                other = g2
            elif g2 in self.cup and g1 not in self.instrument:
                other = g1
            else:
                continue
            mujoco.mj_contactForce(env.model, env.data, i, wrench)
            normal = max(0.0, float(wrench[0]))
            total += normal
            if other in self.sample:
                sample += normal
        return total, sample

    def physics_step(self, env):
        c, d = self.cfg, env.data
        state = self.state(env)
        if state[3] != env.episode_t0:
            self.reset(env)
        tick = env.num_step + 1
        if state[1] == tick:
            return
        state[1] = tick
        switch = float(d.qpos[self.switch])
        on = c[&quot;on&quot;][0] &lt;= switch &lt;= c[&quot;on&quot;][1]
        touch = c[&quot;touch&quot;][0] &lt;= switch &lt;= c[&quot;touch&quot;][1]
        off = c[&quot;off&quot;][0] &lt;= switch &lt;= c[&quot;off&quot;][1]
        detent = int(np.clip(np.floor(d.qpos[self.knob] / c[&quot;detent_spacing&quot;] + 0.5), 0, 10))
        rpm = float(np.interp(detent, [1, 10], c[&quot;rpm&quot;])) if detent else 0.0
        total, sample = self.forces(env)
        d.ctrl[self.actuator] = rpm * np.pi / 30 if (
            on or touch and total &gt;= c[&quot;touch_force&quot;]) else 0.0
        speed = float(d.qvel[self.velocity])
        mixing = (on or touch) and sample &gt;= c[&quot;touch_force&quot;] and (
            speed &gt;= c[&quot;mix_rpm&quot;] * np.pi / 30) and _grasped(env, c[&quot;sample&quot;])
        if off:
            state[0] = 0
        elif mixing:
            state[0] = min(c[&quot;mix_steps&quot;], state[0] + 1)
        liquid_target = (float(np.clip(speed / (c[&quot;mix_rpm&quot;] * np.pi / 30), 0, 1))
                         if sample &gt;= c[&quot;touch_force&quot;] else 0.0)
        decay = np.exp(-1 / (env.control_freq * c[&quot;liquid_relaxation&quot;]))
        state[2] = liquid_target + (state[2] - liquid_target) * decay
        self.paint(env)

    def paint(self, env):
        c, m = self.cfg, env.model
        state = self.state(env)
        lit = state[0] &gt;= c[&quot;mix_steps&quot;]
        spinning = abs(env.data.qvel[self.velocity]) &gt; c[&quot;stop_speed&quot;]
        m.geom_rgba[self.lamp] = c[&quot;lamp_rgba&quot;][&quot;green&quot; if lit else &quot;amber&quot; if spinning else &quot;off&quot;]
        angle = c[&quot;liquid_tilt&quot;] * state[2]
        quat = np.array([np.cos(angle / 2), np.sin(angle / 2), 0.0, 0.0])
        mujoco.mju_mulQuat(m.geom_quat[self.liquid], self.liquid_quat, quat)

    def deal(self, env):
        self.reset(env)
        env.forward()

    def restore(self, env):
        self.paint(env)
</pre></details>

<details><summary><code>tasks/vortex_sample/test.py</code> (7 KB)</summary><pre>&quot;&quot;&quot;Tests of the vortex_sample task.&quot;&quot;&quot;

import mujoco
import numpy as np
import pytest
from core.sim_env import SimEnv
from core import grade_episode as predicates
from core.grade_episode import make_checker



@pytest.fixture
def mixer():
    env = SimEnv(&quot;vortex_sample&quot;, seed=0)
    env.reset(seed=0)
    return env


def controls(env, n):
    for _ in range(n):
        for _ in range(env._substeps):
            env._step_physics()
        env._advance_episode_state()


def dial(env, detent, switch):
    env.data.joint(&quot;knob&quot;).qpos[0] = detent * 0.46
    env.data.joint(&quot;switch&quot;).qpos[0] = switch
    env.forward()


@pytest.mark.parametrize(&quot;detent&quot;, [0, 1, 5, 10])
def test_vortex_on_mapping_and_physical_speed(mixer, detent):
    dial(mixer, detent, 0.4)
    controls(mixer, 20)
    target = (600 + (detent - 1) * 2600 / 9) * np.pi / 30 if detent else 0
    assert mixer.data.actuator(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).ctrl[0] == pytest.approx(target)
    assert mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] == pytest.approx(target, abs=4)
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0


def test_vortex_touch_without_pressure_and_off(mixer):
    dial(mixer, 10, -0.4)
    controls(mixer, 20)
    assert mixer.data.actuator(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).ctrl[0] == 0
    assert abs(mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0]) &lt; 1
    dial(mixer, 10, 0.4)
    controls(mixer, 20)
    dial(mixer, 10, 0)
    controls(mixer, 1)
    assert mixer.data.actuator(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).ctrl[0] == 0
    assert mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] &gt; 100
    controls(mixer, 14)
    assert abs(mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0]) &lt; 1


def test_vortex_control_sampling_and_accumulated_lamp(mixer, monkeypatch):
    dial(mixer, 5, -0.4)
    mixer.dynamics.physics_step(mixer)
    driver = mixer.dynamics
    monkeypatch.setattr(driver, &quot;forces&quot;, lambda env: (0.3, 0.3))
    monkeypatch.setattr(&quot;tasks.vortex_sample.dynamics._grasped&quot;, lambda env, obj: True)
    for i in range(5):
        mixer.num_step += 1
        mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 180
        driver.physics_step(mixer)
        assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == i + 1
        for _ in range(200):
            driver.physics_step(mixer)
        assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == i + 1
        mixer.num_step += 1
        mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 0
        driver.physics_step(mixer)
        assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == i + 1
    np.testing.assert_allclose(mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_lamp&quot;).rgba, [0.03, 1, 0.08, 1])
    dial(mixer, 5, 0)
    mixer.num_step += 1
    driver.physics_step(mixer)
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0


def test_vortex_unheld_sample_cannot_mix(mixer, monkeypatch):
    dial(mixer, 5, 0.4)
    mixer.dynamics.physics_step(mixer)
    driver = mixer.dynamics
    monkeypatch.setattr(driver, &quot;forces&quot;, lambda env: (0.3, 0.3))
    monkeypatch.setattr(&quot;tasks.vortex_sample.dynamics._grasped&quot;, lambda env, obj: False)
    for _ in range(10):
        mixer.num_step += 1
        mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 180
        driver.physics_step(mixer)
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0


def test_vortex_geometry_orbit_and_state_serialization(mixer):
    points = []
    for angle in np.arange(4) * np.pi / 2:
        mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qpos[0] = angle
        mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_orbit&quot;).qpos[0] = -angle
        mixer.forward()
        points.append(mixer.data.site(&quot;platform_function&quot;).xpos.copy())
    points = np.asarray(points)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.linalg.norm(points - points.mean(0), axis=1), 0.002)
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 3
    saved = mixer.sim_state()
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 5
    mixer.reset_to_sim_state(saved)
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 3
    assert mixer.model.opt.timestep == 0.00025
    assert mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_liquid_surface&quot;).contype == 0


def test_vortex_reset_randomize_and_rewind_repaint(mixer):
    driver = mixer.dynamics
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 3
    mixer.data.userdata[2] = 0
    before = mixer.checkpoint()
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 5
    mixer.data.userdata[2] = 1
    driver.paint(mixer)
    assert mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_lamp&quot;).rgba[1] == 1
    assert mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_liquid_surface&quot;).quat[1] != 0
    mixer.restore(before)
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 3
    np.testing.assert_allclose(mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_lamp&quot;).rgba, [0.08, 0.09, 0.08, 1])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_liquid_surface&quot;).quat, [1, 0, 0, 0])
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 5
    mixer.redeal_episode()
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0
    assert mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_lamp&quot;).rgba[1] &lt; 0.1
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 5
    mixer.reset(seed=0)
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0
    assert mixer.model.geom(&quot;mix_lamp&quot;).rgba[1] &lt; 0.1


def test_vortex_grading_requires_mix_then_stopped_and_return(mixer):
    controls(mixer, 1)
    dial(mixer, 5, -0.4)
    check = mixer._check
    assert check(mixer) is False
    assert check(mixer) is False
    assert check.at == 2
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 4
    assert check(mixer) is False
    assert check.at == 2
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 5
    assert check(mixer) is False
    assert check.at == 3
    dial(mixer, 5, 0)
    mixer.data.userdata[0] = 0
    mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 100
    assert check(mixer) is False
    assert check.at == 3
    mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 0
    assert check(mixer) is False
    assert check.at == 4
    assert check(mixer) is True
    mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 2
    assert check(mixer) is False


def test_vortex_tilt_invariant_latches_failure(mixer):
    angle = np.radians(16)
    a = mixer._obj_qadr[&quot;tube&quot;]
    mixer.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [np.cos(angle / 2), np.sin(angle / 2), 0, 0]
    mixer.forward()
    for _ in range(5):
        assert mixer._check(mixer) is False
    assert mixer._check.dead
    mixer.data.qpos[a + 3:a + 7] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
    mixer.forward()
    assert mixer._check(mixer) is False
    assert mixer._check.dead


def test_vortex_liquid_relaxes_without_grasp_credit(mixer, monkeypatch):
    dial(mixer, 5, 0.4)
    driver = mixer.dynamics
    monkeypatch.setattr(driver, &quot;forces&quot;, lambda env: (0.3, 0.3))
    monkeypatch.setattr(&quot;tasks.vortex_sample.dynamics._grasped&quot;, lambda env, obj: False)
    mixer.data.joint(&quot;platform_pivot&quot;).qvel[0] = 180
    driver.physics_step(mixer)
    response = mixer.data.userdata[2]
    assert 0 &lt; response &lt; 1
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0
    monkeypatch.setattr(driver, &quot;forces&quot;, lambda env: (0, 0))
    mixer.num_step += 1
    driver.physics_step(mixer)
    assert 0 &lt; mixer.data.userdata[2] &lt; response
    assert mixer.data.userdata[0] == 0


def test_joint_speed_in_reads_velocity_not_position_or_control():
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(
        &#x27;&lt;mujoco&gt;&lt;worldbody&gt;&lt;body&gt;&lt;joint name=&quot;spin&quot; type=&quot;hinge&quot;/&gt;&#x27;
        &#x27;&lt;geom type=&quot;sphere&quot; size=&quot;0.1&quot;/&gt;&lt;/body&gt;&lt;/worldbody&gt;&lt;/mujoco&gt;&#x27;)
    d = mujoco.MjData(m)
    env = SimpleNamespace(model=m, data=d)
    check, _ = make_checker({&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_speed_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;spin&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: -1, &quot;hi&quot;: 1}, &quot;vortex_sample&quot;)
    d.qpos[0] = 200
    for velocity, expected in ((-1, True), (1, True), (1.001, False), (-1.001, False)):
        d.qvel[0] = velocity
        assert check(env) is expected
    assert &quot;rad/s&quot; in predicates.describe(
        {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;joint_speed_in&quot;, &quot;joint&quot;: &quot;spin&quot;, &quot;lo&quot;: -1, &quot;hi&quot;: 1}, &quot;vortex_sample&quot;)[0][1]


def test_userdata_in_inclusive_bounds_and_description():
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    env = SimpleNamespace(data=SimpleNamespace(userdata=np.array([0.0, 5.0])))
    spec = {&quot;pred&quot;: &quot;userdata_in&quot;, &quot;index&quot;: 1, &quot;lo&quot;: 5, &quot;hi&quot;: 5}
    check, _ = make_checker(spec, &quot;vortex_sample&quot;)
    assert check(env) is True
    env.data.userdata[1] = 4
    assert check(env) is False
    env.data.userdata[1] = 6
    assert check(env) is False
    assert &quot;scene state 1&quot; in predicates.describe(spec, &quot;vortex_sample&quot;)[0][1]
